  • Partner closely with AWS Professional Services, client engineering, and data teams to align the work with broader platform and business goals
  • Translate technical tradeoffs, system behavior, and constraints into terms non-specialists can act on
  • Participate actively in code reviews and design discussions, raising concerns and offering constructive feedback

Leadership & Influence

  • Contribute to data and AI architecture decisions with thoughtful perspective on tradeoffs and long-term implications
  • Take ownership of meaningful work end-to-end, including the unglamorous parts of getting AI into production
  • Raise the bar on engineering practices through your own work and by supporting more junior engineers when opportunities arise

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years professional software or data engineering experience, with 2+ years building data platforms or AI/ML systems in production on AWS
  • Strong software engineering background (Python and SQL, or similar)
  • AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate. Candidates without it are considered if there is a clear, near-term path to earning it
  • Hands-on experience building data lakes on AWS, including S3, Lake Formation, Glue, Athena, and Iceberg or Parquet, with exposure to streaming on Kinesis or MSK
  • Experience with observability for distributed and AI systems, including CloudWatch, X-Ray, OpenTelemetry/ADOT, Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus and Grafana, and drift monitoring with SageMaker Model Monitor
  • Working knowledge of agent enablement on AWS, including Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, RAG patterns, and Bedrock Agents
  • Experience shipping agentic or ML systems in production environments
  • Experience with MLOps and LLMOps practices, including evaluation, deployment, and monitoring of models and agents
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CDK, and CI/CD for data and AI systems
  • Understanding of IAM and KMS security, data governance, responsible AI principles, and PII handling
  • Cost optimization experience across storage, query, compute, and model usage
  • Experience delivering solutions in a consulting or professional services setting, working alongside client and partner teams
  • Demonstrable, day-to-day usage and knowledge of AI-forward coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous technical challenges with sound judgment

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • Experience in regulated enterprise environments such as financial services
  • Additional AWS certifications such as Machine Learning Engineer – Associate, Security – Specialty, or Solutions Architect – Professional
  • Prior work with AWS Professional Services or other AWS partner delivery teams
  • Experience with agent frameworks and orchestration tools, such as Strands Agents or LangGraph
  • Open-source contributions or deep familiarity with the OpenTelemetry ecosystem

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Application Development
description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Do you enjoy turning complex technical challenges into reliable, well-designed software? Are you passionate about building applications, integrations, and services that power your organization? If so, then we want you on our team!


We’re looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer, Application Development to join our growing team. In this role, you’ll help design, build, deploy, and support software services that power network observability across Zayo. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. You will own complex services and cross-service capabilities, translate ambiguous operational needs into scalable solutions, mentor other engineers, and establish practical engineering standards. You will partner with Software Architecture, Network Operations, SRE, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, product stakeholders, and network-domain experts to ensure services are secure, testable, deployable, observable, resilient, and supportable in production.


Technology Environment

Our environment includes technologies such as:

  • Backend: Python 3.11+, FastAPI, gRPC, Pydantic, Protobuf, SQLAlchemy, and Alembic
  • Data and messaging: PostgreSQL, NATS, Redis and asynchronous messaging
  • Platform and delivery: Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI, Helm, and Terraform
  • Observability and networking: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Elasticsearch, VictoriaMetrics, gNMI, SNMP, NETCONF, and vendor APIs

The technology mix varies by service. Equivalent experience with comparable frameworks, messaging platforms, databases, and infrastructure technologies is welcome.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, implementation, and operation of complex backend Python services, APIs, and data-processing workflows, translating ambiguous requirements into clear technical approaches while remaining hands-on in the codebase.
  • Design asynchronous and event-driven integrations and establish scalable patterns for API and event contracts, schema evolution, validation, error handling, database migrations, backward compatibility, and distributed-system reliability.
  • Make and document technical decisions that balance delivery speed, operational risk, maintainability, scalability, and long-term platform direction; contribute to technical roadmaps and modernization efforts.
  • Lead design and code reviews, establish practical standards for Python, testing, security, observability, and documentation, and mentor engineers in breaking down complex work and delivering incrementally.
  • Improve CI/CD practices and partner with SRE and DevOps on container images, Kubernetes deployments, infrastructure as code, secrets management, environment configuration, deployment verification, and rollback.
  • Define production-readiness expectations through service-level indicators, metrics, dashboards, alerts, performance testing, capacity analysis, and resilience testing.
  • Lead complex incident investigations, address root causes and corrective actions, and drive systemic risks spanning multiple services, repositories, teams, or environments to resolution.
  • Coordinate technical dependencies across internal projects and platforms, working with Network Operations and other users to ensure solutions measurably improve operational outcomes.

Required Qualifications:

  • Advanced Python development experience, including structuring, testing, packaging, and operating long-lived backend applications.
  • Experience leading the design or delivery of distributed services, APIs, data platforms, network tools, or automation systems, including asynchronous or event-driven integrations.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases, SQL, data modeling, transaction behavior, indexing, and controlled schema migrations.
  • Hands-on experience with Linux, Docker, containerized services, CI/CD pipelines, and automated software-quality and security controls.
  • Experience implementing production observability and diagnosing complex problems across application code, infrastructure, databases, messaging systems, and external dependencies.
  • Demonstrated ownership of production software through delivery, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and continual improvement.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture, mentoring, project leadership, design reviews, code reviews, or cross-team influence, with the ability to communicate technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing software solutions within the telecommunications industry, with an understanding of carrier networks, network operations, service assurance, network inventory, provisioning, transport/IP technologies, or telecommunications operational support systems (OSS).
  • Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, gRPC, Protobuf, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, or another production messaging platform.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, GitLab CI, GitOps, or progressive-delivery tooling.
  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Elasticsearch, Loki, VictoriaMetrics, service-level objectives, or advanced performance and resilience testing.
  • Experience with network telemetry protocols such as gNMI, SNMP, or NETCONF and integrations with network inventory, alarming, service-assurance, or orchestration platforms.
  • Experience processing high-volume operational telemetry or building software for NOC, SRE, infrastructure, network-engineering, or telecommunications environments.

Education And Experience

  • Minimum of seven (7) years of professional software development experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience designing and operating complex production systems.
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology OR equivalent relevant professional experience.

title: Associate Director, AI for Oncology Clinical Development
location: Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States of America
description:
Drug discovery has benefitted enormously in the current AI era yet comprises only a portion of the journey to bring new treatments to those in need. The final step – clinical drug development – is oft overlooked, despite requiring a significant proportion of time and investment. In the AI for Clinical Development team at AstraZeneca, we're reimagining the process of clinical development. Our vision is to bring safe, efficacious treatments to patients in a way that quantifiably improves our chance to do this faster, more cost-effectively, and with reduced patient burden.

In this role, you will be a technical lead to help us leverage the power of AI to the fullest, alongside our other computational, statistical, and machine learning tools. You will work across the enterprise to define and deliver on AstraZeneca’s most pressing clinical development questions. You will proactively collaborate in cross-functional teams spanning AstraZeneca’s key Oncology foci of hematology, cell therapy, antibody-drug conjugates, small molecules, and biologics. This is an unprecedented, high visibility opportunity to invent new ways to leverage data, models, and learnings across the spectrum of cancer biology and drug modalities – and importantly, you and the team will apply these new methods to measurably advance the late-stage drug pipeline and our group’s ambition.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the AI strategy and roadmap for Oncology early and late phase clinical development
  • Serve as a key technical lead and contributor in matrixed teams to deliver complex, high-stakes AI projects
  • Evaluate and develop cutting-edge AI methods in one or more areas of problem definition, data considerations, governance, algorithm development, validation, and adoption
  • Partner with clinical development, biometrics, regulatory, and study teams to develop and then validate novel AI solutions into clinical study design, execution, strategy, and decision-making
  • Establish and maintain external collaborations with academic institutions, technology partners, and industry consortia to access novel capabilities and advance the AI roadmap
  • Represent AstraZeneca at scientific conferences, standards bodies, and peer-reviewed venues; contribute first- or last-author publications in leading ML and clinical AI journals
  • Mentor and support peers within the team

Qualifications:

  • PhD in a quantitative discipline such as computer science, bioinformatics, computational biology, mathematics, physics, biophysics, computational neuroscience, biostatistics
  • At least 2+ years’ work experience outside of PhD with measurable impact (e.g. models delivered, patents, SaMD filings, first-author publications, open-source projects, standards-body participation)

Technical requirements:

  • Exceptional software development and coding skills, leveraging frontier coding agent frameworks; knowledge of computing hardware a plus
  • Deep experience, knowledge, and understanding of one or more fields of biology
  • Deep understanding of machine learning fundamentals, with domain expertise in one or more of the following -
    • Training and tuning foundation models
    • Bayesian inference
    • Temporal modeling
    • Multimodal integration and modeling
    • Model calibration and domain adaptation
    • Data-centric AI: acquiring, creating, and curating datasets for model training / post-training / benchmarking / evals
    • Model and data evaluations and benchmarking
    • Model interpretability
    • Model post-training and alignment

Preferred Skills:

  • Deep expertise in cancer biology
  • Experience working with biological data such as molecular (e.g. DNA, RNA, protein), imaging (radiology, microscopy), or clinical text (e.g. EHR, clinical notes)
  • Experience in drug development including but not limited to clinical trial design, biomarker discovery, companion diagnostics, dosing, safety, endpoints, and regulatory
  • Experience in a matrixed global organization spanning multiple sites and therapy areas
  • Up to date with the latest AI research and tools, proactively trying out those of interest, and ability to discern hype from true added value

The annual base pay for this position ranges from $144K to $216K. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short-term incentive bonuses, equity-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Platform Activation & Innovation

  • Leverage Data Cloud as the 'intelligent brain' to enable real-time, closed-loop engagement.

Integration & Ecosystem Modernization

  • Overhaul the peripheral integration ecosystem, transitioning from legacy middleware toward real-time, API-first architectures.

  • Define and enforce standards for event-driven integrations and microservices.

  • Ensure seamless data orchestration between Salesforce Data Cloud and internal/external oncology data sources (e.g., claims data, EHR integrations, specialty pharmacy feeds), prioritizing data quality, lineage, and latency.

Global-to-Local Strategic Alignment

  • Serve as the primary technical liaison to Global Product teams, extending the 'Global Core' baseline to meet unique U.S. regulatory and market demands.

  • Establish feedback loops that influence the global roadmap to account for U.S. Oncology’s specific technical constraints and opportunities.

Engineering Leadership

  • Lead and mentor a squad of engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, agile delivery, and continuous learning.

  • Set engineering standards, conduct design/code reviews, and drive DevSecOps practices (CI/CD, automated testing, observability).

  • Oversee technical deliverables from external implementation partners and Salesforce Professional Services to ensure alignment with quality expectations and architecture principles.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Education / Experience

Bachelor’s degree preferably in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

7+ years of overall experience preferably in CRM or related Customer Engagement processes.

Stakeholder Influence

Proven ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across both Business and IT. You must be able to translate complex technical trade-offs into strategic business value and negotiate priorities between U.S. commercial leaders and Global IT product owners.

Omnichannel Mastery

Expert-level understanding of closed-loop marketing and omnichannel orchestration. Proven ability to architect solutions where CRM activities and digital triggers (email, web, social) are synchronized via a central AI/data engine.

Salesforce Ecosystem

Proven track record managing Veeva CRM or Salesforce Life Science Cloud suite. Deep expertise in Salesforce Data Cloud and Marketing Cloud.

Integration Design

Mastery of RESTful API design, Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), and asynchronous messaging patterns using tools like Kafka or MuleSoft. Experience managing complex data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes, specifically ensuring data integrity across disparate clinical and commercial sources.

Agile Leadership

Proven ability to lead Scrum/Kanban squads, manage technical debt, and drive a DevSecOps culture (CI/CD pipelines, GitFlow, Automated Testing).

Preferred Skills

Emerging AI

Hands-on experience or certifications in Salesforce Agentforce or building autonomous agents using Large Language Models (LLMs) and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).

Domain Knowledge

Deep understanding of U.S. Oncology (HIPAA, claims data, EHR models, and regulatory considerations).

Cloud Architecture

Proficiency in AWS or Azure cloud services, specifically for serverless computing (Lambda/Functions) or data warehousing (Snowflake).

Vendor Management

Experience managing 'Managed Services' or System Integrator (SI) partners to ensure code quality and adherence to architectural blueprints.

What You’ll Achieve in Your First 12 Months

USD $18.00 - USD $21.00 /Hr.

title: Radar Signal Processing Engineer
description:
IERUS specializes in customized electromagnetic spectrum technologies and prototype design for radar and sensing applications. IERUS supports customers with a diverse set of competencies including software development, antenna design and manufacture, radar systems, and algorithms. IERUS develops value for our defense and commercial customers through accelerating technology through its development life cycle: identifying, creating, transitioning, and producing technologies with integrity of purpose and product.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Radar Signal Processing Engineer to join our dynamic research and development team. This position offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge radar technologies and signal processing algorithms as part of innovative R&D projects. The successful candidate will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of engineers and scientists to advance the state-of-the-art in radar systems and sensing algorithms.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement advanced radar signal processing algorithms for next-generation radar systems
  • Conduct research and development of novel signal processing techniques to enhance radar performance and capabilities
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including RF engineers, software developers, systems engineers, and program managers
  • Perform modeling, simulation, and analysis of radar systems and signal processing architectures
  • Prototype and test radar signal processing solutions in laboratory and field environments
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and research trends in radar signal processing.

Required Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. citizen
  • Active DoD Secret Clearance
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field
  • 8-12 years relevant experience
  • Strong background in radar principles, signal processing theory, and algorithm development
  • Proficiency in MATLAB, Python, or similar technical computing environments
  • Experience with research and development methodologies and practices
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively in collaborative, multidisciplinary team environments

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with advanced radar signal processing techniques (synthetic aperture radar, adaptive processing, STAP, machine learning applications)
  • Knowledge of RF system design and electromagnetic modeling tools (HFSS, Feko, CST)
  • Experience with real-time signal processing and FPGA development
  • Familiarity with AI/ML applications in radar and signal processing
  • Experience with radar system testing and measurement

Location: Woburn, MA

The proposed salary range for this position is $141,000- $184,000. Salaries are commensurate with candidate experience and qualifications within the experience bandwidth, as well as market and business considerations.

IERUS Technologies is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other federally protected class.

IERUS Technologies participates in E-Verify.

title: Senior Specialist, Bioprocess & Technical Engineering
description:
Job Description

We’re looking for a Senior Specialist in Bioprocess & Technical Engineering to join our team and make a significant impact on our manufacturing network. This is a key leadership role where you will have the opportunity to shape how complex biological processes are introduced, scaled and improved. You will work with our internal sites and external partners to enhance our technical capabilities, ensure our facilities are ready for new technologies and lead initiatives that directly support the quality and supply of life-changing products for patients.

Our team thrives on technical excellence, collaboration and a shared commitment to making a difference. We work closely with teams across Manufacturing, Science & Technology, Quality and Engineering to solve challenges and ensure our processes are robust and efficient. In this role, you will report to the Director of Bioprocess & Technical Engineering and play a vital part in setting high standards across our network.

Bring energy, knowledge, innovation to carry out the following

  • Lead facility-fit and manufacturing readiness assessments by evaluating new products against existing site capabilities, identifying facility, equipment sizing, utility and operational constraints, and defining strategies to enable successful technology transfer and commercialisation.
  • Develop and own process mass balances and capacity models to assess manufacturing feasibility, technology requirements, equipment utilisation, buffer and media demands, and end-to-end process performance across the product lifecycle.
  • Drive technology identification and platform alignment by evaluating process technologies, manufacturing strategies, and equipment solutions that support robust, scalable and standardised biologics manufacturing across the network.
  • Establish and champion platform technology standards by defining, implementing, and governing manufacturing platforms, process design principles, and engineering best practices to maximise consistency, transferability and operational excellence.
  • Support the development and deployment digital engineering tools and models that enable data-driven decision making for facility fit assessments, mass balance development, capacity planning, equipment selection, technology transfer readiness, and lifecycle management.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to internal teams and external partners, ensuring engineering solutions are scientifically sound, operationally sustainable, compliant, and aligned with platform strategies.
  • Support/lead cross-functional technical assessments and investigations supporting new product introductions, technology transfers, process changes, and manufacturing optimisation initiatives, utilizing structured problem-solving methodologies to identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
  • Drive continuous improvement and innovation through the development of engineering standards, digital capabilities, knowledge management systems, and scalable approaches that improve transfer success rates, reduce complexity, and enhance manufacturing robustness.
  • Shape the future manufacturing network by contributing to technology roadmaps, facility expansion strategies, capital investment decisions, and technical due diligence activities for new products, emerging technologies, and strategic partnerships.
  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence by promoting technical rigor, knowledge sharing, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning across the organiser.

What Skills You Will Need

In order to excel in this role, you will more than likely have

  • A Bachelor’s degree in engineering, biological sciences or a related field, with at least seven years of relevant experience in engineering, manufacturing or technology transfer.
  • A minimum of 7 years of experience in biologics drug substance manufacturing, with a background in facility design, process engineering or commercial manufacturing support.
  • A strong technical understanding of biologics manufacturing processes, equipment and automation.
  • The ability to lead and influence in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas to a variety of audiences.
  • A talent for connecting technical details to broader business goals, such as supply reliability and quality.
  • An inclusive leadership style that helps create a psychologically safe and accountable work environment.
  • Experience with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) environments, quality systems and change control.
  • Strong problem-solving, organisational and prioritisation skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in monoclonal antibody drug substance manufacturing.
  • Expertise in upstream or downstream biologics process engineering.
  • Familiarity with new product introductions, Process Performance Qualification (PPQ) and lifecycle management.
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement methods like Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma.
  • Experience with global regulatory requirements and supporting health authority inspections.
  • A willingness to travel up to 20% may be required.

We keep the patient at the very heart of all that we do and strive to find solutions and treatments for some of the world's most challenging healthcare needs.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are proud to be a company that embraces the value of bringing diverse, talented, and committed people together. Please don't hesitate to contact the Talent Acquisition Advisor assigned to this role should you need any support during our recruitment process.

We are committed to flexible working where possible, and this is why our Company has introduced a new hybrid working model for office-based colleagues around the world.

Please feel free to speak to us about what flexibility means to you during your application.

Required Skills

Clinical Manufacturing, Commercialization, Data Analysis, Influencing Skills, Investigation Management, Manufacturing Scale-Up, Process Engineering, Regulatory Compliance, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Stakeholder Management, Strategic Thinking

Employee Status: Regular

Flexible Work Arrangements: Hybrid

title: Data Engineer
description:
Salary: Competitive Salary + 12% Superannuation!

WHY TEAM SIMONDS?

The Simonds story all started in 1949 with a passionate family man, Gary Simonds. He envisioned a builder that Australians could rely on to guide them through the process of crafting their perfect home. This vision remains at the heart of Simonds today with our commitment to making the Great Australian Dream a reality by placing home ownership within Australia’s reach.

Becoming part of Team Simonds means becoming part of the family. Our people are the heart of what we do. Our homes are built for the community, by the community, with a local network of employees, trades and supplies all working towards this vision. It is this passion, dedication, and excellence that you will find on every Simonds job site, office, and display centre across the country. Today, we stand proudly as an ASX listed & leading national builder servicing customers across Victoria, Queensland, South Australia and Western Australia.

Simonds has helped shape Australia. Few can say that. Whether we’re looking back at the homes of yesteryear, what we’re building now, or everything that’s still to come. We’ve not only shaped what Australia looks like, but more importantly, how Australia homes.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Data Engineer at Simonds, you'll play a key role in building and evolving our modern data platform. Reporting to the Analytics Manager, you'll design and maintain data integration pipelines, support cloud data initiatives, and help deliver reliable, high-quality data that drives business decisions.

Working across a variety of business systems, you'll collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to improve data accessibility, streamline integrations and support enterprise reporting and enterprise analytics.

In this role, you'll:

  • Design, build and maintain data integration pipelines using Boomi AtomSphere and SSIS and other enterprise integration technologies.
  • Develop ETL/ELT processes and SQL-based data models to support reporting and analytics.
  • Support the migration of data into modern cloud platforms, including Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric or similar technologies.
  • Optimise data pipelines for performance, reliability and scalability.
  • Improve data quality through validation, governance and best practice.
  • Partner with the Analytics Manager, IT teams and vendors to deliver innovative data solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to automate processes and continuously improve the data environment.

WHO YOU ARE

You're a hands-on Data Engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable data solutions. You're adaptable and thrive in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment, able to shift priorities, pick up new challenges quickly and move seamlessly between competing demands. You work well independently, collaborate effectively with others and take pride in delivering high-quality outcomes.

You'll bring:

  • 4-6 years' experience in a Data Engineering role.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT development using SSIS or similar tools.
  • Experience with Boomi AtomSphere or another enterprise integration platform (such as MuleSoft, Azure Integration Services or Informatica).
  • Strong SQL and T-SQL skills.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake or Databricks.
  • An understanding of data warehousing, data modelling and API integrations.
  • Exposure to Power BI and Python will be highly regarded.
  • Strong communication skills and a proactive, solution-focused approach.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment, with the ability to shift priorities, pick up new challenges quickly and move seamlessly between competing demands.

Relevant tertiary qualifications are preferred, while Boomi, Azure or Snowflake certifications will be viewed favourably.

WHY JOIN US?

Aside from a fantastic opportunity to join one of Australia's ASX listed leading residential builders, Simonds can offer you:

  • Great benefits across a wide range of products and services including a generous discount on our award-winning homes as well as all the great things that go in them.
  • Access to our free employee well-being program, including counselling, nutritional, financial, and legal support for both you and your immediate family.
  • Access to Simonds Reward Days - receive an extra day of leave per year.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth through our Learning and Development programs on our inhouse Simonds Learning platform.
  • Access exclusive employee benefits including novated leasing, discounted car hire, and health, retail, and energy savings.
  • Enjoy sporting, trade, and supplier discounts, including partner offers with the Geelong Cats and Melbourne United, plus discounted access to materials and services for personal projects.
  • Generous rewards and recognition.

A commensurate remuneration package will be negotiated with the right candidate.

If this sounds like your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you as soon as possible!

Please note: You must have unlimited Australian work rights to be considered for this role.

title: Senior Data Governance & Classification Specialist
description:
Senior Data Governance & Classification Specialist

Provide technical and strategic advisory services to government entities to help them build their data asset registers and implement classification policies. Design guidelines and toolkits to enable government employees to classify data independently and efficiently. Measure the level of compliance of government entities with national data classification policies and submit periodic performance reports to decision-makers. Lead national initiatives to assess cybersecurity risks resulting from improper classification of sensitive data at the state level. Ensure alignment of different entities’ policies with national data protection and privacy legislation, and identify data sovereignty requirements. Evaluate global technical solutions in data classification and provide recommendations to government entities on the best tools suited to the national infrastructure. Organize national workshops and conferences to transfer knowledge and discuss challenges faced by institutions in implementing data classification projects.

The contract duration is 12 months, with the possibility of extension based on departmental requirements.

Requirements

Required Academic Degree

Bachelor’s degree in (Information Security, Computer Science, or Management Information Systems). Strongly preferred: Master’s or PhD in (Data Governance or Public Cybersecurity Policy).

Required Training Certificates (If Required)

CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional) – Advanced level CGEIT (Certified in the Governance of Enterprise IT) Audit and compliance certifications such as CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor / Implementer

Required Years Of Experience

Minimum 10 years of experience in data governance and security. Must include at least 4 years working on regulatory frameworks, national policies, or consulting for major government institutions.

Required Language Proficiency

Arabic: Optional English: Required Other: Arabic preferred but not mandatory

Other Required Qualifications

Regulatory background: Deep understanding of local data and privacy laws and national cybersecurity standards. Consulting skills: Strong ability to influence and negotiate with senior leadership across government entities. Strategic vision: Ability to link data classification to national priorities such as digital transformation, data economy, and digital sovereignty. Institutional excellence: Familiarity with government excellence standards and quality models (e.g., EFQM) to ensure world-class advisory services.

title: Järjestelmäasiantuntija (kiinteistöautomaatio), Oulu
description:
Haluatko tehdä käytännönläheistä työtä, jossa osaamisesi näkyy toimivina ja turvallisina kiinteistöinä? ARE:lla pääset osaksi satavuotiasta perheyritystä ja työyhteisöä, jossa rakennamme yhdessä kestävämpää arkea. Haemme nyt kiinteistöpalveluihimme kiinteistöautomaation järjestelmäasiantuntijaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Kiinteistöpalveluissamme huolehdimme muun muassa kauppakeskusten, hotellien ja toimistokiinteistöjen taloteknisestä huollosta ja kunnossapidosta. Työllämme varmistamme, että kiinteistöt toimivat luotettavasti, energiatehokkaasti ja tarjoavat miellyttävät olosuhteet niiden käyttäjille.

Järjestelmäasiantuntijana pääset työskentelemään monipuolisissa ja vaihtuvissa asiakaskohteissa järjestelmien ohjelmoinnin ja vianetsinnän parissa sekä tunti- että projektitöissä. Toimit asentajien teknisenä tukena, osallistut tarjouslaskentaan yhdessä työnjohdon kanssa ja otat vastuuta asiakkuuksien automaatiotöistä. Pääset myös vaikuttamaan toiminnan kehittämiseen edustamalla Oulun automaatio-osastoa sisäisissä kehityshankkeissa. Työskentelet pääsääntöisesti arkisin klo 7–15.30.



Työpäivieni suola on niiden monipuolisuudessa. Tarvittaessa lähden aina auttamaan myös kollegoita, jos siihen on tarve. ARE:lla työskennellessä ei tarvitse töitä tehdä yksin, vaan aina voi luottaa siihen, että apua saa ja yhdessä onnistutaan.



Toivomme sinulta:

- Automaatioinsinöörin AMK-tutkintoa

- Ymmärrystä talotekniikkaprosesseista- ja laitteista

- Tietämystä kiinteistöautomaation laitekannasta

- Tietoa ja kokemusta Schneider Electric, Honeywell tai jonkin muun rakennusautomaatiojärjestelmien ohjelmoinnista sekä käyttöönotosta

- Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia

- B-ajokorttia

- Nuhteeton tausta asiakaskohteiden luonteen takia

Arvostamme itsenäistä ja järjestelmällistä työotetta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä halua tehdä laadukasta työtä asiakkaan arjessa. Sinulla pysyvät kokonaisuudet hallinnassa, ja viihdyt työssä, jossa asiakaspalvelu ja tekninen osaaminen kulkevat rinnakkain.

ARE – arvostettujen ammattilaisten talo

Suunnittelemme työt huolellisesti, toimimme ennakoivasti ja pidämme huolta siitä, että jokainen pääsee päivän päätteeksi turvallisesti kotiin. Saat tueksesi arvostettujen ammattilaisten yhteisön, hyvän perehdytyksen ja vaihtelevia tehtäviä, joissa ammattitaitosi vahvistuu osana arjen tekemistä. title: Data specialist - project - (6 months)
description:
POSITION:

Data Specialist - Project 6 Months

LOCATION:

Epsom Downs, Johannesburg

REPORTING TO:

Director: Conservation Development

Purpose

Owns the organization’s data architecture across systems — starting with, but not limited to, the finance ERP — and actively drives the conversion of manual data capture into automated data capture wherever it makes sense to do so. Acts as custodian of financial data as the canonical source of truth, and builds the reporting, automation, and integration layer connecting the ERP to the rest of the organization’s systems. This is not a passive data-analysis role: a core part of the mandate is identifying where manual processes are introducing risk or wasted effort and building the automation to remove them.

Relationship to the Business Central Migration

This role is not the primary technical lead on the Business Central migration — that responsibility sits with the Microsoft Partner and Finance ERP Manager as day-to-day liaison. However, this role's involvement is still load-bearing, in three specific ways:

Owns the data architecture that replaces what Serenic's fund-accounting layer used to do. Business Central does not natively support funds, grant, or encumbrance accounting, so this logic must be rebuilt as a dimension structure. Designing how funds, cost centers, and restricted/unrestricted tracking get modelled is a data architecture problem and sits with this role. This is the single most concrete, highest-stakes piece of migration involvement it carries. Owns the business logic behind anything builds on the company’s behalf, so that knowledge does not live only with the vendor. The intercompany elimination automation is the clearest current example: The Microsoft Partnerbuilds it, but this role is responsible for understanding why it works the way it does, so the organization is not permanently dependent on the vendor to explain its own system. Pick up the integration and automation work that sits just outside the migration's Phase 1 boundary — connecting Kiss flow, Salesforce, and other systems to Business Central; building write-back budget reporting; eventually migrating Jet Reports to Power BI. None of this is "the migration" in the narrow sense, but all of it only becomes possible once the migration lands, and all of it is what turns a working ERP into a well-integrated one. In short: the Finance ERP Manager keeps the migration moving day-to-day; this role makes sure it is being built on a data structure that will actually hold up. Key Responsibilities Owns and maintains a data map of the organization — what data lives where, and where it needs to flow between systems (the finance ERP, Kiss flow, Salesforce, Res Request, Tall Order, Sage 300, Jet Reports, Power BI). Acts as custodian of the ERP's financial data as the organization’s canonical source, guarding against corruption from manual entry and championing automation wherever possible. Systematically identifies manual, repetitive, or error-prone data capture processes across the organization and assesses where converting them to automated capture is appropriate — this is an active, ongoing part of the role, not an occasional project. AP Reporter, an internal tool already used to digitize previously manual field data capture, is a useful illustration of the kind of work this role should be doing more broadly, including on the operational side of the business. Designs and builds automation using Power Apps and Power Automate to replace manual workflows — for example, structured data-entry forms in place of ad hoc spreadsheets, or automated approval/routing steps in place of manual email chains. Designs and builds Power BI dashboards and reports, in collaboration with the company's BI team, including budget-vs-actual, compliance monitoring, and ad hoc analytical requests. Builds ERP-integrated budget reporting with write-back capability (e.g. via a tool such as Velixo), replacing the current static, Excel-based annual budget process. Owns the Phase 2 migration of existing Jet Reports functionality into Power BI — auditing existing reports, understanding their purpose and audience, and defining what should be rebuilt versus retired. Leads the data-integration design for connecting adjacent systems to Business Central — including vendor master data ownership, dimension mapping for fund/cost-center tracking, and sync error handling (relevant to Kiss flow, Salesforce, and other integrations). Designs the approach to historical data retention once the legacy ERP environment is decommissioned — e.g. extracting to a data lake (such as Microsoft Fabric) rather than keeping a live, costly legacy system running indefinitely. Build training materials and dashboards that help operational users understand the quality and purpose of the data they capture, in partnership with the People & Change role. Works closely with the existing in-house BI team, historically a separate, request-driven function with no direct working relationship with Finance. Required Skills & Experience Strong data architecture or data modelling background, ideally with exposure to ERP-centric environments. Maintains comprehensive, up-to-date documentation and architecture diagrams of the data landscape — a mandatory, not optional, part of the role, given the succession risk inherent in such a specialized position. Hands-on, practical experience building automation with Power Apps and Power Automate specifically — this is a core, not peripheral, requirement for this role. Hands-on experience with Power BI and, ideally, Microsoft Fabric. Experience integrating an ERP with adjacent business systems such as CRM, procurement, point-of-sale, or payroll platforms. A genuine automation-first mindset — able to spot where a manual process should become an automated one, and to weigh that judgement against effort and risk, not just build automation for its own sake. Working SQL proficiency. Strong stakeholder management — this role sits across departments by design and needs to work with Finance, BI, Operations, and IT without a single clean reporting line. Advantageous, Not Required Direct experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Experience with Excel-to-ERP reporting/write-back tools such as Velixo. Experience with multi-entity consolidation or intercompany elimination design. Nonprofit or donor-funded sector experience.

title: IT Support Tech I
description:
Position Summary / Essential FunctionThe IT Support Technician provides responsive, hands-on technical assistance that supports the availability, functionality, security, and efficient use of information technology systems across Central Wire locations. As a member of the Business Direct Customer Support Team, the position serves as a first point of contact for user incidents and service requests involving desktop and laptop computers, printers, scanners, Microsoft 365 applications, telephone systems, accounts, and related peripherals.
Working primarily from established procedures and under the guidance of the Business Systems Analyst Team and Security and Infrastructure Team, the IT Support Technician I diagnoses routine issues, performs approved configurations and installations, documents work in the ticketing system, and escalates matters requiring advanced analysis or specialized authority. The position also maintains accurate technology records, supports onboarding and user training, assists with technology deployments and projects, and helps maintain an organized inventory of IT equipment.
Key Duties and Responsibilities
Help Desk and End-User Support• Provide timely, professional first-line technical support to more than 500 users in an international, multi-site environment.• Respond to help desk telephone calls, email requests, and tickets; gather relevant information and determine the nature, urgency, and business impact of reported issues.• Troubleshoot routine hardware, software, connectivity, access, printing, scanning, and peripheral issues using established diagnostic procedures and available knowledge resources.• Assist users with the effective use of approved IT systems, applications, and equipment.• Resolve issues within assigned authority and technical capability; route or escalate complex application, infrastructure, cybersecurity, or recurring issues to the appropriate support group.• Keep users informed regarding ticket status, expected next steps, and resolution.
Ticket Management and Documentation• Create and maintain complete, accurate, and timely ticket records in the established IT service-management system.• Document symptoms, diagnostic steps, actions taken, equipment or systems affected, escalation details, and final resolution.• Monitor assigned incidents and service requests through closure and follow up to confirm an effective resolution.• Create and update knowledge-base articles, build instructions, and repeat-fix documentation when appropriate.
Endpoint, Account, and Technology Support• Following established procedures and with guidance as needed, configure, install, deploy, update, replace, and support desktops, laptops, printers/copiers, telephone equipment, approved software applications, and related peripherals.• Perform basic PC hardware installation, replacement, repair, and bench work within assigned authority.• Assist the Enterprise Software and Security and Infrastructure teams with approved account, user ID, password, access, patching, upgrade, and deployment activities.• Apply cybersecurity fundamentals and promptly report suspected security events, unauthorized access, phishing, malware, or control exceptions through established channels.• Follow change-management, asset-management, security, data-protection, and configuration standards.
Inventory, Records, Training, and Projects• Maintain accurate department records, including hardware inventory, software licensing, deployed assets, network or device configuration information, and knowledge-base content.• Maintain appropriate IT hardware stock levels and an orderly, safe bench and storage area in accordance with established guidelines.• Participate in new-employee orientation and provide basic IT training regarding systems access, equipment, security practices, and support procedures.• Assist with IT projects, equipment deployments, site support, system upgrades, and other departmental initiatives as assigned.• Communicate technical issues, ticket flow, project status, risks, and dependencies to members of the support team.• Travel to other CWI locations as required to provide on-site IT support.• Perform other related duties as assigned.
Required Qualifications• One to three years of IT support, help desk, desktop support, customer service, or systems support experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.• Working knowledge of Windows operating-system installation, configuration, and troubleshooting.• Basic working knowledge of Active Directory and Windows domain environments.• Experience supporting Microsoft 365 applications.• Experience with PC hardware installation, build, component replacement, and basic repair.• Basic knowledge of TCP/IP networking concepts and cybersecurity fundamentals.• Strong analytical troubleshooting, organization, documentation, follow-up, and customer-service skills.• Ability to communicate technical information clearly to users with varying levels of technical knowledge.• Ability to work independently within established procedures and collaborate effectively with specialized IT teams.
Preferred Qualifications• Technical certificate, associate degree, or coursework in information technology, computer systems, networking, cybersecurity, or a related discipline.• Experience supporting users in a manufacturing, multi-site, or international environment.• Experience with an IT service-management or help desk ticketing platform.• Relevant entry- or intermediate-level certification, such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals, or an equivalent credential.
Key Skills and Competencies• Approachability and Listening: Puts users at ease, gives appropriate attention, asks effective questions, and demonstrates receptivity to the information provided.• Communication: Explains technical information clearly in writing and verbally, selects the appropriate communication method, and provides the level of detail needed by the audience.• Composure: Responds to urgent requests and demanding situations in a tactful, calm, and self-controlled manner.• Cooperation and Teamwork: Works flexibly and collaboratively with users, peers, and specialized support teams; demonstrates trust and respect for others.• Customer Focus: Builds effective internal-customer relationships, understands user needs and business impact, and offers practical support within established standards.• Priority Setting: Assesses urgency, impact, dependencies, and service expectations to organize work and escalate appropriately.• Accountability and Follow-Through: Maintains accurate records, meets commitments, monitors open work, and follows issues through resolution or effective handoff.• Technical Aptitude and Continuous Learning: Applies the technical knowledge required for the role, learns new technologies and procedures, and recognizes when specialized assistance is required.• Safety and Security Awareness: Performs physical and technical work safely and follows applicable cybersecurity, access-control, confidentiality, and asset-handling requirements.
Work Environment / Physical Requirements• Frequent sitting and computer use, with occasional standing, walking, bending, reaching, and work in confined or restricted equipment areas.• Ability to lift, carry, position, and install equipment weighing up to 30 pounds.• Ability to use standard hand tools and safely connect, disconnect, and move computer and peripheral equipment.• Ability to work scheduled evenings and/or weekends when required for patching, upgrades, installations, maintenance, or business-continuity support.
BenefitsSubject to the terms, eligibility requirements, and amendment provisions of the applicable plans and policies:• 401(k) with matching • Dental insurance • Employee assistance program • Flexible spending account • Health insurance • Health savings account • Life insurance • Paid time off • Referral program • Tuition reimbursement • Vision insurance

title: Clinician II - CReW (Federal Way)
description:
Overview

Full-time (40 hours) position starting at $39.37 per hour (D.O.E) with COMPETITIVE BENEFITS INCLUDE:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life insurance and long‑term disability
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
  • Generous paid time off, including paid sick leave, 15 vacation days, 12 paid holidays, and 1 personal holiday
  • CCS/CHS 403(b) Employee Savings Plan

POSITION DESCRIPTION:This position is responsible for outreach, case management and therapeutic support to assist in maintaining the stability of tenants across a variety of life domains, focusing especially on housing retention and mental health. This position and will work under the direction of both Plymouth Housing Program Director and the CReW Clinical Supervisor to assure all program goals and objectives are met.

Who We Are:

Catholic Community Services’ Counseling, Recovery & Wellness (CReW) Program is a licensed community mental health and substance use disorder treatment program and provider of the King County Integrated Care Network (KC-ICN). Our collaborative team focuses on serving adults with mental illness and/or substance use disorders to help improve the quality of life for our clients and our great community. Services offered utilize Harm Reduction and Recovery principles, with an emphasis on building collaborative relationships with the persons served as the first step towards lasting engagement in treatment. Range of services includes diagnostic assessments, individual therapy, peer support, case management, group counseling, skills training, care coordination, medication management, and psychoeducation. Our team was created out of the need for onsite supportive services in our agency housing program and we adapt our services to best fit the unique needs of our clients in a variety of locations within Seattle downtown and greater King County. CReW is committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Candidates from all walks of life are strongly encouraged to apply.

POSITION SUMMARY:The Co-Occurring Counselor works both independently and as part of a team to provide outreach, individual psychotherapy, and ongoing case management services to diverse clients who have co-occurring mental health and substance use disorders. As we strive to meet clients where they are, our work occurs in a variety of settings, including client homes in various housing sites, shelters, and in the community.

WHAT WE OFFER:

As a full-time position (40 hrs/week), employees are eligible for medical, dental & vision insurance coverage, pension and 403(b) plans. CCS also offers optional enrollment in supplemental cancer insurance, hospitalization and critical illness insurance. Employees accrue generous amounts of sick time and paid vacation, in addition to 13 paid holidays annually. Licensure supervision is available (LICSW, LMHC, LMFT), as well as oversight, if needed, for first 50 clinical hours required for a SUDPT credential. Hybrid remote work schedules may be possible depending upon primary locations, caseload served, and team schedules.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Clinical Assessment and Intervention:

  • Complete trauma informed biopsychosocial assessments for individuals enrolling in CReW services to determine client strengths and needs to create a diagnostic picture.
  • Provide and/or facilitate a range of therapeutic responses and interventions, including case management, psychotherapy, trauma processing and/or skills training, intended to support the overall recovery of the individual.
  • Plan interventions collaboratively with treatment teams, focusing on a non-judgmental and strengths-based approach.
  • Identify the needs, barriers, and strengths of residents to develop bi-annual treatment plans and document interactions in routine case notes that reflect progress in relation to the treatment plan.
  • Participate in psychiatric consultation, staffing, and supervision.
  • Facilitate support groups that focus on a range of topics, some of which include: activities of daily living skills, housing transitions, social skills, grief and loss support, concepts of recovery, education and health resources, or others.

Case Management:

  • Assess client needs and required level of services, identify community resources to meet those needs, facilitate clients’ access to services, and advocate for them on a continuing basis. Such needs may include accessing housing, financial and health benefits, primary health care, mental health treatment, substance use counseling, chore service, protective payees, transportation, food access, and legal services.
  • Assist clients with locating resources and services for affordable housing, as well as offer assistance with the move-in and transition process via skills training and advocacy with landlords to promote long-term stability.
  • Provide and/or arrange necessary crisis response and stabilization services. Respond to crises in a prompt, effective and collaborative manner.
  • Provide crisis de-escalation and risk assessment for clients as needed. Advocate with Emergency Responders, King County Designated Crisis Responders, Detox and Drug and Alcohol Involuntary Treatment Services when more intensive services are needed.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Outreach and engage with people living in homelessness to identify potential clients who are in need of services but may not necessarily be willing to participate.
  • Communicate and uphold CReW program and agency policies and procedures with staff and clients.
  • Develop and support a positive team oriented and inclusive work environment.
  • Maintain confidentiality and maintain an atmosphere of safety and support for staff and clients.
  • As CReW is a HIPAA covered entity service area, staff are responsible for upholding a culture of privacy and security in highly confidential work environment.
  • Complies with all CCSWW policies and procedures that involve access to and safeguarding of client Protected Health Information (all forms).
  • Other duties as assigned.

JOB CONDITIONS:COVID Statement: Due to the nature to engage individuals who are living in homelessness, some field based and site based work is required. CCS provides various levels of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) to staff and to clients. CCS requires that all staff and clients follow safety protocols around masking, distancing and sanitation as directed by local and state governments as well as recommended Public Health guidance.

This position requires the employee to work in an environment where there may be exposure to blood, bodily fluids, and other potentially infectious material. Other exposures could include cleaning supplies, chemicals involved in pest control, paint and other materials used in building maintenance. Working conditions may include interruptions, interactions with angry persons, and exposure to computers.

WHAT WE’RE SEEKING IN A CANDIDATE:

  • Meet or exceed qualifications for Mental Health Professional (as defined by WAC 246-341: a person with a Master’s in Social Work, Psychology or Counseling; OR with a Master’s degree in one of the social sciences along with two years of experience in clinical services under the direct supervision of an MHP).
  • Substance Use Disorder Professional or Trainee (SUDP/T, formerly CDP/T) credential with Washington Department of Health, OR ability to obtain DOH credential within 60 days of hire.
  • One-year direct services experience with vulnerable populations including people in homelessness, with mental illnesses or substance use disorders.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Basic computer skills with ability to maintain up to date and meticulous records.
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment, allowing for flexibility in role development and working as part of a multidisciplinary program.
  • Support and uphold the mission, beliefs and values of Catholic Community Services and Catholic Housing Services.
  • Responsible for upholding a culture of privacy and security in highly confidential work environment (HIPAA covered entity service area).
  • Complies with all CCSWW policies and procedures that involve access to and safeguarding of client Protected Health Information (all forms).
  • Demonstrate the necessary attitudes, knowledge and skills to deliver culturally competent services and work effectively in multi-cultural situations.
  • Criminal history background checks are required prior to employment.

Note to Internal Candidates: HR reviews internal compensation and determines any increase based on their experience and also agency internal equity factors.

Catholic Community Services and Catholic Housing Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Please let us know if you need special accommodations to apply or interview for this position.

title: Tooling Engineer
description:
Tooling Engineer
**ABOUT ADVANCED ENERGY**
Advanced Energy (Nasdaq: AEIS) is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement and control solutions for mission-critical applications and processes. AE's power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing and healthcare. Advanced Energy has devoted four decades to perfecting power for its global customers and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.
**WHY BE A PART OF ADVANCED ENERGY?**
Some people say it's like working in the best of two worlds. We operate like an agile, growing, small company - you can see your work make a difference to the company every day. Things move quickly and you can see and feel it. At the same time, we're a global company founded in 1981 and have been publicly traded for more than 28 years. We have a strong cash position, deep trust and partnership with leading customers, a global best-in-class operations capability, and a proven leadership team. We have a track record and resources to make things happen both organically and inorganically. Being part of a nimble company with a solid foundation attracts team members that are capable, driven and like a challenge. Our employees collaborate and know how to have fun inventing, working, building and winning together. At our core, we are Advanced Energy - powering the future, together.
**POSITION SUMMARY**
+ Responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining manufacturing tooling and fixtures for production lines in the TH facility, ensuring tooling reliability, production efficiency, and product quality.
+ Provides regional technical support for tooling operations and collaborates with cross-functional teams to optimize tooling solutions and drive continuous improvement in manufacturing processes.
**RESPONSIBILITIES**
+ Design and engineer custom tooling, jigs, and fixtures for manufacturing processes (e.g., assembly, machining, inspection) using CAD software, ensuring compliance with production requirements and safety standards.
+ Collaborate with external vendors and internal production teams to source, fabricate, and validate tooling prototypes, conducting design reviews and feasibility analyses.
+ Troubleshoot tooling-related issues (e.g., wear, misalignment, performance inefficiencies) on production lines, implementing corrective actions and preventive maintenance plans.
+ Optimize existing tooling designs to reduce production costs, improve cycle times, and enhance product quality, leveraging lean manufacturing principles.
+ Manage tooling inventory and maintenance schedules, tracking tooling performance metrics (e.g., uptime, repair frequency) and documenting tooling specifications and SOPs.
+ Participate in new product introduction (NPI) projects, leading tooling design and validation activities to support smooth production ramp-up.
+ Ensure compliance with industry regulations and company safety policies in all tooling design, fabrication, and usage activities.
+ Travel to Malaysia, China, and Philippines to support regional tooling rollouts, provide on-site technical training for local teams, and align tooling standards across facilities.
**QUALIFICATIONS**
+ Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. A master's degree in Manufacturing Systems is a plus.
+ Minimum 3 years of tooling engineering experience in a manufacturing environment (automotive, electronics, or consumer goods manufacturing preferred).
+ Hands-on experience with tooling fabrication, vendor management, and on-site tooling installation/validation.
+ Prior experience in cross-regional manufacturing support or international travel for technical assignments is a plus.
+ Experience with lean manufacturing or tooling cost optimization projects is desirable.
+ Expertise in tooling design principles and manufacturing processes, including knowledge of materials (e.g., steel, aluminum), machining techniques, and fixture design for assembly/machining operations.
+ Proficiency in 3D CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, CATIA) and CAM tools for tooling fabrication; experience with finite element analysis (FEA) is a plus.
+ Strong problem-solving skills with experience in root cause analysis (RCA) for tooling failures and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma).
+ Familiarity with manufacturing quality standards (e.g., ISO 9001) and tooling safety regulations.
+ Ability to create detailed technical documentation (e.g., tooling drawings, maintenance manuals) and train production personnel on tooling operation and care.
+ Fluent in English (verbal/written)

title: BackEnd Developer to Team Motor for Blocket
description:
Direct Link -

What you will be up to

Exciting times as mentioned, we are on fire! Welcome to Blocket Motor, Blocket’s strongest and financially biggest growth engine. And specifically, welcome to our team where we focus on our private users who want to buy or sell a vehicle at Blocket. Everything from making it easy to find a car that suits your need, displaying the correct information about a boat, making it smooth to enter information about the vehicle you want to sell and creating an ad to promote it on Blocket. Our ambition is to take the user experience to the next level and create new types of values both for our users and for Blocket. That is what we are doing during our working hours. In addition, our work leads towards a more sustainable world, so you will get a little karma in this role as well. Not bad at all. You will work in a cross functional team with three-four additional developers, as well as UX, data insights, product management and your Engineering Manager.

Skills & Requirements

Who you are

We believe you are a seasoned developer with at least 4 years hands-on experience of Backend development working in a team. You are able to independently lead the development of new features, and enjoy discussing and debating code and solutions with your peers. You like sharing your knowledge with your cross functional team and also more junior developers and above all, you are curious and continuously strive to learn new things. We are often working in pairs so collaboration is another key.

Skills

  • Python
  • Kafka
  • SQL (PostgreSQL)
  • Event-driven systems
  • Distributed systems and microservices

Bonus

  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • ElasticSearch

Hello from your colleagues!

Hey there! Welcome to us! You will be working with such a widely used product that has so many active users. This means that the things we are building will be seen and used by a lot of people every day. All car dealers in the country are here. Big and small. It is also a great technical challenge having such a large user base. We constantly get the chance to develop and release new features and updates to make Blocket Motor an even better product. That is inspiring! Another inspiring thing is to work with a product that really lies in time, sustainability is everything these days. The tech stack used by the team is modern, it is really nice to work with an event driven micro service architecture. Frontend and backend work tightly together, we do a lot of pair- and mob programming. Sten is our manager and with him you can be yourself, perfectly candid and relaxed. He is very involved in the product and the team, always up for a chat, good meal or a ride. Although more into roller coasters than Harley’s.

Hi there, I’m your new manager!

My name is Sten and it’s my job to make sure you develop great stuff, have fun and grow as a person. We have many great challenges ahead of us. Both technical and to create great experiences. As a developer my core competence are within iOS and mobile development but I have wide experience from different phases of the product development cycle. In my role as manager and coach I like to see everyone in my team to get involved, have fun and grow as both developers and humans. I really would love to work with you 🙂

Interested in joining the Blocket world? We look forward to hearing from you! Send your CV or apply with your LinkedIn-profile and let us know what makes you tick. We would love to get to know you a bit better! Have a link to some neat stuff on github? Make sure to include a link when you apply.

Buzz: backend developer, backend, communication, python, kafka, SQL, postgreSQL, docker, kubernetes, reactJS

And we’re rolling. The road is there, some bumps everywhere, but with big wheels we keep on turning, and Sten in the team is burning (i.e. on fire as the rest of us. It is really exciting times!). We’re rolling Blocket Motor by building some really great products. You will have the greatest cross functional team with co-drivers to collaborate with in order to build new fantastic, secure and trustable products that will make life much more smooth and lovely for our dear clients and users. And they are many, like everywhere in Sweden. So jump in, seatbelts on, let’s roll!

We are Blocket, Sweden’s largest and most popular marketplace with around 12,3M monthly active users generating 100 million sessions.
