title: Global Medical Core Capability Strategy Lead
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

Job Description

The Global Medical Core Capability Strategy Lead is a Director-level expert and the primary design and development lead for Takeda Medical’s global capability architecture. This role builds the intellectual foundation that Medical Excellence operates from, developing the competency frameworks, role archetypes, what good looks like descriptors, and capability roadmap that define what excellence looks like across Medical roles enterprise-wide. The role will be based in either Cambridge MA, or Zurich, Switzerland.

Operating with a TA-agnostic, enterprise-wide lens, this role works in close peer partnership with the Global Scientific Training Leads, IBU Medical Excellence, and the broader Medical Excellence network, ensuring capability frameworks are grounded in clinical and scientific reality and fit for purpose across all BUs and markets. The role is the development and design engine within the Medical Capability Strategy & Operations group, translating the Medical Affairs Vision 2030 agenda into a systematic, evidence-based capability architecture that the Head, Medical Capability Strategy & Operations can then govern, align, and champion across the enterprise.

ACCOUNTABILITIES

1. Capability Framework Design & Development

  • Lead the design and development of Takeda Medical’s global competency frameworks, role archetypes, and what good looks like descriptors across all Medical roles, ensuring they are grounded in enterprise needs, scientifically credible, and fit for purpose across all BUs, markets, and therapy areas
  • Own the capability maturity model, defining clear progression standards and capability levels that enable structured assessment, development planning, and performance measurement across the global Medical organization
  • Continuously evolve the capability architecture in response to changes in the enterprise operating model, portfolio priorities, and the external Medical Affairs landscape, ensuring frameworks remain current and forward-looking

2. Medical Affairs Vision 2030 Capability Roadmap

  • Lead the translation of the Medical Affairs Vision 2030 agenda into a systematic, multi-year capability development roadmap for Takeda Medical, defining the future-ready capabilities required and the sequenced development architecture to build them
  • Work in close partnership with the Head, Medical Capability Strategy & Operations to ensure the roadmap is aligned to enterprise transformation priorities and can be governed and aligned across Global Medical Leadership, BUs, and markets
  • Identify and integrate emerging capability requirements, including data fluency, AI-enabled engagement, omnichannel scientific interaction, and evidence generation, into the capability roadmap ahead of need

3. Performance Standards & Measurement

  • Define clear, measurable performance indicators that translate what good looks like descriptors into observable behaviors and outcomes, enabling consistent assessment and development planning across the global Medical organization
  • Partner with the Head, Medical Capability Strategy & Operations and the Learning Strategy & Operations team to ensure capability performance measurement is embedded in the Bloom learning ecosystem and, over time, in the CXF platform
  • Contribute informed input into how capability data can be structured and leveraged within the CXF program, working with DD&T and the Head, Medical Capability Strategy & Operations to ensure the capability architecture is built into the platform design

4. Stakeholder Co-Creation & Enterprise Partnership

  • Work in close peer partnership with the Global Scientific Training Leads to ensure capability frameworks are grounded in scientific training realities and that the capability architecture and scientific training curricula are coherently integrated rather than operating in parallel
  • Partner with the Head, Europe & Intercontinental Medical Excellence, IBU Medical Excellence & Operations, US Scientific Training, and OBU Scientific Training to ensure capability frameworks and role archetypes are co-created and fit for purpose across the full range of BU contexts and market operating models
  • Engage with Marketing & Commercial Excellence, R&D, and DD&T as key stakeholders in capability design, ensuring Medical capability frameworks reflect the cross-functional expectations of what future-ready Medical Affairs looks like
  • Provide capability and skillset development input into Takeda’s Enterprise Engagement model, contributing to the rules of the road that govern how Medical Affairs and Global Development collaborate to support clinical studies, ensuring the underlying capability and skillset requirements are reflected in the Medical capability architecture
  • Support the Head, Medical Capability Strategy & Operations in presenting and aligning capability frameworks across Global Medical Leadership and enterprise stakeholders, acting as the subject matter expert and design authority

5. Bloom Content Governance & Programme Development

  • Contribute to the governance of the Bloom learning ecosystem by ensuring capability framework content, what good looks like descriptors, and related learning assets are current, well-curated, and aligned to the broader program architecture
  • Contribute to building internal capability framework design and development bench strength within the broader Medical Capability Strategy & Operations team, supporting the function’s ambition to operate with greater independence from external vendors over time
  • Manage external vendor relationships and content development partnerships supporting capability framework design and development as a complement to internal team capability, with accountability for approximately USD $1-2M annual budget for external capability development spend

DIMENSIONS & ASPECTS

  • Deep expertise in competency framework design, capability architecture, talent development strategy, and adult learning principles, with strong understanding of Medical Affairs Vision 2030 and what the capability evolution to 2030 requires in practice across a complex enterprise
  • Operates with a TA-agnostic, enterprise-wide strategic lens, working through influence and co-creation across the Medical Excellence network and key BU partners without direct authority, building credibility through expertise, rigor, and the quality of the frameworks produced
  • Decision authority within the capability design domain, accountable for the intellectual quality and enterprise fitness of competency frameworks, role archetypes, and what good looks like descriptors, with shared accountability for the broader capability architecture governed by the Head, Medical Capability Strategy & Operations
  • Primary relationships: Head, Medical Capability Strategy & Operations (line manager), Global Scientific Training Leads (peer co-creation), Head, Europe & Intercontinental Medical Excellence, IBU Medical Excellence & Operations, US Scientific Training, OBU Scientific Training, MCE, DD&T, R&D, Global Medical Excellence Leads network

EDUCATION, BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

  • MD, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent advanced scientific or medical degree preferred; relevant healthcare, learning sciences, or organizational development degree required
  • 10+ years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, with significant experience in Medical Affairs
  • 6+ years of progressive experience in capability development, Medical Excellence, talent strategy, or closely related roles
  • Demonstrated expertise in competency framework design, capability architecture, and performance standards development in a global pharmaceutical context
  • Strong understanding of Medical Affairs field roles, scientific engagement, and the Medical and Commercial interface
  • Proven ability to influence and build consensus across senior stakeholders without direct authority in a complex, globally distributed matrix environment
  • Experience working across Global, BU, Regional, and LOC Medical structures preferred
  • Awareness of digital and AI-enabled learning technologies and their application to Medical Affairs capability development

Locations

title: Solution Architect
description:
The Silverchain Group is one of Australia's leading in home care specialists, providing health and aged care services to 140,000 clients a year. We have been trusted by Australians to deliver care that is differentiated by quality and safety for 130 years.

Silverchain provides home care services in all states of Australia, and the ACT in partnership with our clients, as well as governments, health networks, hospitals, retirement communities, and private companies. We employ nurses, doctors, allied health, care workers, and a dedicated research and innovation division.The Solution Architect plays a strategic role in shaping the data foundations of Silverchain's Digital Program - a multi-year transformation to deliver a national operational care platform powered by Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Azure.

Working across business, technical, vendor and Silverchain's technical analysis team, the Solution Architect reporting to the Technical Lead, will be responsible for designing and optimising solution architecture across Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE), Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O), Azure services, and modern low-code/no-code platforms for Silverchain's Digital Program. This role provides assurance that program data is structured, secure, integrated, and aligned with business goals, leveraging the Microsoft ecosystem to enable analytics, reporting, and AI-driven insights.

Operating within a hybrid agile delivery model, the Solution Architect ensures that solution architecture decisions are aligned to regulatory requirements, program objectives and enterprise strategy, ensuring and enabling a future-ready platform that supports Silverchain's ambition to lead the future of home care.

What's on offer

  • Full-Time, Fixed-Term 12 months position.
  • Hybrid role based in WA, SA, VIC, QLD or NSW.
  • Working for a non-profit organisation, you can salary package up to $18,500 tax free.
  • Everyday discounts, including vouchers for Coles, Woolworths, Amazon, Myer, The Good Guys and more.
  • Comprehensive health and wellbeing resources and support.

What we're looking for

To thrive in this role, you'll need:

  • Tertiary qualifications in Computer Science, Data, Information Technology or related discipline.
  • Proven experience as a Solution Architect or Integration Architect in large-scale enterprise or government programs.
  • Deep demonstrated expertise in Azure data services:
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Azure Data Factory
  • Azure Synapse Analytics
  • Azure Data Lake Storage
  • Azure SQL / Cosmos DB
  • Strong understanding of data integration patterns (batch, streaming, APIs, event-driven).
  • Proficiency in Power Platform (Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps) for no-code/low-code enablement.
  • Demonstrated experience with data security, compliance, and governance frameworks.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

The role

As a Solution Architect, you will:

  • Lead the maturation of solution and integration architecture and capabilities in alignment with the company's strategic vision and business and Digital Program objectives.
  • Establish and execute the Digital Program's integration roadmap and approach for integrating Dynamics 365 CE and F&O with Azure data services and other existing OB systems/services.
  • Align the Digital Program's D365 design and implementation with legislative, compliance, cybersecurity, licensing, and operational requirements.
  • Own responsibility for all architecture artefacts relevant to integration patterns, and reference architectures across Dataverse, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and related services within the Digital Program's scope, with a significant focus on integration architecture.
  • Assess and assure robust data and security integration between Dynamics 365 CE/F&O, third-party systems, and external data sources.
  • Enforce, and where necessary support the development of data governance frameworks, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality standards.
  • Work with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable data solutions.
  • Collaborate with solution architects, application teams, and infrastructure specialists within the Digital Program, Silverchain's Data Strategy and Analytics Team and Digital Services to ensure alignment on design and integration.

Why choose Silverchain

Everyone at Silverchain, from our care teams to leadership, plays a vital role in delivering Best Care. It's a team effort. Best Care is care that is safe, personal, connected and effective. We are proudly one of the few Australian home care providers accredited in both national health and aged care standards. This means the quality of care we provide is expected to meet the same standards as a hospital or residential aged care facility. As a not-for-profit organisation, our ambition is to create a better home care system for all Australians and we develop innovative models of care to set the industry benchmark. We'll also provide you with opportunities to help you develop and grow in your career, with training and education programs to help you achieve your goals.

How to apply

To submit your application, click ‘Apply'.

At Silverchain, we recognise the positive contribution that a diverse workforce makes to our organisation where individuals can be authentic, respected and celebrated. We strongly encourage applications from Indigenous Australians, people of all ages, gender, abilities, and cultural backgrounds.

* Aikaisempi kokemus siivoustehtävistä on eduksi
* Positiivista asennetta ja joustavuutta
* Tarkkuutta ja luotettavuutta työtehtävissä
* B-ajokortti ja mahdollisuus oman auton käyttöön on hyödyksi kohteen sijainnin vuoksi
* Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa (Fluency in Finnish is a requirement for this position)

Miksi Luotealle töihin?

MeLuoteallapidämme aidosti huolta työntekijöistämme ja haluamme, että viihdyt ja voit hyvin joka päivä. Saat meistä rinnallesi luotettavan ja luotsaavan suomalaisen työnantajan, joka toimii vastuullisesti, pitää lupauksensa sekä huolen siitä, että palkanmaksusi on ajallaan.

Perehdytämme sinut huolella työsuhteen käytäntöihin ja työtehtäviisi, sekä erikseen jokaiseen kohteeseen, jossa työskentelet. Käyttöösi saat asianmukaiset ja modernit työvarusteet. Meillä et jää yksin, vaan sinulla on aina saatavilla esihenkilösi tuki.

Osaavat työntekijät ovat meille tärkeä voimavara ja kannustamme henkilöstöämme osaamisen kehittämiseen ja kouluttautumiseen. Meillä työskentelevillä on mahdollisuus kehittää omaa ammattitaitoaan esimerkiksi suorittamalla ammattitutkinto tai sen osia.

Meillä saat myös työterveyshuollon tuen, joka tuo turvaa arkeen. Päätoimisille (20 h/vko tai enemmän) tarjoamme laajemmat palvelut ja osa-aikaisille (alle 20 h/vko) tarjoamme hoitajan sairausvastaanoton. Yli 20 tuntia viikossa työskentelevillä on lisäksi kattava sairaskassa lääkkeisiin, silmälaseihin ja lääkärikäynteihin.

Miten haet meille?

Hakemukset kulkevat meillä vain hakulomakkeen kautta:näin varmistamme reilun pelin ja tietosuojan.Klikkaa itsesihae -painikkeen kauttahakulomakkeelle jakerromeille, mikä tekisisinusta meille sopivan työntekijän.

Miten rekrytointi etenee?

Hakuaika tehtävään päättyy 20.10.,mutta käsittelemme hakemuksia ja etenemme rekrytointiprosessissa jo hakuajan aikana, joten kannattaa toimia nopeasti.Kun rekrytointi etenee seuraaviin vaiheisiin, otamme sinuun yhteyttä joko puhelimitse tai sähköpostitse.Varmuuden vuoksi kannattaa tarkistaa ajoittain myös roskaposti.

Luoteaon kiinteistöalan palveluyritys, joka tarjoaa kokonaisvaltaisia ratkaisuja kiinteistöjen koko elinkaarelle, yhdistäen energiatehokkuuden ja älykkään teknologian. Näin parannamme kiinteistöjen arvoa ja luomme parhaat mahdolliset olosuhteet kiinteistöjen käyttäjille.

title: Tech Implementation - Hospitality.
description:
Who Are We?

Oolio | Bepoz is a leading provider of innovative technology and payments solutions for the hospitality industry across Australia, England and the U.S.A. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction, we have established a reputation for delivering solutions and services that help our clients achieve their goals. From small independent restaurants to large multi-site groups, we help venues run their operations through purpose-built POS platforms. Our Implementation team is the bridge between a signed contract and a venue that's up, running, and confident with their new system. This role is less about plugging in hardware and more about making a complex system work the way a venue actually needs it to. You will take new Bepoz customers from nothing to go live: building their database from scratch, configuring menus and pricing, setting up integrations, and standing next to the team on launch night to make sure everything works. Implementations are where the product promise gets tested. Customers have just committed to a new system and they're counting on you to make it work. When you get it right, venues notice immediately and relationships are formed.

What You Will Be Doing.

You will join a national team of implementation specialists and work closely with field technicians, support staff, and BDMs. The role has real variety: no two venues configure the same way, and the problems you solve on one job rarely look exactly like the last one.

Database Build & Configuration;

  • Build venue databases from the ground up: products, pricing, modifiers, operators, and table layouts.

  • Configure complex menu structures, condiment trees, promotions, and reporting groups.

  • Set up integrations with third-party systems including EFTPOS, reservations platforms, and loyalty programs.

  • Work from discovery information to produce configurations that reflect how .a venue

  • actually operates, not just what fits the template.

Go-Live & On-Site Support;

  • Be on-site for launch, own the go-live, and handle issues in the moment.

  • Validate the build against the venue's real-world trading conditions before the doors open.

  • Provide post-go-live hypercare until the venue is stable and self-sufficient.

Customer Training;

  • Train venue staff and managers on day-to-day system use, reporting, and basic administration.

  • Adapt your delivery to the room. A head chef and a CFO need different explanations of the same feature.

  • Produce clear handover documentation so the venue isn't dependent on you once you've left.

Project Coordination;

  • Manage your own project workload across multiple concurrent implementations.

  • Communicate proactively with customers throughout the project, especially when timelines shift.

  • Work closely with the sales team, field technicians, and support to make sure nothing falls through the cracks at handover.

What We're Looking For.

You Will Need;

  • Hands-on experience implementing or configuring POS systems, ideally Bepoz or Oolio (though other enterprise platforms are worth a conversation).

  • An interest in what's happening behind the scenes of POS and payments tech.

  • Experience building and configuring complex menu or product databases.

  • Strong communication skills across all levels of a venue, from bar staff to ownership.

  • The ability to manage multiple projects at once without things slipping.

  • A current Australian driver's licence.

Bonus points for:

  • A background working in hospitality, whether front of house, back of house, or venue management. You'll understand the pressure of a venue in a way that's hard to teach.

  • Experience with integrations: EFTPOS providers, reservations, loyalty, or kitchen display systems.

  • Exposure to multi-site or group-level rollouts.

  • A degree in Information Technology or a related qualification would be highly regarded.

What do we offer?

  • Work with a strong State led team.

  • The opportunity to develop your skills and earn a base salary plus lucrative commissions. You will also receive a laptop, phone and a car allowance.

  • An inclusive and supportive culture.

  • Great career growth opportunities across Australia and internationally.

  • Free onsite parking in a modern office complex. (Please note our office location may move to North Sydney in 2027)

We will be beginning the recruitment process immediately, so please apply now if role is of this interest to you with your current resume and a short cover letter via the Seek Link.

title: Data Specialist
description:
Location: Dublin1 , Ireland (Hybrid working). The client may require the employee to work on-site, for example, for quarterly team meetings. The employee is expected to attend when reasonably requested. Very occasionally, work outside normal hours may be required. This will be discussed and agreed in advance.

Start Date: 11 th January 2027
Contract Duration: 12 Months, with further Extension, can go up to 3 years

Client Overview:

The IT Data Office forms part of the CIO Division within the Client It is a relatively new section established in Feb 2024. A key element of the IT Data Office mandate is to support the Department’s strategic and day to day data needs in line with the implementation of the Department’s published Data Strategy 2024-2027. The IT Data Office is led by IT Head of Data (Principal Officer) supported by a mixed team of internal staff and contractors. The primary strands of business data needs emerge from the following channels:

  • Business Sections within the Department: Ranging from operational areas (such as inspectorate, payroll and pensions) to policy development (supporting sections implementing education planning and reform agendas e.g. teacher supply, special education, school transport).
  • Education Shared Service Data & Reporting: Ensuring the smooth running of the centralized Education and Training Board (ETB) data platform, meeting the ongoing needs of 16 ETBs’ HR/payroll reporting and extension of the shared service reporting to agreed Higher Education Institutes in line with broader Shared Services Plan.
  • Project Management Office: Where projects may require specific data competency support (these include digital transformation and modernisation projects in areas around collection of data from schools and reducing overall admin burden on schools, parents and teachers).
  • Data Strategy Implementation Program: Specific program of work to progress the goals and action items as set out in the Data Strategy.

Role Overview:

The department is seeking Data Specialist (Intermediate) to lead on, and be responsible for, identifying and remedying technical knowledge gaps associated with our data platforms in particular where there are dependencies, risks and/or loss of critical technical knowledge within the IT Data Office.

The purpose of this role is to strengthen the IT Data Office resilience and continuity of business-critical data services by ensuring that essential technical and operational knowledge is identified, captured and maintained effectively for the broader IT Data Office to leverage. The initial focus will be on the data services in place on Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE) platform however this intention is that scope of role will also extend to the two other Microsoft based platforms. This is a technical role, and it requires the ability to carry out items such as code reviews and tracing technical data lineage via complex data ingestions/ETLs.

The following non exhaustive list sets out key role and responsibilities for the resource:

  • Establishing and maintaining comprehensive documentation of Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)processes supporting the Oracle Data Warehouse
  • Document key source-to-target data flows, including source systems, target tables, transformations, dependencies and processing logic for OBIEE platform but also extending to other platform ingestions.
  • Capture scheduling and orchestration information, including frequency, sequencing, dependencies, triggers and upstream/downstream processes
  • Garnering technical knowledge from subject matter experts, experienced staff and contractors and establishing how critical processes are implemented
  • Establish and maintain run books and operational procedures for business-critical ODI processes to support BAU operational and incident resolution.
  • Leading structured technical knowledge-transfer activities and walkthroughs facilitating knowledge transfer into the Departments IT Data Office team by allowing shadowing and/or holding walk through sessions as part of quarterly team meetings.
  • Producing videos where these provide an effective means of transferring complex technical knowledge

The resource will need to be able to take ownership of assigned responsibilities, demonstrate strong initiative, self-motivation and take a proactive approach to technical problem solving and troubleshooting.

Requirements

Mandatory Requirements (Pass / Fail): Candidates MUST meet ALL of the following:

Experience:

It is a mandatory requirement, that the proposed Data Specialist (Intermediate) has the equivalent experience >4-6 years’ experience as a Data Specialist

Availability:

Must be available to start from 11 th January 2027.

Qualifications:

It is a mandatory requirement, that the Resource proposed has the equivalent of Senior i.e. >4-6 years’ experience as a Data Specialist including experience in the following:

  • Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE)
  • Advanced PL/SQL
  • CEFR C2 Proficiency/Mastery (or equivalent)
  • If there is no certificate, fluency will be assessed at presentation stage

The following non-exhaustive list of Key Deliverables are applicable to this Role.

  • Technical Knowledge Gap Analysis
  • Business Critical Technical Process Runbooks
  • Step-by-Step Technical Operational Guides
  • System and Process Maps
  • Walkthrough and Training Videos
  • Technical Operational Recovery Procedures
  • Incident Reports

The following Experience/Competencies/Skillsets are applicable to this Role for the proposed Resource must clearly and comprehensively demonstrate the resources experience in the four areas set out below.

Tenderers must include examples for each and include visuals as appropriate.

TOTAL 650 MARKS

1. Demonstrate comprehensive practical experience in being able to identify undocumented technical dependencies, complex technical configurations and processes across a variety of data platforms including identification of single points of failure and recommendations for appropriate mitigations.

2. Demonstrate ability and hands on experience in understanding complex technical ETL processes, data transformations/lineage mappings and to translate them into appropriate suites of technical knowledge documentation including use of modern / user-friendly formats such as checklists, video walkthrough, wiki pages, knowledge base to ensure sufficiently clear and practical technical guidance is available and enable knowledge transfer from individuals into sustainable team and organisational knowledge.

3. Demonstrate practical experience in successfully leading and supporting structured technical knowledge transfer activities across teams including experience in validating that technical knowledge has successfully been conveyed and by mentoring and supporting other team members and highlighting areas for future improvements whilst promoting a culture of proactive knowledge sharing across the team.

4. Demonstrate strong capability and technical experience in continuous improvement activities such as identifying opportunities to simplify and standardise complex technical code / processes and reduce dependencies on specialist individuals (for example via automation of repetitive or high-risk activities where appropriate) and ongoing proactive identification of recurring problems/gaps.

title: Software Engineer
description:
We’re working with an innovative Auckland technology company developing advanced systems for the space industry, and we're looking for a Software Engineer to join them on an initial three-month contract.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who loves actually building things. You could be a recent graduate with an impressive university or personal project behind you, or an experienced engineer looking for an interesting short-term challenge. Years of experience aren't the deciding factor, we're looking for capability, enthusiasm and evidence that you can turn an idea into something that works.

The challenge is to bring data from multiple pieces of experimental equipment together into one central interface. Think of a mission-control-style console: numerous signals and instruments feeding into one place where engineers can initiate experiments, monitor what's happening and review the data afterwards.
You'll need to think beyond the screen. Understanding where the data comes from, how the hardware connects and how that information gets into the database and interface will all be part of the challenge.

What you will do
  • Develop a full-stack interface to initiate, monitor and review experimental data
  • Bring multiple data sources and pieces of physical equipment into one central GUI
  • Build the backend and database functionality needed to organise experimental data
  • Rapidly prototype, with the goal of having an initial working GUI within two weeks
  • Work hands-on with engineers and hardware through development, testing and refinement

What we are looking for
  • Strong Python skills, combined with C++ or LabVIEW experience
  • Frontend capability such as Tkinter, Qt, React, web development or similar technologies
  • An understanding of backend development, databases and how data moves between systems
  • A practical, curious mindset and willingness to get hands-on with hardware when required
  • Examples of things you've built – university, personal and commercial projects all count

What’s in it for you
  • Work on unusual technology being developed for applications in the space industry
  • Take genuine ownership of a project and see your software interacting with real hardware
  • Open to graduates through to senior engineers – ability matters more than job titles
  • Build something tangible quickly, then spend the remainder of the contract making it better
  • Join a collaborative engineering environment where enthusiasm and initiative are valued

This is an initial three-month contract based in Onehunga, Auckland. Some technical support will be available, but you'll be trusted to take ownership, investigate problems and work out how to make the system come together.

If you're earlier in your career, don't be put off by the breadth of the role. If you're strong in Python, have built something you're proud of and enjoy figuring out how software interacts with the physical world, we'd be keen to hear from you.

title: Enterprise Architecture Practice Lead
description:
About the role:

You will personally develop material conceptual, target-state and reference architectures, improve the quality and timeliness of architecture decisions, and help create better outcomes for customers, team members and the organisation.

You will set clear direction, connect perspectives from across stakeholder groups, constructively challenge weak decisions and remain accountable for architecture quality and practice outcomes. You will join a developing practice with capable people and established governance foundations, while leading targeted uplift in capability, methods, stakeholder engagement and documentation practices. Your early priority will be to build trust, then use that trust to activate the Technology and Digital Plan through clear, timely and practical architecture decisions.

About the team:
The Strategy and Architecture team connects Unitywater’s business strategies and Technology and Digital Plan with the architecture choices needed to deliver them. The team shapes how business capabilities, information, applications, integration, infrastructure, cyber security, operational technology and emerging technologies work together as Unitywater matures as a digital utility.
What you will do:
  • Collaborate on the activation of the Technology and Digital Plan by developing and facilitating priority architecture decisions, target states and transition roadmaps.
  • Personally lead material or cross-domain enterprise architecture work while directing and assuring work produced by the practice and specialist contractors.
  • Shape initiatives early by clarifying outcomes, capabilities, dependencies, constraints, viable options and whole-of-life implications before material commitments are made.
  • Connect business capabilities, information, applications, integration, infrastructure, cloud, cyber security and operational technology into coherent enterprise-level architectures.
  • Provide architecture leadership across operational technology and integration, bringing information technology and operational technology together securely and reliably. Shape the foundations and practical adoption pathways needed for emerging artificial intelligence capabilities.
  • Act as a key stakeholder in the Architecture Review Board, which reviews high-level architecture designs and decisions, and support effective design assurance and conformance.
  • Develop practical principles, standards, guardrails, reusable patterns, reference architectures and traceable decision records.
  • Lead and develop the Enterprise Architecture Practice, improving capability, methods, stakeholder engagement, documentation quality, work allocation and accountability.
  • Clearly communicate options, risks, costs, benefits, operability, sequencing and lifecycle implications to leaders and governance forums.
  • Identify opportunities to reuse capabilities, simplify the technology environment, reduce duplication and address technical debt and lifecycle risk.

About you:
Our One Unitywater behaviours - Create the Future, Care Together, and Own It – define how we work together at Unitywater. To contribute to this, you will demonstrate the following skills and qualities for the role
What you will need:
  • Substantial senior experience in enterprise or solution architecture within a complex technology environment, including personally developing conceptual, target-state and reference architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy and outcomes into coherent architecture direction, investment choices and practical transition pathways.
  • Strong systems thinking and technical judgement, with demonstrated technical depth in operational technology and integration architecture, including connecting operational and enterprise environments securely and reliably.
  • Experience across information technology and operational technology boundaries, including SCADA or comparable control environments, operational data flows, cyber security, resilience, safety and critical-infrastructure considerations.
  • Applied understanding of artificial intelligence and its architecture implications, including data readiness, integration, security, privacy, governance, operational risk and human oversight. You do not need to be an artificial intelligence engineer, but must be able to assess use cases, shape safe adoption pathways and challenge specialist advice.
  • Proven people leadership experience, including coaching senior technical professionals, setting quality expectations, allocating work and managing performance.
  • Strong influence and communication skills, including facilitating difficult trade-offs and preparing clear recommendations for senior and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience applying architecture principles, standards, patterns and governance proportionately.
  • TOGAF or similar certification, or demonstrated equivalent framework experience.
  • A current C Class Driver’s Licence and ability to travel between Unitywater sites when required.

What will set you apart:
  • A relevant tertiary qualification in technology, engineering, information systems or a related discipline.
  • Experience in water, energy, utilities, regulated critical infrastructure or another asset-intensive environment.
  • Experience using Architecture Review Boards, design authorities, repositories, modelling tools and traceable decision records.
  • Experience presenting architecture strategies, investment recommendations or business cases to executive or Board-level audiences.
  • Relevant professional certification in architecture, operational technology, artificial intelligence, integration, cyber security, cloud, data or technology governance.

Working at Unitywater:
  • Flexibility: We value flexibility and support work-life balance with hybrid and flexible working, purchased annual leave and access to floating public holidays. Tell us what this looks like for you!
  • Wellbeing: We offer several initiatives to support your wellbeing, such as discounted private health insurance, salary packaging, employee assistance program, and access to retailer discounts and benefits.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
This position is National Remote. You'll enjoy the flexibility to telecommute* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

Optum Insight is improving the flow of health data and information to create a more connected system. We remove friction and drive alignment between care providers and payers, and ultimately consumers. Our deep expertise in the industry and innovative technology empower us to help organizations reduce costs while improving risk management, quality and revenue growth. Ready to help us deliver results that improve lives? Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The Billing Analyst is an individual contributor who supports Optum Payment Integrity billing and invoicing operations through a basic, structured, and standard approach to work. The analyst applies established billing procedures, system knowledge, and factual analysis to prepare invoices, maintain revenue reporting, reconcile billing activity, perform quality checks, and address routine billing discrepancies. The role responds to standard requests from internal business partners, provides billing documentation and process guidance, and seeks direction from leadership or cross-functional partners when decisions fall outside established procedures or billing ownership.

This position helps maintain accurate, timely, and controlled billing operations by reviewing source data, researching variances, supporting account and claim corrections, and contributing practical input to billing processes, reports, systems, and procedures.

This position is full time, Monday - Friday. Employees are required to have flexibility to work any of our 8-hour shift schedules during our normal business hours of 8:00 am - 5:00 pm, Monday - Friday.

This will be on the job training and the hours during training will be during normal business hours

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Prepare, modify, and distribute invoices using established billing schedules, controls, and customer requirements.
  • Maintain routine billing and revenue reports, including daily billed activity, month-to-date billed revenue, operational performance reporting, and supporting documentation for stakeholders.
  • Reconcile invoice, claim, revenue, and accounts receivable information; identify discrepancies and apply existing procedures and facts to resolve routine issues.
  • Research billing variances, claim corrections, duplicate activity, processing-log differences, and system-to-system discrepancies using available data and standard controls.
  • Perform quality control reviews of invoices, reports, data entries, integrations, and billing outputs before information is submitted to internal or external customers.
  • Support recurring billing processes such as invoice generation, monthly billing close activities, revenue reconciliation, credit management, and Great Plains integration coordination.
  • Use billing systems, reporting tools, and business applications such as ClinicalPoint, Tableau, Great Plains, Microsoft Excel, and related operational platforms to review data and support billing accuracy.
  • Respond to routine questions and requests from Account Management, Account Coordination, Appeals, Finance, Operations, MCA, and billing team members; provide invoices, reports, process guidance, SOP support, and basic training as appropriate.
  • Gather relevant information from internal partners and escalate or seek guidance when a billing issue requires decisions outside established procedures or billing ownership.
  • Create or maintain trackers, reconciliations, and documentation that strengthen error identification, billing accuracy, process consistency, and operational controls.
  • Use results from billing issue resolution and recurring error analysis to recommend practical corrections or enhancements to billing reports, systems, tools, or processes.
  • Maintain knowledge of applicable billing terminology, policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements, including CMS-related requirements where relevant.

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma / GED
  • Must be 18 years of age OR older
  • 2+ years of billing experience
  • Working knowledge of billing principles, practices, and controls, with the ability to analyze source data, investigate routine billing discrepancies, and apply established procedures to resolve issues.
  • Experience preparing and review invoices, reconcile billing and revenue information, interpret reports, research variances, and communicate findings to business partners while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Experience with Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, etc.)
  • Ability to work full time, Monday - Friday. Employees are required to have flexibility to work any of our 8-hour shift schedules during our normal business hours of 8:00 am - 5:00 pm.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting Itemized Bill Review billing, medical claim workflows, invoice generation, revenue reporting, reconciliations, or billing quality control.
  • Experience with ClinicalPoint, Tableau, Great Plains, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft SharePoint, or comparable billing and reporting tools.
  • Experience creating operational trackers, duplicate reconciliations, error reports, or other controls that improve billing accuracy and process visibility.
  • Experience supporting integrations, invoice numbering, EOP uploads, claim corrections, credits, or other billing process enhancements.
  • Knowledge of CMS requirements and medical, financial, or payment integrity terminology.
  • Experience providing SOP guidance, process documentation, training, or billing support to cross-functional partners

Telecommuting Requirements:

  • Ability to keep all company sensitive documents secure (if applicable)
  • Required to have a dedicated work area established that is separated from other living areas and provides information privacy.
  • Must live in a location that can receive a UnitedHealth Group approved high-speed internet connection or leverage an existing high-speed internet service.

Soft Skills:

  • Ability to manage recurring assignments, meet established deadlines, maintain documentation, and request instruction or guidance when needed.
  • Professional written and verbal communication skills for responding to standard requests, explaining billing findings, and supporting process training.

*All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The hourly pay for this role will range from $24 - $43 per hour based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

Responsibilities

  • Provides oversight relative to all aspects of planning & scheduling for all projects within the Division
  • Provides input to the development of project pursuits including fee proposals, RFP responses, presentation content, etc.

  • Professional Certification in AACEi, PMI, AGC, CMAA, or similar is recommended.
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Develop, implement, and train on standard and project specific cost control procedures in accordance with the Division and/or Business Unit procedures

Salary to be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience of the applicant, as well as the internal equity and alignment with the team.

The pay ranges from $180,000 - $240,000 plus benefits and retirement program.

Gilbane offers an excellent total compensation package which includes competitive health and welfare benefits and a generous profit-sharing/401k plan. We invest in our employees’ education and have built Gilbane University into a top training organization in the construction industry. Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.

Gilbane is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or disability status. title: Service Consultant
description:
Service Consultant – Avant Mutual, Medical IndemnitySydney Full-time Hybrid (50% WFH once trained)
About Avant
Avant is Australia’s leading medical defence organisation with a proud heritage of protecting Australian medical professionals for over 130 years. It was established by a small group of doctors in 1893, who wanted to “protect themselves from actions arising out of the practice of medicine”. Avant now represents 90,000 health practitioners and medical students across every state and territory, delivering market leading products and services to meet their professional, personal and practice needs.Building on this heritage, our vision is to be the most trusted professional partner in supporting doctors throughout their lives and careers. As a mutual organisation, owned by members and run purely for their benefit, our members are at the centre of all we do. As well as providing products and services to our member, we play a broader community role by advocating for improvements in the healthcare system and in quality, safety and professionalism in medicine, through delivering education and research activities.

About the Role
As a Service Consultant, you’ll be the first point of contact for our members, providing consistently superior service across inbound and outbound calls, emails, and written correspondence. You’ll develop strong knowledge of our products, policies, and procedures, giving you a solid foundation for long-term career growth at Avant.Your work will reflect the Avant Values every day:

  • Passion in the way you support our members• Purpose in your commitment to quality• Trust in the accuracy and confidentiality of your work• Courage in identifying improvements and contributing new ideas

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver consistently superior service that exceeds member expectations• Provide high-quality, accurate support across all service channels• Maintain member records with precision and confidentiality• Identify and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives• Being able to work in a team environment but also autonomously• Support team goals and contribute to a positive and collaborative culture• Follow Occupational Health & Safety guidelines and promote a safe workplace• Support and providing excellent service during our peak renewal periods (end of Calander year and end of financial year)

Key attributes we’re looking for
Success in this role comes from collaborating effectively, communicating clearly, and building strong, trusted relationships with a broad range of stakeholders and members.

  • Experience in a customer service–focused role.• While not essential, it will be highly regarded if you also have:• Experience in the general insurance industry, with an understanding of insurance products and market dynamics.• Exposure to a professional membership organisation, particularly in roles involving direct member interaction.

About You
You’ll thrive in this role if you bring:• Experience in a service-focused role with a strong customer-first mindset• Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to quality• Ability to manage sensitive information with discretion• Strong analytical skills and a proactive approach to process improvement• Clear, confident communication and interpersonal skills• Knowledge of OH&S practices (preferred)• Availability for full-time hours (Monday to Friday 8am to 8pm AEST and Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm AWST)

What’s in It for You

  • Hybrid working – enjoy 50% WFH once fully trained• Modern offices with excellent onsite amenities• A supportive, vibrant, and values-driven team• Genuine career growth opportunities within a large medical organisation• The chance to make a meaningful impact supporting Australia’s medical professionals

title: Technical Operations Engineer
description:
Technical Operations Engineer | Must be located in NSW | PowerShell & Automation

Your new company

Our client operates within the healthcare sector, supporting hospitals, pharmacies, correctional facilities and community health services across Australia. They are seeking a Technical Operations Engineer to join their growing team and help deliver a high level of service to customers across NSW.


Your new role

As the Technical Operations Engineer, you will be responsible for the day-to-day operation, support and continuous improvement of a specialist software platform used by customers across NSW.

This is a hands-on technical role, not a people leadership position. The ideal candidate will enjoy solving problems, writing scripts, improving systems and taking ownership of technical issues from investigation through to resolution.

While the role has traditionally been focused on infrastructure and technical operations, it is evolving into something much more. The organisation is building an AI-enabled approach to infrastructure management and support, leveraging automation and data to improve operational outcomes across healthcare environments throughout the state.

You do not need prior AI experience. Instead, we are looking for someone with strong scripting and infrastructure experience who is curious about emerging technologies and excited by the opportunity to learn how AI can be applied to real-world operational environments.

The role is predominantly work from home. However, candidates must be based in Sydney and willing to travel to customer locations throughout NSW when needed.




What you'll need to succeed

  • Strong experience supporting and troubleshooting applications, Windows Server infrastructure, networking, and database environments
  • Advanced PowerShell scripting skills, with the ability to design, develop, maintain and troubleshoot complex automation scripts that improve operational efficiency and system reliability
  • Experience working in complex operational or production environments where automation, scripting and infrastructure management are critical
  • Working knowledge of SQL Server, including the ability to investigate issues, analyse data and perform database troubleshooting
  • Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across applications, infrastructure, networking and customer-facing systems
  • Experience managing support tickets through to resolution while maintaining strong customer communication and stakeholder engagement
  • Interest in AI, automation and emerging technologies, with a desire to contribute to AI-assisted operational processes and infrastructure management capabilities
  • Ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities and deliver outcomes in a remote working environment
  • Comfortable operating in both hands-on technical and customer-facing environments, including occasional customer site visits when required


What you'll get in return

  • Predominantly remote working with flexibility and autonomy
  • Opportunity to work alongside technical leaders who are building next-generation AI-assisted operational environments
  • Exposure to infrastructure automation, scripting and emerging AI technologies
  • A highly varied role spanning infrastructure, applications, scripting, databases and customer environments
  • Opportunity to contribute to the development of AI-driven infrastructure management capabilities
  • Exposure to healthcare and mission-critical technology environments
  • Long-term career growth within a business investing heavily in innovation and technology
  • The ability to make a genuine impact on customer outcomes across hospitals, pharmacies, correctional facilities and community health services throughout Australia


What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to charlie.pym@hays.com.au.

title: Data Visualisation Specialist
description:
We are looking for a strong Tableau Report Developer / Data Visualisation Specialist who can transform complex data into clear, compelling and commercially useful visual stories.

The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, Business Analysts, Product Owners and the Head of Data Analytics to understand reporting needs, interpret data, and design creative dashboards and visualisations that support business decision-making across the financial services environment.

This is not a purely technical report-building role. The ideal candidate must be a data storyteller who understands how to present insights in a way that is visually engaging, commercially relevant and easy for business users to consume.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain high-quality Tableau dashboards, reports and visualisations.
  • Translate business questions and reporting requirements into clear, actionable visual insights.
  • Work with stakeholders to understand the business context behind the data and recommend the best way to visualise it.
  • Partner with Business Analysts and Product Owners to refine requirements, validate data definitions and ensure dashboards meet business needs.
  • Use data from the Snowflake platform to build scalable, accurate and performant reporting solutions.
  • Create visually compelling dashboards that tell a clear story and guide business users toward meaningful insights.
  • Engage with business stakeholders to understand what decisions need to be supported by the data.
  • Apply strong data visualisation principles, including layout, usability, colour, hierarchy, filtering, drilldowns and executive-level storytelling.
  • Ensure reports are accurate, consistent, user-friendly and aligned to agreed business definitions.
  • Optimise Tableau reports for performance and usability.
  • Support the Head of Data Analytics with the delivery of strategic reporting and analytics initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing dashboards, reporting packs and data visualisation standards.
  • Help business users interpret dashboards and understand the insights being presented.
  • Collaborate with data teams to understand source data, data models and reporting limitations.
  • Maintain documentation around reports, metrics, definitions and dashboard usage where required.

Required Experience

  • Proven experience as a Tableau Developer, BI Developer, Data Visualisation Specialist or Reporting Analyst.
  • Strong hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in Tableau.
  • Experience working with cloud data platforms, preferably Snowflake.
  • Strong ability to engage with business stakeholders and translate requirements into visual reporting solutions.
  • Experience working with Business Analysts, Product Owners, Data Analysts and Analytics teams.
  • Strong understanding of data visualisation best practice and dashboard design principles.
  • Ability to interpret data and present it as a meaningful story, not just a static report.
  • Experience working in a commercial, retail, financial services, banking, loyalty, credit, payments or customer analytics environment would be advantageous.
  • Strong SQL skills would be beneficial.
  • Experience working with customer, product, sales, transactional, credit, loyalty or financial services data would be highly advantageous.

Technical Skills

  • Tableau Desktop / Tableau Server / Tableau Cloud
  • Snowflake
  • SQL
  • Dashboard design and visual storytelling
  • Data modelling awareness
  • Data analysis and interpretation
  • Report performance optimisation
  • Data validation and reconciliation
  • Requirements gathering and stakeholder engagement
  • BI / analytics delivery lifecycle

Behavioural Competencies

  • Strong visual and creative thinking
  • Excellent business engagement skills
  • Commercially minded and insight-driven
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Able to simplify complex data
  • Confident communicator
  • Curious and analytical
  • Collaborative and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity
  • Able to challenge requirements constructively and recommend better ways to visualise information

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a creative Tableau developer with strong business-facing experience. They should be able to sit with stakeholders, understand what they are trying to achieve, and then design dashboards that clearly communicate the story behind the data.

They must be comfortable working on a Snowflake-based data platform, collaborating with Business Analysts and Product Owners, and producing reporting outputs that are polished, useful and commercially relevant.

This person should bring a combination of technical Tableau development, data storytelling, visual design thinking and stakeholder engagement.

Advantageous Experience

  • Retail financial services experience
  • Customer analytics
  • Credit, lending, payments or transactional data
  • Loyalty or rewards analytics
  • Retail sales or product performance reporting
  • Executive dashboards
  • KPI and scorecard development
  • Experience in large enterprise data environments
  • Exposure to agile delivery teams

title: IT Integration & Transition Lead
description:
A national, ASX-listed civil construction group has acquired a Brisbane-based civil business of around 200 users. It now needs an experienced on-site lead to bring that business's technology and IT services onto group platforms, standards and support.

This is not a hands-on engineering role or a helpdesk position. Group technical teams and specialist delivery partners will do the engineering. Your job is to own the transition, hold every party to the plan, and leave behind a stable, supportable environment.

The role
  • Build and run one integrated roadmap across ERP (Vista), identity and Microsoft 365, devices, networks, data, security and infrastructure retirement
  • Lead the phased transition of support from the incumbent external provider to the group's internal IT teams, through to a signed-off exit
  • Coordinate testing, cutover, rollback and post go-live stabilisation, protecting payroll, month-end and site operations
  • Work closely with local leadership and staff across finance, payroll, operations, estimating, survey, plant and HSEQ, and earn their trust through visible progress and reliable follow-through
  • Establish clear business ownership of systems, data and process decisions
  • Manage risks, supplier scopes, licensing and costs within group governance
About you
  • You have led an acquisition integration, MSP insourcing or IT service transition before, ideally more than once
  • You plan well, manage dependencies, handle governance and know what a clean cutover and operational handover look like
  • You know Microsoft 365, Entra, Azure, endpoint management, networks and enterprise applications well enough to challenge a delivery plan without doing the build yourself
  • You have managed multiple suppliers against statements of work and acceptance criteria
  • You are credible with site teams and senior leaders alike, and you explain change in plain language
  • Experience in civil construction, infrastructure or Defence-linked environments is highly regarded
Why this one

You'll report directly to the Group CIO, own a clear mandate with a defined finish line, and be the person the business remembers for fixing things.

title: Onboarding Engineer
description:
Salary: $90,000 – $100,000 per year

There's never been a better time to join Virtual IT Group (VITG). We have exciting growth plans, strong market momentum, and an ambitious 12 months ahead. We're proud of the fantastic clients we partner with and the long-term relationships we've built across Australia and New Zealand. From managed services to industry-leading cyber security, our expertise helps organisations thrive, and we're looking for great people to be part of what's next.


As an Onboarding Engineer, you’ll be the first impression that sets our clients up for long-term success. You'll lead the onboarding of newly acquired clients, discovering and documenting their environments, deploying our managed services and security toolsets, remediating risks, and ensuring a seamless handover into ongoing support.

This is a client-facing role for someone who enjoys variety, project work, and solving new challenges. No two days are the same. One day you'll be auditing and onboarding a new environment, the next you'll be coordinating vendors, managing a complex transition, or helping navigate a challenging client situation. Strong people skills are just as important as technical capability, as you'll regularly work with a variety of personalities, stakeholders, and situations.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical onboarding of new clients from contract sign-off through to successful go-live and handover.
  • Audit, discover, and document client environments, including infrastructure, Microsoft 365, networking, backup, and security platforms.
  • Deploy and configure managed services, monitoring, patching, backup, and security tooling to VITG standards.
  • Coordinate onboarding projects, managing timelines, risks, dependencies, vendors, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Build comprehensive documentation and deliver clean handovers to Service Desk and operational teams.
  • Act as the technical face of VITG during onboarding, building trust and delivering an exceptional client experience.
  • Identify and remediate risks, gaps, and non-standard configurations before they become operational issues.


Qualifications & Experience

  • ProvenMSP experience is essential.
  • Strong systems engineering or infrastructure experience across Microsoft 365, Windows Server, networking, virtualisation, and backup technologies.

title: Security Operations Officer – Data Security Specialist
description:
Security Operations Officer – Data Security Specialist

Industry Information Technology and Services

Black & Grey HR is recruiting for an established technology solutions and services provider in Doha, Qatar. Our client is seeking an experienced Security Operations Officer – Data Security Specialist responsible for executing and enhancing security operations, monitoring and responding to threats with a focus on mega sports events and non-event periods. Collaborate across teams to implement effective security measures for information systems.

Key Responsibilities

Data Security Engineering Design and implement data protection controls across enterprise, cloud environments and Artificial Intelligence Solutions. Deploy and manage solutions such as Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data masking, and tokenization. Collaborate with application and infrastructure teams to embed security into data lifecycle management. Implement and manage data discovery and classification tools to identify, categorize, and label sensitive data across the organization. Continously monitor data security posture and produce regular compliance and risk reports. Assist the incident response team in investigating and responding to data security incidents, including insider threats and breaches.

Cloud Data Security

Implement and manage data protection controls in GCP and Azure. Secure databases and data lakes. Configure encryption at rest, in transit, and in use, with BYOK strategies. Deploy cloud-native data discovery and classification solutions. Manage secrets management and ensure secure access to data storage systems. Implement controls for AI data governance.

Cryptography

Define and enforce cryptographic practices and key management standards. Manage enterprise encryption practices for data at rest, in transit, and in use. Ensure compliance with organizational and industry cryptographic standards.

Data Privacy

Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA, PDPPL). Embed privacy‑by‑design principles and requirements into technical controls. Drive data classification and governance programs to safeguard personal and sensitive information.

Database Security

Secure structured and unstructured data repositories, including relational and NoSQL databases. Implement database activity monitoring (DAM) and user access controls. Perform regular security reviews and hardening of database systems.

Collaboration & Governance

Collaborate with other stakeholders on data protection strategies. Ensure compliance with Qatar’s NCSA framework and international standards. Conduct data security assessments for vendors and third‑party integrations. Review and approve data sharing agreements. Define and track data security KPIs and metrics. Maintain data security dashboards for continuous monitoring. Stay current with emerging threats, technologies, and industry best practices.

Requirements8+

years of experience in information security with a focus on data protection, cryptography, and database security. Bilingual (Arabic Speaker) Preferred. Hands‑on experience with cloud platforms, especially GCP and Azure. Strong understanding of encryption standards, cryptographic protocol, and key management processes. Practical experience with secrets management (Hashi Corp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, GCP Secret Manager). Proven expertise in cloud-native data protection across multi‑cloud environments. Experience implementing data masking, tokenization, and anonymization techniques. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or related field. Professional certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CDPSE, or CCSK. Cloud security certifications (GCP, Azure, or AWS Security Specialty) preferred.

Required Skillsets Hands‑on

experience with DLP solutions (Forcepoint, Microsoft Purview, Google Cloud DLP). Implementation of data anonymization, pseudonymization, and masking techniques. Configuration and monitoring of DAM solutions (Imperva, IBM Guardium). Experience with data discovery and classification tools (Forcepoint, Microsoft Purview). Strong knowledge of cryptographic and key management systems (KMS, GCP Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault). Securing relational, NoSQL, and data lake environments. Performing database vulnerability assessments and security audits. Working knowledge of secret management solutions and integration with CI/CD pipelines.

title: Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, Ngành Trò chơi và Ứng dụng, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (tiếng Anh, tiếng Việt)
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
description:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để tăng trưởng trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn lan toả niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng đạt được thành công lớn nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google và khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, tìm hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và dựa vào đó để xây dựng các giải pháp hiệu quả giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu lớn lao nhất. Bạn gặt hái thành công cùng đội ngũ bán hàng, định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo dấu ấn thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Với vai trò là Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, bạn sẽ là người kiến tạo sự tăng trưởng chiến lược, xây dựng mối quan hệ hợp tác đáng tin cậy với các bên liên quan cấp cao để thống nhất về các mục tiêu kinh doanh đầy tham vọng. Bạn sẽ khai thác sức mạnh của AI tạo sinh và phân tích dự đoán để định hướng những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành, mang lại giá trị độc đáo và tối đa hoá tác động nhằm thúc đẩy sự thành công lâu dài của các đối tác. Ở vai trò này, bạn sẽ vận dụng tư duy nhạy bén trong kinh doanh để xác định, định hướng và thu hút khách hàng bằng các giải pháp Hiệu suất dựa trên AI của Google (Tìm kiếm). Bạn sẽ cung cấp dịch vụ khách hàng, nghiên cứu và phân tích thị trường theo chuẩn của Google, đồng thời dự đoán cách đưa ra quyết định, thấu hiểu những điểm khác biệt tinh vi của từng chiến dịch, cũng như không ngừng tìm tòi và khám phá nhu cầu của các lĩnh vực kinh doanh chủ chốt. Cùng với khách hàng, bạn sẽ đặt ra mục tiêu và chiến lược để quảng cáo của họ có thể tiếp cận người dùng một cách hiệu quả nhất.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách chào bán một cách cạnh tranh trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google trên Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên trong nhóm LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh ở vị trí tiên phong của công nghệ, làm việc với ban điều hành, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả rõ rệt, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

  • Duy trì mối quan hệ bền chặt với khách hàng, công ty quảng cáo và các bên liên quan trọng yếu khác để đảm bảo phù hợp với mục tiêu kinh doanh và thúc đẩy hợp tác thành công.
  • Thiết kế và giới thiệu các giải pháp mang tính đột phá, dựa trên dữ liệu (Tìm kiếm dựa trên AI) phù hợp với nhu cầu của khách hàng. Tận dụng kiến thức chuyên sâu về các giải pháp quảng cáo của Google và kỹ năng kể chuyện lôi cuốn để xử lý hiệu quả các ý kiến trái chiều, thu hút đầu tư và vượt chỉ tiêu doanh thu.
  • Chỉ đạo thực thi các sáng kiến chiến lược để thúc đẩy việc áp dụng và tăng doanh thu cho các giải pháp hiệu suất dựa trên AI (trên Mạng Tìm kiếm), từ đó đổi mới hoạt động quảng cáo của khách hàng.
  • Phân tích và tối ưu hoá Lợi tức đầu tư (ROI) tiếp thị bằng cách theo dõi và đánh giá hiệu suất của các chiến dịch dựa trên AI (trên Mạng Tìm kiếm), đưa ra các đề xuất dựa trên dữ liệu để không ngừng cải thiện.
  • Nắm bắt các xu hướng và cải tiến trong ngành tiếp thị kỹ thuật số, cung cấp thông tin chi tiết và đề xuất chủ động để đảm bảo đội ngũ và khách hàng luôn dẫn đầu trong bối cảnh không ngừng thay đổi.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc có kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 8 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực quảng cáo, tư vấn bán hàng hoặc phát triển kinh doanh.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp lưu loát bằng cả tiếng Việt và tiếng Anh để làm việc với các bên liên quan trong nội bộ và hỗ trợ khách hàng nói tiếng Việt.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Có kinh nghiệm thúc đẩy thay đổi và phối hợp với nhiều bên liên quan.
  • Có kinh nghiệm quản lý dự án liên chức năng.
  • Có kinh nghiệm trong ngành trò chơi.
  • Có kinh nghiệm thiết lập mối quan hệ và bán hàng cho các bên liên quan ở cấp điều hành.
  • Am hiểu về các hoạt động và mô hình kinh doanh truyền thông liên chức năng.
  • Kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề xuất sắc.

title: Geriatri, Vantaa Myyrmäki
description:
Me Terveystalossa teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Työllämme on suuri merkitys, ei vain asiakkaillemme, vaan koko yhteiskunnalle. Meitä tärkeimmän tekijöitä on Terveystalossa jo yli 14 000 lähes 400 toimipaikassa eri puolilla Suomea. Siellä, missä ihmiset elävät arkeaan ja missä kotimaista työtämme tarvitaan.

Etsimme nyt Geriatria Vantaan Myyrmäkeen.

Mitä työ Geriatrina Myyrmäessä pitää sisällään?

Myyrmäen yksiköissä pääset pitämään monipuolista potilasvastaanottoa geriatristen asiakkaiden parissa. Työtehtävät koostuvat ajanvarauksellisesta potilasvastaanotosta. Geriatrina työskentelet pääsääntöisesti yksityisasiakkaiden parissa. Työpäivien rakenne, kesto, vastaanottoaikojen pituus ja tarkemmat rajaukset potilasryhmän sisällä ovat täysin räätälöitävissä juuri sinun toiveitasi myötäillen. Työ voidaan sovittaa sinun arkeesi sopivaksi; meillä voit tehdä satunnaista vastaanottotyötä eri toimipisteissä iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin tai esimerkiksi säännöllistä päivätyötä yhdessä yksikössä toiveidesi mukaan.

Tarjoamme yksikössämme asiakkaillemme työterveyspalveluiden lisäksi muun muassa monipuolisia yleislääkäri-, erikoislääkäri- ja laboratoriopalveluita. Yksikkömme sijaitsee hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella Myyrmäen kauppakeskus Myyrmannissa, jonka ansiosta liikkuminen toimipisteeseemme on todella sujuvaa useasta suunnasta myös julkisia kulkuneuvoja käyttäen.

Terveystalossa työskentelee ympäri pääkaupunkiseutua Geriatrien ja muiden asiantuntijoiden tukena myös muistihoitajia. Muistihoitajan tehtäviin kuuluvat erilaisten muistitestien ja toimintakykyarvioiden tekeminen sekä ohjaus-, neuvonta- ja koulutustehtävät. Meillä yksiköissä lääketieteellisen tuen lisäksi työtäsi helpottaa ja tukee oma nimetty lääkäri- ja asiantuntijavastaavasi Johanna. Johanna tukee sinua arkesi suunnittelussa, huolehtii perehdytyksestäsi Terveystaloon, järjestelmiimme ja toimipisteeseen. Hän varmistaa että arkesi on sujuvaa ja voit keskittyä ydinosaamiseesi.

Tarvetta geriatrille löytyy tällä hetkellä Myyrmäen lisäksi myös muista pääkaupunkiseudun yksiköistämme, esimerkiksi Helsingin Kaaresta ja Espoon Leppävaarasta. Voit työskennellä joustavasti osa- tai kokoaikaisesti, työsuhteessa tai ammatinharjoittajana. Autamme sinua tarvittaessa sopivan työskentelymallin valinnassa.

Miksi töihin Terveystaloon?

Me teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Tavoitteenamme on olla inhimillinen työntekopaikka, jossa ammattilainen voi keskittyä olennaiseen. Meillä arki on sujuvaa, välitämme toinen toisistamme ja teemme vaikuttavaa työtä.
- Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Osaajatutkimuksemme mukaan ammattilaisemme arvostavat muun muassa lämmintä työyhteisöämme, hyvää esihenkilötyötä ja lähijohtamista sekä mahdollisuutta onnistua omassa työssä. - Teemme vaikuttavaa työtä. Terveystalossa on ainutkertaista osaamista aina ennaltaehkäisystä perusterveydenhuoltoon, suunterveyteen ja erikoissairaanhoitoon. Käytössämme ovat ainutlaatuiset oman työn laatumittarit ja digitaaliset hoitopolut kaikkiin yleisimpiin sairauksiin. Panostamme myös ammattilaistemme laadukkaaseen kouluttautumiseen, kehittymiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun. - Kotimainen ja vastuullinen. Vastuullisuus on meille sydämen asia. ISS ESG:n arvioinnissa kuulumme globaalisti oman alamme kärkeen, ja Suomalainen työ ry on myöntänyt meille Avainlippu-tunnuksen osoituksena Suomessa tuotetusta ja työllistävästä palvelusta. Teemme työtä suomalaisten terveyden ja koko yhteiskunnan hyvinvoinnin eteen tinkimättömällä ammattitaidolla. Suomen suurimpana yksityisenä terveydenhuoltoalan toimijana vaalimme kotimaisia juuria ja olemme ylpeitä suomalaisista omistajistamme. - Monipuoliset koulutusmahdollisuudet. Tarjoamme osaajillemme omat laadukkaat koulutuksemme, Terveystalon Lääkäripäivät, viikoittaiset Tiedosta taidoksi -koulutukset, eri erikoisalojen omat koulutukset ja Terveystalo Academyn monipuolisen kurssivalikoiman. Meillä voit suorittaa useita eri erityispätevyyksiä sekä pätevöityä ja erikoistua työterveyshuoltoon. Pyrimme tukemaan kouluttautumista myös talon ulkopuolella.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Olethan yhteydessä vastaavaan ura-asiantuntija Topi Manniseen sähköpostitse topi.manninen@terveystalo.com tai puhelimitse 050 408 1001.

Vaikka juuri tämä tehtävä ei olisi sinulle ajankohtainen, ole rohkeasti yhteydessä. Keskustelen mielelläni myös muista mahdollisuuksista työskennellä lääkärinä Terveystalolla.

Voit myös jättää yhteystietosi hakulomakkeen kautta niin olen sinuun yhteydessä.
