title: Vice President, Product Management (Endpoint Security)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Vice President, Product Management (Endpoint Security) based in United States.

As Vice President of Product Management, you will define and execute the strategy for a complex Endpoint Security portfolio, shaping its evolution, market position, and commercial performance.
You will own the full product lifecycle, from investment and development through launch, adoption, optimization, and portfolio evolution.
The role combines deep cybersecurity expertise with product leadership, financial ownership, technical strategy, and go-to-market execution.
You will guide a global team of Product Managers while collaborating closely with Engineering, Security Research, Managed Services, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Finance.
A major focus will be identifying new market opportunities, cross-sell potential, product integrations, and growth initiatives that strengthen the broader security platform.
You will represent the Endpoint Security strategy with executive leaders, customers, partners, industry analysts, and other external stakeholders.
This is a high-impact leadership opportunity in a fast-growing cybersecurity environment where innovation, customer outcomes, and measurable business results are central to success.

Accountabilities:

  • Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership: Own the complete lifecycle of the Endpoint Security portfolio, including strategy, investment decisions, development, launch, adoption, optimization, portfolio evolution, acquisitions, and integration.
  • Financial Ownership: Own financial targets for the Endpoint Security product line and develop strategies that support sustained revenue growth and improved commercial performance.
  • Positioning & Go-to-Market: Define portfolio positioning, pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategies in partnership with Product Marketing and Sales, supporting both new customer acquisition and expansion within the existing customer base.
  • Growth & Revenue Expansion: Develop cross-functional strategies to improve product performance, identify new revenue streams, and expand cross-sell opportunities, with a strong focus on net-new business.
  • Market & Competitive Strategy: Monitor the Endpoint Security competitive landscape, assess market trends and opportunities, build business cases for new products, and develop strategies for integrating additional Endpoint capabilities.
  • Technical Product Leadership: Guide strategic decisions involving endpoint agents, prevention and behavioral detection, EDR telemetry, response capabilities, operating-system architecture, performance, reliability, and false-positive management.
  • Platform Integration: Define how Endpoint Security capabilities integrate with the broader security platform and managed services, ensuring they improve analyst workflows, detection and response outcomes, and the overall customer experience.
  • Product Performance: Establish and manage success metrics covering protection efficacy, product quality, deployment and adoption, customer health, satisfaction, retention, and commercial performance.
  • Product Operating Model: Establish an effective cadence for product discovery, delivery, launches, and ongoing performance management, translating portfolio strategy into clear priorities, roadmaps, resource recommendations, and measurable outcomes.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and mentor a high-performing global team of Product Managers while fostering accountability, collaboration, innovation, and strong execution.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the accountable product leader across Engineering, Security Research, Managed Services, Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Finance.
  • Executive & External Representation: Communicate Endpoint Security strategy and business performance to executive leadership, customers, industry analysts, partners, and other external stakeholders.
  • Innovation & Market Expansion: Identify opportunities for innovation, explore new market segments, and develop initiatives that strengthen the product portfolio and support long-term growth.
  • M&A Support: Contribute to acquisition evaluations through strategic analysis and help guide the integration of acquired Endpoint capabilities.
  • Business Planning: Participate in quarterly business reviews, industry forums, events, and other strategic business activities while maintaining clear visibility into portfolio performance.
  • Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships across complex stakeholder groups, manage conflict constructively, and drive alignment toward shared business and product outcomes.

    • Requirements

    • Cybersecurity Expertise: Significant experience in cybersecurity with extensive knowledge of the Endpoint Security market, including industry trends, competitors, emerging technologies, and market opportunities.
    • Endpoint Product Experience: Demonstrated ownership of a technically complex Endpoint Security product through multiple lifecycle stages, including strategy, development, launch, scaling, operational challenges, and portfolio evolution.
    • Growth Environment: Proven success in high-growth organizations, with experience navigating changing market conditions and executing strategies that deliver exceptional business growth.
    • Technical Depth: Strong understanding of endpoint agents, prevention and behavioral detection, EDR telemetry, response capabilities, operating-system architecture, performance, reliability, and false-positive management.
    • Cloud & Security Knowledge: Strong technical and business understanding of cybersecurity platforms and the broader technologies and services surrounding endpoint protection.
    • Business Acumen: Strong experience developing business cases for new products and strategic initiatives, with the ability to connect product decisions to financial and commercial outcomes.
    • Strategic Product Leadership: Ability to translate business and portfolio strategies into product priorities, roadmaps, resource allocation recommendations, operating models, and measurable results.
    • People Leadership: Experience leading, mentoring, and developing global, cross-functional product teams, with a demonstrated ability to create high-performing and collaborative environments.
    • Cross-Functional Influence: Ability to drive meaningful outcomes across Engineering, Security Research, Managed Services, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, Finance, and other organizational functions.
    • Executive Communication: Strong communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to engage effectively with senior executives, customers, partners, analysts, and other external stakeholders.
    • Emotional Intelligence: High EQ, strong conflict-management capabilities, and a collaborative approach to navigating complex stakeholder relationships.
    • Innovation Mindset: Ability to identify new market opportunities, challenge existing approaches, and drive innovation in a rapidly evolving cybersecurity environment.
    • Customer Focus: Strong understanding of customer needs and the ability to connect product strategy with customer satisfaction, retention, adoption, and measurable security outcomes.

      • Benefits

      • Equity: Equity participation available to all employees.
      • Flexible Time Off: Flexible paid time off along with paid volunteer days.
      • Retirement Benefits: RRSP and 401(k) matching programs.
      • Healthcare Coverage: Comprehensive private benefits including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life, and AD&D coverage, along with additional value-added services.
      • Employee Assistance: Robust Employee Assistance Program with access to mental health services.
      • Family Benefits: Fertility support and paid parental leave.
      • Professional Development: Training and career development programs supporting continued learning and career growth.
      • Work Arrangement: Remote opportunities in the United States and Canada, with hybrid options also available in select locations.
      • Leadership Impact: Executive-level ownership of a strategically important cybersecurity product portfolio with direct influence on growth, innovation, and market positioning.
      • Collaborative Environment: Opportunity to work with global, cross-functional teams spanning product, engineering, security research, managed services, sales, marketing, customer success, and finance.
      • Inclusive Culture: A collaborative workplace that values diverse perspectives, inclusion, accessibility, and employee participation.

title: Lead Specialist: Data Quality and Master Data Management
description:
Empowering Africa's tomorrow, together...one story at a time. With over 100 years of rich history and strongly positioned as a local bank with regional and international expertise, a career with our family offers the opportunity to be part of this exciting growth journey, to reset our future and shape our destiny as a proudly African group. Belonging at Absa. Absa is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from suitably qualified individuals from diverse backgrounds. In support of our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) commitments and Employment Equity objectives, preference may be given to candidates from underrepresented designated groups, including persons with disabilities. We encourage applicants who may require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process to let us know so that appropriate support can be provided.

Key Focus Areas

  • Data quality rule definition and implementation.
  • Data quality monitoring and reporting.
  • Data quality issue identification, logging and remediation.
  • Root cause analysis of recurring data quality failures.
  • Customer Master Data Management support.
  • Critical Data Element quality improvement.
  • Data profiling, validation and exception management.
  • Business rule documentation and evidence management.
  • Stakeholder engagement with business, technology, risk and data teams.
  • Governance reporting on data quality and MDM progress.

Key Accountabilities

  • Define, document and maintain Data Quality rules in partnership with Data Owners, Data Stewards, business teams and technology stakeholders.
  • Monitor data quality results, trends and exceptions across priority data domains, with a strong focus on customer data.
  • Identify, log, track and report data quality issues from detection through to remediation and closure.
  • Conduct root cause analysis to identify process, system, control or ownership gaps causing poor data quality.
  • Support Customer MDM implementation and adoption, including data validation, matching, survivorship, issue management and business readiness.
  • Work with business and technology teams to ensure remediation actions address the underlying cause and not only the symptoms.
  • Support the definition and monitoring of Critical Data Elements, including thresholds, rules, controls and ownership.
  • Prepare regular Data Quality and MDM reports for governance forums, risk committees and management updates.
  • Maintain accurate evidence of Data Quality controls, issue remediation, approvals and decisions.
  • Contribute to the implementation of Data Management standards, policies and operating procedures.

Operational Effectiveness

  • Improve the completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency and timeliness of priority data.
  • Ensure data quality issues are tracked clearly, escalated appropriately and resolved within agreed timelines.
  • Support the reduction of recurring data defects by addressing root causes at source.
  • Strengthen monitoring routines through dashboards, scorecards and exception reporting.
  • Drive clear accountability for data quality outcomes across business and system ownership areas.
  • Support automation of data quality checks and reporting where possible.
  • Ensure Customer MDM activities are aligned to business priorities, risk requirements and operational readiness.

Good Governance

  • Promote adherence to Data Quality, Master Data and Data Governance standards.
  • Ensure Data Quality rules, thresholds, issues and remediation plans are approved and evidenced.
  • Maintain clear audit trails for Data Quality monitoring, root cause analysis and remediation decisions.
  • Support governance forums with accurate reporting on data quality performance, risk exposure and MDM progress.
  • Escalate material data quality issues, unresolved root causes and ownership gaps through the appropriate governance channels.
  • Contribute to improved regulatory reporting, customer data confidence and business decision-making through trusted data.

Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with Data Owners, Data Stewards and business teams to define rules, validate issues and agree remediation actions.
  • Work closely with Technology, Architecture and MDM teams to resolve system and data integration issues.
  • Engage Risk, Compliance, Operations, Finance and Reporting teams to understand downstream impacts of poor data quality.
  • Facilitate working sessions to investigate root causes, agree ownership and unblock remediation.
  • Provide clear guidance to stakeholders on data quality expectations, evidence requirements and control responsibilities.
  • Build trusted relationships by being structured, responsive and solution-oriented.

Qualifications and Education

Relevant diploma or degree. Certification in Data Quality, Master Data Management, Data Governance, DAMA, Information Management or Data Analytics would be advantageous.

Field of Study

  • Data Management
  • Data Governance
  • Information Management
  • Information Systems
  • Computer Science
  • Data Analytics
  • Business Analysis
  • Risk Management or Compliance
  • Business Administration

Work Experience

  • 5 - 8 years' experience in Data Quality, Master Data Management, Data Governance, Business Analysis, Data Analytics, Reporting or Information Management.
  • Experience defining and implementing data quality rules, controls, thresholds and monitoring routines.
  • Experience with data quality issue management, root cause analysis and remediation tracking.
  • Solid exposure to Customer MDM, customer data, golden source concepts, matching, deduplication or master data controls.
  • Experience working with Critical Data Elements and business rules would be advantageous.
  • Experience preparing data quality dashboards, governance reports, scorecards or management updates.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment, preferably financial services or banking, would be advantageous.
  • Experience using tools such as Ataccama, Informatica, Microsoft Purview, SQL, Power BI, Excel, SharePoint or similar platforms would be beneficial.

Competencies

  • Strong understanding of Data Quality and Master Data Management principles.
  • Good analytical and root cause analysis capability.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to interpret data quality results and translate findings into practical remediation actions.
  • Good understanding of controls, governance, evidence and risk management.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and facilitation skills.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on actions.
  • Structured, disciplined and process-oriented approach.
  • Comfortable working across business, technology, risk and governance teams.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and SharePoint.
  • Experience with Data Quality, MDM, SQL or reporting tools would be advantageous.

Education

Bachelor's Degrees and Advanced Diplomas: Business, Commerce and Management Studies.

title: Marine Personnel Training & Career Development Specialist (Engine)
description:
Job Summary and Purpose Handle and manage all activities related to seafarers’ professional development, career progression, and certification compliance.

Key Accountabilities

  • Conduct comprehensive Training Needs Analysis (TNA) for all seafarer ranks and roles.
  • Maintain a training matrix covering STCW, company-mandated, and computer-based training (CBT).
  • Develop and maintain individual training plans for each seafarer, ensuring alignment with regulatory and operational requirements.
  • Coordinate with internal departments and external training providers to schedule and deliver training programs.
  • Monitor training completion and certification validity, ensure timely renewals and compliance.
  • Design and implement a structured cadet mentorship framework to support the professional growth of cadets onboard.
  • Track cadet progress against training objectives and onboard assessments.
  • Design and implement career progression paths for all seafarer ranks, ensure transparency and alignment with company policies.
  • Track seafarer progress through career stages and maintain up-to-date records of qualifications and experience.
  • Manage the promotion process, including: Monitoring eligibility based on predefined criteria. Maintaining and updating promotion waiting list. Coordinating with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely and fair promotions.
  • Provide career counseling and debriefings to seafarers’ post-deployment, offer guidance on development opportunities.
  • Oversee the appraisal process for all seafarers:Ensure timely submission of appraisal reports after each tour. Review and assess appraisal content for accuracy and consistency. Identify training needs or performance gaps highlighted by Masters and Chief Engineers.
  • Manage the annual performance cycle:Consolidate appraisal scores. Collaborate with department heads to finalize year-end performance ratings. Support the reward and recognition process based on performance outcomes.
  • Assess and approve external training centers to ensure alignment with STCW, flag state, and company-specific standards.
  • Conduct periodic evaluations of training providers for quality, relevance, accreditation status, and instructor competency.
  • Maintain a vetted list of approved training centers and ensure seafarers are enrolled only in compliant institutions.
  • Liaise with training providers to address feedback, resolve issues, and implement improvements where necessary.
  • Conduct vessel visits (including sailing visits) to evaluate and enhance the effectiveness of onboard training, mentorship, and career development practices.
  • Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of the Fleet Officer Meeting, including agenda setting, logistics, and event management.
  • Gather feedback from seafarers and vessel leadership during visits to inform continuous improvement of training and development programs.
  • Support additional Marine Personnel Department (MPD) initiatives and tasks as required, contributing to departmental goals and operational excellences.

Qualifications, Experience and Job Skills

Qualifications, Experience and Job Skills Qualifications:CoC STCW A-III/2. Experience:A minimum of 48 months sailing experience on Tankers, out of which minimum 6 at a Management Level Position (Chief/Second Engineer). Familiarity with maritime regulations, certification systems, and training practices. Job Specific Skills:Training Program Design & Delivery, Training Needs Analysis (TNA), Career Pathway Development, Performance Management, Data Management & Reporting, Mentorship, Briefing & Debriefing, Stakeholder Coordination, Event & Program Management, Regulatory Compliance, Communication & Advisory. Expertise in developing and managing training programs aligned with STCW, company-specific, and computer-based learning requirements. Familiarity with maritime training standards, including IMO Model Courses and flag state requirements. Ability to assess individual and departmental training needs using structured analysis tools and performance data. Skill in designing structured career progression frameworks for all seafarer ranks. Experience in managing promotion pipelines and maintaining promotion eligibility records. Proficiency in managing appraisal systems, analyzing performance data, and aligning outcomes with training and reward strategies. Strong capability in maintaining accurate training, certification, and performance records. Ability to conduct effective debriefings and provide career guidance to seafarers, including cadets and junior officers. Skills in organizing and managing events such as Fleet Officer Meetings, training sessions, and career development workshops. In-depth knowledge of STCW, MLC, and flag state regulations related to seafarer training, certification, and career development. Strong interpersonal and communication skills to engage with seafarers, vessel leadership, and management on development matters.

Job Requisition ID:167437

Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world’s most admired and innovative brands. Overview of the role:
Business Analystassesses Al-Futtaim Logistics divisions, improving processes and systems. They analyze business problems and develop solutions for businesses and clients. Strong analytical thinking, communication skills, and an understanding of business objectives are essential. The role involves extracting data from logistics platforms to provide insights that enhance cost efficiency, utilization, productivity, and customer experience. Analysts must have a deep understanding of operations and be able to transform raw data into meaningful visuals. Their insights drive business growth and efficiency.

What you will do:

Feasibility Studies / Business Cases / Logistics Study Reports on Expansion Plans:

  • Support the business and management in expansion plans and new projects based on strategic directives. Coordinate with the operations team to collect the required input, analyze data, and prepare business cases for review and decision-making.
  • Monitor job-wise margins in the system against estimated costs. Establish periodic monitoring and escalation procedures for jobs where actual profitability falls below the desired level, ensuring timely corrective action.
  • Develop new logistics products based on emerging business activities, new verticals, and expansion plans in collaboration with division heads.

Process Review and Improvement:

  • Review current operational processes and recommend improvements. Implement process enhancements in consultation with business and operations teams, monitor progress, and maintain a tracker for future reference and audits.

Business Analytics & MIS:

  • Facilitate the achievement of business goals by providing relevant MIS, analytical support, and operational analysis required by various business units. Experience in developing BI reports is essential for compiling operational reports.
  • Consolidate reports from various operations and circulate them to management. Issue monthly reports highlighting operational results and analyzing performance.
  • Review operational processes to ensure effective controls, accurate financial transactions, and timely MIS reporting for strategic decision-making.
  • Conduct regular site visits to identify cost-saving opportunities related to operational efficiencies and resource utilization (consumables, personnel, assets). Report findings to management for review and decision-making.

Required Skills To Be Successful:

  • Strong team player with experience interacting with senior stakeholders and delivering measurable results in cost benefits, revenue growth, or efficiency gains.
  • Proven ability to analyze complex data and translate it into actionable insights using MIS tools.
  • Expertise in predictive and preventive data modeling using advanced tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, Tableau, SQL, Python, and Alteryx.
  • Deep business understanding to develop reports and operational knowledge for effective analysis.

About The Team:

The role reports to the Head of Customer Solutions and Marketing. You will be working in a fast-paced supply chain environment in Jebel Ali Free Zone, interacting with multiple internal and external stakeholders.

What Equips You For The Role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, or Computer Science.
  • At least three years of proven experience in data analysis and reporting using Power BI or similar business intelligence tools (Power Query).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to derive insights from complex datasets.
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and data modeling techniques is a plus.
  • Experience with data visualization best practices and dashboard design.

About Al-Futtaim Automotive
A major division of the UAE-based Al-Futtaim Group of companies,Al-Futtaim Automotiveis an industry leader with presence in 10 countries across the Middle East, Asia and Africa.
Our core business activities at Al-Futtaim Automotive include distribution, manufacturing, leasing and aftersales, and we are firmly established as the regional representative of some of the world’s most iconic automotive brands: Toyota, Lexus, Honda, Jeep, Chrysler, Dodge, Volvo and RAM.
We are driven by a customer-centric approach, constantly pushing the boundaries on innovation, quality standards, and value-added service across our vast universe of customers – right from motoring enthusiasts to fleet operators to contractors. Our mission is to become the leader in custom-made mobility solutions by delivering nothing less than world-class omni-channel experiences.
We channel our local expertise and global trust to deliver one of the most comprehensive portfolios of mobility products and solutions, from passenger cars to SUVs, electric vehicles to high-performance motorbikes, commercial vehicles to industrial & construction equipment.
What keeps the company moving forward is a 9000-member strong team, with inspiring possibilities for growth, throughout the career path.This is Al-Futtaim Automotive and we empower talent to move forward.

description:

Valkeakosken kampussairaalan akuuttiosasto on tällä hetkellä 36-paikkainen, kolmen lääkärin osasto, jossa tavallisimpia hoitoon tulon syitä ovat erilaiset infektiot, pitkäaikaissairauksien pahenemisvaiheet sekä pienten vammojen jatkohoito. Usein potilaan tilannetta täytyy tutkia tarkemmin vielä osastolle tulon jälkeen, ja käytettävissäsi ovat hyvin toimivat laboratorio- ja kuvantamispalvelut. Keskimääräinen hoitoaika osastolla on viime aikoina ollut noin 10 päivää. Tarvittaessa voit kerryttää yleislääketieteen ja geriatrian palvelua tässä tehtävässä.

Lääkärin työnkuva osastolla on monipuolinen, ja työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:
potilaiden kliininen tutkimus ja sairauksien diagnostiikka
potilaan kokonaisvaltaisen hoidon suunnittelu ja toteuttaminen
toimintakyvyn ja kokonaistilanteen arviointi sekä mahdolliset hoidonlinjaukset
pientoimenpiteet osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan
turvallisen kotiutumisen varmistaminen ja jatkohoidon suunnittelu

Kelpoisuusehtona on Suomessa laillistetun lääkärin pätevyys ja riittävä kokemus soveltuvalta alalta tai erikoislääkärin oikeudet soveltuvalta alalta. Lisäksi edellytämme hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Eduksi luetaan kokemus perustason osastotyöstä. Arvostamme asiakaslähtöistä ajattelutapaa, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kehittämismyönteisyyttä.

Lisätietoja
Voit aloittaa tehtävässä 1.3.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Noudatamme kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.
Työ on kokoaikaista päivätyötä, ja säännöllinen työaika on 38 tuntia 15 minuuttia viikossa.
Valitulla tulee olla voimassa tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 §:n mukainen rokotesuoja ja 55 §:n mukainen hengityselinten tuberkuloosia koskeva selvitys.
Lisäksi tehtävään valitun on esitettävä vaadittavat todistukset terveydentilastaan kuukauden sisällä työn aloittamisesta.

Hyvinvointialue tarjoaa erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kouluttautua, kehittyä ammatillisesti ja rakentaa oman näköistäsi työuraa. Jätä hakemuksesi ja tule mukaan tekemään merkityksellistä työtä pirkanmaalaisten terveyden hyväksi. Toivotamme sinut lämpimästi tervetulleeksi osaksi työyhteisöämme.

  • Functional Frontend Skills: Enough React / Next.js / TypeScript knowledge to productively work inside an existing frontend codebase.

title: Onsite ICT Officer – Service Desk Support
description:
Salary: Rare PT opportunity: 3-day onsite tech support

Onsite ICT Officer – Service Desk Support

Part-time – three days per week | Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday | Melbourne CBD | Onsite

  • Provide hands-on technology support in a collaborative, purpose-led organisation.
  • Build practical experience across Windows 11, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft 365, and cyber security monitoring.
  • Join a welcoming workplace focused on helping Australians retire with dignity, security, and confidence.

Who we are

Industry Fund Services (IFS) is a leading provider of specialist services to the profit-to-member superannuation sector. Our purpose is to help Australians retire with dignity, security, and confidence. We use our deep expertise, innovative thinking, collective ownership, and scale to empower our partners, keeping members at the heart of everything we do.

The opportunity

We are looking for a practical, service-focused Onsite ICT Officer to join our Technology team on a part-time basis, working onsite every Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Reporting to the Technology and Security Lead, you will be the friendly, hands-on point of support for our Melbourne office, helping employees resolve technology issues and ensuring devices, workstations, mobile equipment, and meeting-room technology operate as intended.

You will also work closely with our remote service desk to progress logged issues and support timely resolution. This is a varied role that offers exposure to device management, software administration, vulnerability management, and security monitoring in a supportive professional environment.

What you will do

  • Respond to onsite technology and hardware issues and provide a helpful, responsive experience for employees.
  • Liaise with the remote service desk to follow up outstanding tickets and support timely resolution.
  • Set up and maintain end-user workstations, laptops, mobile devices, and meeting-room audio-visual equipment.
  • Prepare and deploy laptops, including building the standard operating environment through Microsoft Intune.
  • Undertake device audits and reconciliations using Microsoft Intune.
  • Provide administration support across a range of software-as-a-service applications.
  • Support oversight of endpoint vulnerability management activities delivered by our managed service provider.
  • Monitor threat detection alerts in the security information and event management system and ensure flagged incidents are followed up promptly.
  • Build strong working relationships with employees, service desk colleagues, vendors, and other technology partners.
  • Work in accordance with IFS technology security, governance, and workplace policies.

About you

You are approachable, organised, and motivated by helping people. You can communicate technical information clearly, follow established processes, manage competing priorities, and remain calm when resolving issues under time pressure. You will also bring:

  • Experience supporting Windows 11 in a professional environment.
  • A sound understanding of corporate network configuration and cyber security principles.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to build rapport with end users.
  • Good organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines.
  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Office skills, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • A Bachelor of Computer Science or a similar qualification, current study towards a relevant qualification, or other relevant technical education.

Experience with Microsoft Intune and Active Directory will be highly regarded. Exposure to the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 administration portals will also be an advantage.

The Perks of Working Here

  • Work-life balance: Enjoy a predictable three-day working week, Tuesday to Thursday.
  • Inclusive Culture: Diverse, collaborative, values-driven
  • Purpose-Driven Work: Contribute to helping people retire with secure, confident futures
  • Competitive package: Salary, superannuation, and annual leave loading
  • Generous Leave: Extra paid time off over Christmas / New year + Paid parental leave
  • Wellbeing Focus: EAP access & a strong commitment to employee wellbeing
  • Prime Location: Modern CBD office directly above Melbourne Central Station, with free snacks and barista-style coffee to keep you fueled

You must have unrestricted working rights in Australia to apply.

This role is based in Melbourne and requires you to work onsite at our office near Melbourne Central Station on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday each week.

If you are looking for a hands-on, people-focused ICT support role where you can broaden your technical experience and make a meaningful contribution, we would love to hear from you. Please

apply with your current résumé.

IFS is an equal opportunity employer and supports diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

Employment offers are subject to the satisfactory completion of relevant background checks, including reference checks, confirmation of the right to work in Australia, and other checks appropriate to the role.

description:
The opportunity

As Medical Lead, Breast Cancer within US Oncology Medical Affairs, you will serve as a medical and scientific leader for the breast cancer portfolio, including the ADC franchise. You will lead the development, alignment and execution of the US medical strategy, provide medical leadership to the Core Medical Team, and partner across US and global functions to translate scientific priorities into meaningful outcomes for patients, healthcare professionals and the broader healthcare ecosystem.

This is an opportunity for an experienced physician or doctorate-level medical affairs leader who combines deep oncology expertise with strong business acumen, launch experience and the ability to influence across complex, cross-functional networks.

Why join us

  • Meaningful patient impact: help shape evidence, education and medical strategy in breast cancer, with patient needs at the center of decisions.
  • Science with scale: work across an innovative Oncology portfolio and collaborate with leading internal experts, external scientific leaders, academic institutions, professional societies, advocacy organizations, payers and providers.
  • Leadership with ownership: set direction, make evidence-based decisions, lead through influence and take accountability for high-impact medical plans, launches and investments.
  • Growth and development: expand your expertise through cross-functional and global collaboration, exposure to the product lifecycle, and opportunities to mentor Medical Affairs colleagues.
  • Inclusive, collaborative culture: join a team that values diverse perspectives, constructive challenge, curiosity and speaking up.
  • A connected scientific campus: work on-site in Gaithersburg, a major US R&D and Oncology campus designed to encourage collaboration and cross-functional science.

What you will do

  • Lead US Medical Affairs activities for breast cancer and provide medical leadership to the Core Medical Team.
  • Contribute to integrated medical plans and translate strategic imperatives into clear, measurable tactics for the disease area and brands.
  • Own the alignment and execution of medical plans, launch plans, resources and budgets in partnership with US commercial, global and functional teams.
  • Ensure the medical accuracy, scientific integrity and fair balance of promotional, medical information and learning materials for internal and external audiences.
  • Shape evidence-generation priorities with global partners, including medical evidence plans, Externally Sponsored Scientific Research, HEOR studies and outcomes research.
  • Build trusted peer relationships with external scientific experts, academic institutions, professional societies, advocacy organizations, payer and provider groups.
  • Lead or contribute to national and regional advisory boards, congress activities, scientific exchange and speaker training.
  • Provide medical input to product safety in collaboration with Patient Safety physicians.
  • Partner closely with Medical Science Liaisons and National Clinical Account Managers to support key accounts appropriately.
  • Align the US strategy with the Global Medical Affairs Leader and other global stakeholders.
  • Guide and mentor Medical Affairs colleagues, sharing expertise and raising scientific and strategic capability across the team.

What you bring

Essential requirements

  • Doctorate degree in Medicine (MD or DO), PhD, PharmD or equivalent, with relevant experience.
  • At least 5 years of related experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, clinical practice or a research institution.
  • 1-3 years in Headquarters base Medical Affairs role
  • 1-3 years of experience supporting oncology in a country, regional or global organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute medical strategy, work across the product lifecycle and support launch planning.
  • Strong business acumen
  • Proven ability to collaborate productively with scientific, medical, commercial, market access and other cross-functional partners.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-influence skills.
  • Ability to travel nationally and internationally up to approximately 10%.

Desirable requirements

  • Direct experience in breast cancer
  • Proven understanding of FDA requirements
  • Knowledge of relevant professional societies and established relationships with scientific and medical experts.
  • Experience with pharmaceutical drug development, evidence generation, HEOR and medical/scientific affairs.

About our Gaithersburg campus

Our Gaithersburg, Maryland campus is a major home for R&D and Oncology in the US, located near Washington, DC. The modern scientific environment brings together specialists, technology and collaborative workspaces to support cross-functional science. Site amenities include a fitness center, employee healthcare clinic, electric vehicle charging stations, a full-service cafeteria, dry cleaning and activity-based workspaces designed for different working styles.

Compensation and benefits

The annual base pay range for this position is $193,281 - $289,922 USD. Hourly and salaried non-exempt employees will also be paid overtime pay when working qualifying overtime hours. Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition, our positions offer a short-term incentive bonus opportunity; eligibility to participate in our equity-based long-term incentive program (salaried roles), to receive a retirement contribution (hourly roles), and commission payment eligibility (sales roles).

Benefits offered included a qualified retirement program [401(k) plan]; paid vacation and holidays; paid leaves; and, health benefits including medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans.

Additional details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base pay (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Ready to make a meaningful impact?

If you are energized by scientific challenge, motivated by the opportunity to improve outcomes in breast cancer, and ready to lead across medical, commercial and global partnerships, we would welcome your application.

description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an exceptionally skilled and experienced Senior Databricks Specialist / Data Architect to join Marc Ellis on a 12-month extendable contract basis (long-term under Marc Ellis payroll) in Doha, Qatar. In this critical enterprise data leadership role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-scale data platforms using Microsoft Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, and Delta Lake architectures. The ideal candidate will bring 8+ years of experience in data engineering and architecture, at least 4+ years of strong hands-on Azure Databricks expertise, and deep technical familiarity with Unity Catalog and Medallion Architecture. If you possess a distinguished background in big data platform engineering and multi-system integration, we invite you to apply.

Detailed Job Description

As a Senior Databricks Specialist / Data Architect at Marc Ellis in Doha, Qatar, you will serve as the principal technical authority responsible for architecting, governing, and scaling the organization’s enterprise data platform and its integration with Dynamics 365 CRM and other core enterprise systems. Your daily responsibilities will encompass designing robust data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, implementing Delta Lake storage layers, configuring Unity Catalog governance and access controls, and driving performance tuning and cost optimization on Azure Databricks. You will troubleshoot complex production data issues and collaborate with engineering teams to automate CI/CD deployments via Azure DevOps.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, architect, and optimize enterprise-scale data platforms using Microsoft Azure Databricks.
  • Build and scale high-performance data pipelines and processing frameworks using Apache Spark and PySpark.
  • Architect and manage Delta Lake storage layers and implement Databricks Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
  • Implement enterprise data governance, access control, and data lineage tracking using Unity Catalog.
  • Integrate Azure Databricks seamlessly with APIs, enterprise applications, Dynamics 365 CRM, and auxiliary data sources.
  • Design and maintain robust cloud data infrastructure using Azure Data Factory and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.
  • Apply advanced data modeling, dimensional modeling, and data quality standards across large enterprise datasets.
  • Drive continuous performance optimization, cost reduction, and query tuning on Databricks clusters.
  • Build automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, version control workflows, and infrastructure as code using Azure DevOps and Git.
  • Troubleshoot complex production data issues, memory bottlenecks, and pipeline failures rapidly.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 8+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data architecture, or big data systems.
  • Minimum of 4+ years of strong hands-on professional experience with Microsoft Azure Databricks.
  • Deep technical proficiency in Apache Spark, PySpark, and Delta Lake data formats.
  • Strong experience designing enterprise data platforms, data pipelines, and Databricks Medallion Architectures.
  • Advanced practical knowledge of Unity Catalog, data governance, security policies, and access controls.
  • Strong SQL skills and proven capability in processing large-volume enterprise datasets.
  • Solid background with Azure data services including Azure Data Factory and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.
  • Experience with CI/CD deployment automation, Git, and Azure DevOps pipelines.
  • Mandatory residency/work authorization: Ability to operate in Doha, Qatar.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Professional certifications such as Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • Prior experience integrating Databricks with enterprise CRM platforms (Dynamics 365, Salesforce).
  • Experience implementing FinOps cost-optimization strategies for cloud big data workloads.
  • Immediate availability for 12-month contract mobilization in Doha.

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
As a Business Systems Analyst, you will partner with business and technology stakeholders to understand needs, challenge assumptions, simplify processes and turn complex requirements into practical, testable solutions. You will also play a hands-on role in translating approved requirements into system configuration, business rules and workflows, then validating that the solution delivers what was intended.

Your Responsibilities

This is a hands-on Business Analyst role where you'll be involved from understanding the problem through to shaping, configuring and validating the solution.

You will :

  • Partner with business and technology stakeholders to understand business needs, problems, opportunities and desired outcomes.
  • Assess configuration impacts and dependencies, document changes and validate that configured solutions behave as intended.Translate complex business needs into clear, practical and testable functional requirements.
  • Analyse current and future-state processes, identifying gaps, dependencies, impacts and opportunities to improve.
  • Develop acceptance criteria and maintain requirements traceability throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Work closely with Architecture, Engineering, Quality Engineering and delivery teams to ensure requirements are understood and solutions remain aligned to the intended outcome.
  • Get hands-on with the application, translating approved requirements into system configuration, business rules, workflows, parameters and other supported settings.
  • Support testing, investigate configuration issues and help resolve problems within your area of responsibility.
  • Maintain clear analysis, requirements and configuration documentation to support delivery, release and operational handover.
  • Bring structure to ambiguity, facilitate different perspectives and help stakeholders reach a shared understanding of what needs to be delivered.

About You

You will bring:

  • Proven experience working as a Business Analyst within a technology, transformation or delivery environment.
  • Strong capability across requirements elicitation, functional analysis, process mapping, acceptance criteria and requirements traceability.
  • A structured approach to problem solving, with the ability to distinguish the underlying business problem from the requested solution.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and facilitation skills, with the confidence to work across both business and technical audiences.
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity, ask the right questions and bring clarity to complex or evolving requirements.
  • Strong written communication and the ability to produce clear, concise and usable BA artefacts.
  • A genuine interest in systems and how they can be configured to support business outcomes.
  • Experience with application configuration, workflows, business rules, parameters or similar system functionality will be highly regarded.
  • The judgement to recognise when an issue sits within your remit and when it requires input from Architecture, Engineering or other specialists.
  • A practical, collaborative and outcome-focused approach - you're not someone who wants to write a requirements document and hand it over. You want to see the solution through.

title: People and Operations Associate
description:
At Intenseye, we believe protecting people at work is non-negotiable.

That’s why we’re building the world’s most advanced AI-powered platform for industrial environments, designed to help organizations move from reactive programs to proactive risk prevention across safety, operations, and quality management. Our technology gives enterprises the ability to see risk and inefficiency as they emerge, take action in real time, and prevent incidents before they happen.

Powered by cutting-edge AI and Intenseye’s proprietary Sentinel hardware, our platform delivers ethical, highly accurate intelligence across complex worksites. EHS, operations, and quality teams gain continuous leading indicators, deep operational insight, and unprecedented visibility into how work actually happens.

Today, Intenseye helps protect hundreds of thousands of workers across 25+ countries—and we’re just getting started.

The role

We're looking for a People & Operations Associate to be the face of employee engagement for our US team. You'll shape how it feels to work at Intenseye, from a candidate's first interview to a new hire's first day to the events that bring the team together. Day to day, you'll sit where people, workplace and business operations meet: running the office, planning events, and making sure everyone has what they need to do their best work. You'll work closely with the People team and support our leadership team, so you'll get broad exposure to how a fast-growing company works.

This role is a strong fit for someone who is:

  • A natural culture-builder: you energize a room, bring people together, and care about making work a place people want to be.

  • Highly organized: you juggle many moving parts and nothing slips.

  • People-first: you care about how candidates, new hires and teammates feel, and you sweat the details that shape their experience.

  • Proactive: you spot what needs doing and handle it before anyone asks.

  • Discreet: you handle confidential information with good judgment.

  • Adaptable: you're comfortable switching between an interview schedule, a vendor call and a team offsite in the same afternoon.

  • This position is based out of our NYC office and requires a minimum of three days on site

What you'll do

  • Manage day-to-day office operations: supplies, facilities, and relationships with vendors and building management.

  • Support US hiring: schedule interviews, coordinate with hiring managers and candidates, and make sure every candidate has a smooth, positive experience.

  • Plan and run office events and team activities: celebrations, offsites and traditions that build connections across the team.

  • Own US employee engagement: be the go-to person for team connection and culture. Plan the moments that make people feel part of the team.

  • Support general company operations: help manage inventory of Intenseye's hardware. Track units, coordinate shipments and returns, and keep records accurate. Pitch in on other operational projects as the company grows.

  • Handle hardware for new hires: order laptops and equipment, set them up, and have them ready before day one.

  • Partner with the People team on onboarding and offboarding: coordinate NHO, employee offboarding and general office needs in between.

  • Support the leadership team: occasional scheduling, meeting logistics, and special projects as needed.

What we're looking for

  • 1–2 years of experience in people operations, recruiting coordination, office management, executive support or a similar role.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize across competing requests.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, and a warm, professional presence with candidates and colleagues.

  • Comfortable with Google Workspace, scheduling tools and ATS/HRIS systems.

  • Basic technical comfort setting up laptops and accounts, or eagerness to learn.

  • Startup mindset: High ownership, high velocity, pragmatic judgment.

  • Able to work on-site in our NYC office minimum 3 days per week.

Compensation and Benefits

  • $80,000-95,000

  • Employee Stock Options

  • Health, vision, dental insurance

  • 401k with match

  • Flexible PTO policy + 13 company holidays

  • Pre-tax commuter benefits

Intenseye is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where every team member feels valued and empowered. We recruit, hire, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, color, age, sex, ancestry, marital status, religion, national origin, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, medical condition, pregnancy, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

If you’re excited about our mission and believe you can have an impact in this role, we strongly encourage you to apply. Your experience, skills, and perspective may be exactly what we’re looking for.

title: Senior Specialist, Bioprocess & Technical Engineering
description:
Job Description

We’re looking for a Senior Specialist in Bioprocess & Technical Engineering to join our team and make a significant impact on our manufacturing network.

This is a key leadership role where you will have the opportunity to shape how complex biological processes are introduced, scaled and improved. You will work with our internal sites and external partners to enhance our technical capabilities, ensure our facilities are ready for new technologies and lead initiatives that directly support the quality and supply of life‑changing products for patients.

Our team thrives on technical excellence, collaboration and a shared commitment to making a difference. We work closely with teams across Manufacturing, Science & Technology, Quality and Engineering to solve challenges and ensure our processes are robust and efficient. In this role, you will report to the Director of Bioprocess & Technical Engineering and play a vital part in setting high standards across our network.

Bring Energy, Knowledge, Innovation To Carry Out The Following

  • Lead facility-fit and manufacturing readiness assessments by evaluating new products against existing site capabilities, identifying facility, equipment sizing, utility and operational constraints, and defining strategies to enable successful technology transfer and commercialisation.
  • Develop and own process mass balances and capacity models to assess manufacturing feasibility, technology requirements, equipment utilisation, buffer and media demands, and end-to-end process performance across the product lifecycle.
  • Drive technology identification and platform alignment by evaluating process technologies, manufacturing strategies, and equipment solutions that support robust, scalable and standardised biologics manufacturing across the network.
  • Establish and champion platform technology standards by defining, implementing, and governing manufacturing platforms, process design principles, and engineering best practices to maximise consistency, transferability and operational excellence.
  • Support the development and deployment digital engineering tools and models that enable data‑driven decision making for facility fit assessments, mass balance development, capacity planning, equipment selection, technology transfer readiness, and lifecycle management.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to internal teams and external partners, ensuring engineering solutions are scientifically sound, operationally sustainable, compliant, and aligned with platform strategies.
  • Support/lead cross‑functional technical assessments and investigations supporting new product introductions, technology transfers, process changes, and manufacturing optimisation initiatives, utilizing structured problem‑solving methodologies to identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
  • Drive continuous improvement and innovation through the development of engineering standards, digital capabilities, knowledge management systems, and scalable approaches that improve transfer success rates, reduce complexity, and enhance manufacturing robustness.
  • Shape the future manufacturing network by contributing to technology roadmaps, facility expansion strategies, capital investment decisions, and technical due diligence activities for new products, emerging technologies, and strategic partnerships.
  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence by promoting technical rigor, knowledge sharing, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning across the organisation.

What Skills You Will Need

  • A Bachelor’s degree in engineering, biological sciences or a related field, with at least seven years of relevant experience in engineering, manufacturing or technology transfer.
  • A minimum of 7 years of experience in biologics drug substance manufacturing, with a background in facility design, process engineering or commercial manufacturing support.
  • A strong technical understanding of biologics manufacturing processes, equipment and automation.
  • The ability to lead and influence in a collaborative, cross‑functional environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas to a variety of audiences.
  • A talent for connecting technical details to broader business goals, such as supply reliability and quality.
  • An inclusive leadership style that helps create a psychologically safe and accountable work environment.
  • Experience with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) environments, quality systems and change control.
  • Strong problem‑solving, organisational and prioritisation skills.

Preferred experience

  • Experience in monoclonal antibody drug substance manufacturing.
  • Expertise in upstream or downstream biologics process engineering.
  • Familiarity with new product introductions, Process Performance Qualification (PPQ) and lifecycle management.
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement methods like Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma.
  • Experience with global regulatory requirements and supporting health authority inspections.
  • A willingness to travel up to 20% may be required.

We keep the patient at the very heart of all that we do and strive to find solutions and treatments for some of the world's most challenging healthcare needs.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are proud to be a company that embraces the value of bringing diverse, talented, and committed people together.

We are committed to flexible working where possible, and this is why our Company has introduced a new hybrid working model for office‑based colleagues around the world.

Clinical Manufacturing, Commercialization, Data Analysis, Influencing Skills, Investigation Management, Manufacturing Scale‑Up, Process Engineering, Regulatory Compliance, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Stakeholder Management, Strategic Thinking

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
About the role

As a Solutions Engineer, you'll be the technical and functional expert on Karmly Workforce for prospective and existing customers. Pre-sales engagement is critical to this role — you'll dig into a customer's complex environment of systems and processes, understand their pay rules, rostering and billing requirements, and shape how it all comes together in Karmly Workforce, before handing a well-scoped solutions over to the Implementation team to deliver. You'll be a trusted advisor to clients on workforce management and labour hire best practice — equally comfortable in a boardroom with senior stakeholders and on the ground with hands-on owner-operators, payroll and operations teams, and able to see requirements through each of these lenses. This is a role for someone who's genuinely energised by ambiguity and by driving change.

Key responsibilities

  • Act as the lead solutions expert on Karmly Workforce during pre-sales, running discovery sessions and tailored demos alongside the sales team

  • Dig into a customer's complex current environment — existing systems, spreadsheets, pay rules, rostering and billing processes — to build a clear picture of what needs to come together in Karmly Workforce

  • Translate complex business requirements (award interpretation, pay rules, rostering logic, client billing structures, compliance workflows) into a well-scoped Karmly Workforce solution

  • Prepare well scoped & documented customer engagements to the Implementation team, who lead detailed configuration, Proof of Value and delivery so that we can reduce the time to go live and billing

  • Build strong relationships with client stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor on workforce management and labour hire best practice

  • Move comfortably between boardroom conversations with senior stakeholders and hands-on conversations with owner-operators, payroll teams and operations admin — viewing requirements through each of these lenses

  • Troubleshoot complex configuration and integration questions raised during pre-sales, escalating product gaps to Product/Engineering

  • Gather and relay customer and market feedback to Product Management to help shape the Karmly Workforce roadmap

  • Keep current on payroll compliance, modern awards/agreements and labour hire regulation across the markets Karmly Workforce serves (initially NZ and Australia)

About you

  • 4+ years' experience in a solutions consulting, pre-sales, systems configuration or similar customer-facing technical role — ideally within SaaS, payroll, workforce management or HRIS

  • The ability to demonstrate a complex product with clarity and confidence, and to cut through ambiguity to what actually matters

  • A genuine interest in and understanding of accounting principles — a relevant accounting qualification is highly regarded

  • Practical understanding and hands-on experience of labour hire operations — you know how a labour hire business actually runs, day to day

  • A strong grasp of payroll, rostering, timesheet and client billing processes, and the confidence to interpret complex pay and award rules

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to lead conversations with senior client stakeholders as well as hands-on owner-operators, payroll teams and operations admin

  • Genuine comfort working through ambiguity, and the drive to champion change within a customer's business

  • Experience with and, ideally, exposure to APIs or third-party integrations (payroll, accounting or HR systems)

  • Exposure to applicant tracking systems (ATS) such as JobAdder, Tracker or Bullhorn

  • Familiarity with AI tools and agentic workflows (e.g. Claude, MCP servers) and an interest in applying them to solution design and customer problem-solving

About us

FlexiTime builds workforce management software for businesses that employ people doing real work in the real world. Our products, PayHero (payroll), Karmly (contractor management and labour hire) and Droppah (rostering and scheduling), help businesses across New Zealand and Australia pay, roster and manage their teams. We're bootstrapped, profitable and growing fast, and we're just getting started.

Karmly Workforce is our all-in-one labour hire operations platform, built for businesses that place and manage contingent and labour hire workers — including cleaning, security, hospitality, logistics and construction. It brings recruitment, onboarding, scheduling, time and attendance, payroll and compliance, and client billing together into one system, so our customers can fill roles faster, pay people correctly, and run their operations from a single source of truth.

Benefits

  • Work on a product that genuinely makes a difference to how businesses schedule, pay and look after their people

  • A supportive team environment with room to grow your career as our Karmly Workforce customer base scales

  • The chance to shape a product and a practice that's still growing — your ideas and feedback carry real weight

If you are interested in joining our fast growing, profitable company with global opportunity, we would love to hear from you!

title: VC Analyst
location: Canada, Germany, Ireland, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom
description:
We are hiring a VC Analyst to open relationships with investors who back private companies directly, and to put the right opportunities in front of them.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE

This role sits on the investor side of Pairs. You find investors who are active right now, learn what each of them backs, and introduce them to opportunities that fit.

Most of the work is first contact done well. You write to family offices, angels and early-stage funds in a way that earns a reply, turn those replies into calls, and book the right investors into meetings with founders.

We are not raising a fund. Our investors invest directly in companies, so the work is about direct investors, not fund LPs.

Our platform handles the pipeline, research and follow-up. Your time goes to the conversations, and to learning which investors are ready to commit capital.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our investor team, on a process that already works. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen opportunities, what we decline and why.

This is an early-career role. Drive and judgement matter more to us than years in a seat.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Investor research. Who is investing right now, in what, at what stage and check size.

  • First conversations. Messages that read like a person wrote them, and replies turned into calls.

  • Investor meetings. Qualified investors booked with founders whose opportunity fits what they back.

  • Your growing network. Every investor you open, kept current and qualified. The network you build here is yours.

YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

  • Have worked around venture capital, as an analyst, a scout, at an accelerator or in a role close to deals, and can name rounds from this year you found interesting.

  • Can write a short, specific message to a stranger that gets a reply.

  • Keep your pace high without letting quality slip, and follow a process without needing a reminder.

  • Understand the basics of a round: stage, check size, SAFE versus priced, and why an investor passes.

  • Treat discretion as second nature. Please do not include any investor names in your application.

  • Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A fully remote, asynchronous role

  • Direct access to the co-founders and our investor team

  • Close collaboration with our internal team

  • Live mandates from your first week, and access to the opportunities that clear our diligence

  • Insight into our internal processes, including how we screen deal flow

  • Room to grow into a senior investor-side role as your network grows

  • A base salary plus commission

Compensation Range: $90K - $150K

description:
Who We Are:
Christopher Street Financial (CSF) is a unique, growing financial planning and wealth management firm based in New York City, with clients nationwide. We value this for our clients, for our colleagues, and for our community.
Christopher Street Financial was founded in 1981 as the first company committed to providing financial advice and investment services to the LGBTQ+ community. A lot has changed since the birth of Christopher Street Financial, but one thing has not: our commitment to provide financial planning and investment services to the LGBTQ+ community and those who share our values.

We believe in the efficiency of a common approach and the value of providing a common client experience, all while acknowledging our clients’ individuality. We collaborate with one another, combining the strengths of our unique abilities to achieve greatness as a group. We seek to recognize individual efforts based on how they contribute to team success. title: Asset Servicing Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
The Safekeeping Officer is responsible for the secure custody and administration of physical securities and assets, ensuring all holdings are accurately recorded, safeguarded, and maintained in compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. The role involves performing sanctions screening and due diligence checks on incoming transactions and related parties, reviewing and reconciling client and counterparty instructions for completeness and accuracy, and distributing validated instructions to the appropriate operational units for timely processing. The incumbent works closely with internal stakeholders, custodians, and clients to resolve discrepancies, support audit and compliance requirements, mitigate operational risks, and ensure the efficient execution of safekeeping and custody-related activities.
**Responsibilities:**
+ Safekeep and maintain custody of physical securities and other physical assets in accordance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and client agreements.
+ Ensure proper receipt, recording, storage, movement, and release of physical securities while maintaining accurate audit trails and custody records.
+ Perform sanctions screening and compliance checks on incoming transactions, counterparties, and related documentation in line with regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
+ Review and reconcile incoming instructions against supporting documentation, account records, and system information to ensure completeness and accuracy.
+ Validate and distribute transaction instructions, notifications, and documentation to the appropriate operational teams for timely processing.
+ Conduct daily and periodic reconciliations of physical securities holdings, inventory records, and custody positions to identify and resolve discrepancies promptly.
+ Monitor outstanding instructions, exceptions, and breaks, ensuring timely investigation, follow-up, and resolution.
+ Coordinate with internal departments, clients, custodians, brokers, and external counterparties on safekeeping-related matters and operational inquiries.
+ Ensure all safekeeping activities are performed in compliance with regulatory requirements, operational procedures, risk controls, and service level agreements.
+ Support audits, inspections, and regulatory reviews by providing required documentation and evidence in a timely manner.
+ Maintain accurate records and management reports relating to physical asset inventory, reconciliation status, and operational risk incidents.
+ Identify process improvement opportunities and contribute to the enhancement of operational efficiency, controls, and client service quality.
+ Works closely with peers and product to develop solutions that will enable team to meet the mission statements of the department and create dynamic MIS
+ Participates in system testing
+ Maintains awareness of product changes and system enhancements
+ Assists team member during periods of high volume work, provides back-up coverage, and performs other duties as assigned by supervisor
+ Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
**Qualifications:**
+ Bachelor's degree in business administration, Finance, Economics, Accounting, Banking, or a related field.
+ Minimum  **2-5 years of relevant experience**  in Custody Operations, Asset Servicing, Securities Services, or Financial Services Operations.
+ Solid knowledge of at least one or more of the following areas: Asset Servicing (Corporate Actions), Cash Processing, Foreign Exchange (FX), Securities Settlement, and Custody Operations.
+ Good understanding of post-trade processing, operational controls, reconciliation processes, and risk management practices.
+ Experience in reviewing, analyzing, and documenting business requirements, including the ability to prepare  **Business Requirement Documents (BRD)** .
+ Proven ability to identify process improvement opportunities and initiate or support operational and technology enhancement projects.
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
+ Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly  **Excel** , including PivotTables, data analysis, reporting, and reconciliation.
+ Experience with data analysis and the ability to interpret operational data to support decision-making and process improvements.
+ Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Operations, Technology, Compliance, and Business teams.
+ Ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and perform under tight deadlines in a dynamic environment.
Preferred Qualifications
+ Experience leading or participating in process automation, system implementation, or transformation initiatives.
+ Knowledge of SWIFT messages, market practices, and custody/asset servicing platforms.
+ Familiarity with project management methodologies and UAT testing processes.
**Education:**
+ Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience

The role will serve as the technology owner for ServiceNow Telecommunications Service Management, including associated telecommunications service operations, event management, incident management, major incident management, problem management, customer-impact analysis, service-level management, and service-assurance workflow capabilities.
