  • Partner with Network Operations and Service Assurance leaders to translate business needs into platform capabilities, automation opportunities, and operational improvements.
  • Establish governance, prioritization, and investment decisions aligned to customer impact, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and business priorities.
  • Manage platform budgets, software licensing, technology partners, and vendor relationships.

Lead Platform Engineering & Delivery

  • Lead a multidisciplinary team of product managers, architects, developers, integration engineers, data engineers, analysts, and support resources.
  • Drive the design, development, integration, testing, release, and ongoing enhancement of Service Assurance capabilities.
  • Establish modern engineering, DevSecOps, release-management, and quality practices that ensure scalability, reliability, maintainability, and security.
  • Deliver reusable, enterprise-scale solutions that support multiple network domains, products, customer segments, and operational teams.

Modernize Service Assurance Operations

  • Own the integration strategy connecting ServiceNow with monitoring, inventory, customer, workforce-management, communications, and analytics platforms.
  • Improve event management, service-impact analysis, incident management, workflow automation, outage communications, and operational visibility.
  • Advance automation, observability, AI, and operational-intelligence capabilities that improve incident detection, prioritization, and resolution.
  • Ensure platform data and workflows provide reliable visibility into network services, customer impact, locations, SLAs, and operational performance.

Ensure Platform Reliability & Operational Excellence

  • Own the operational performance, availability, security, resiliency, and support model for a platform supporting 24×7 network operations.
  • Establish service-level objectives, monitoring, escalation procedures, support processes, and disaster-recovery capabilities.
  • Lead platform incident management, problem management, and technical-debt reduction initiatives.
  • Continuously improve reliability and user experience through feedback, automation, and operational insights.

Drive Data Governance & User Adoption

  • Establish governance for CMDB, service models, topology data, operational data, and platform configuration standards.
  • Partner with Architecture, Inventory, and Data teams to improve data quality, accuracy, and trustworthiness.
  • Simplify operational workflows and improve productivity for NOC engineers, service-assurance analysts, incident managers, and customer operations teams.
  • Lead training, adoption, change-management, and continuous-improvement initiatives to maximize platform value.

Build & Develop High-Performing Teams

  • Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing Service Assurance product and engineering organization.
  • Define clear accountabilities across product management, architecture, engineering, testing, platform operations, and support functions.
  • Manage external implementation partners, software vendors, managed-service providers, and ServiceNow partners.
  • Foster a culture of product ownership, operational excellence, innovation, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Success in This Role

Key measures of success include:

  • Platform availability and service-level performance
  • Release quality and delivery predictability
  • Automation and operational efficiency improvements
  • Incident management effectiveness and restoration times
  • Customer-impact visibility and service-assurance outcomes
  • User adoption and satisfaction
  • Data quality, CMDB maturity, and platform reliability
  • Technical-debt reduction and cost optimization
  • Business value delivered through the product roadmap

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Telecommunications, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of twelve (12) years of experience in enterprise platforms, telecommunications technology, ServiceNow, OSS/BSS, service assurance, or network operations systems.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of leadership experience managing product, platform-engineering, application-development, or technology-support teams.
  • Significant experience with ServiceNow TSM, TSOM, ITSM, ITOM, Event Management, CMDB, Service Mapping, or related capabilities.
  • Experience leading both technology delivery and production support for a business-critical enterprise platform.
  • Strong understanding of telecommunications service assurance, network events, incidents, services, inventory, topology, and customer impact.
  • Experience integrating ServiceNow with network-management, inventory, customer, field-service, data, and communications platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience developing product roadmaps and translating operational requirements into platform capabilities.
  • Experience with software-development lifecycle, DevSecOps, testing, release management, observability, and platform operations.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, financial management, and organizational leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in fiber, optical transport, Ethernet, IP, internet, cloud connectivity, or managed network services.
  • ServiceNow architecture, implementation, or product-owner certification.
  • Experience with ServiceNow Telecommunications Service Operations Management.
  • Experience with AIOps, event correlation, network observability, topology, and automated remediation.
  • Experience managing ServiceNow upgrades and reducing complex customization.
  • Familiarity with ITIL, SRE, platform engineering, and product operating models.
  • Experience supporting highly available, 24×7 operational platforms.

In your first year, you will:

  • Assess the current ServiceNow implementation, architecture, integrations, data quality, support model, and technical debt.
  • Create a prioritized multi-year platform roadmap with measurable operational outcomes.

title: Vice President, Infrastructure Services
description: Position SummaryThe Vice President, Infrastructure Services leads the strategy, operating model, engineering, delivery, and operation of enterprise infrastructure and employee technology services. This executive is accountable for the reliability, scalability, resilience, and performance of cloud and on-premises platforms, connectivity, digital workplace and end-user services, business service availability, distribution center technology enablement, and responsive IT service management. The role establishes the multi-year infrastructure roadmap, service ownership and governance model, investment priorities, and organizational capabilities required to support business growth, customer commitments, regulatory requirements, and the company’s adoption of automation and AI. The VP leads senior leaders, managers, and technical teams; partners closely with business and technology leaders; and measures results through service reliability, employee experience, operational readiness, risk reduction, and financial performance. Essential Functions and DutiesStrategic Leadership, Roadmap & Organizational Direction: Serve as a strategic thought leader and champion the benefits of emerging technologies, including AI, Machine Learning (ML), agentic AI, and other advancements, as they apply to infrastructure services and operations. Develop and maintain a multi-year Infrastructure Services strategy and roadmap aligned with business growth, customer commitments, operational requirements, regulatory expectations, and enterprise technology priorities. Define and evolve the Infrastructure Services operating model, organizational structure, service ownership, and decision rights across cloud and platform engineering, network and communications, digital workplace and end-user services, site reliability engineering and operations, warehouse technology enablement, and infrastructure architecture, automation, and AI. Establish infrastructure investment priorities across platform modernization, lifecycle management, resiliency, technical debt, capacity, automation, and emerging capabilities; develop business cases and sequence investments based on business need, risk, service impact, and financial considerations. Partner with the PMO and business and technology stakeholders to establish priorities, secure appropriate resources and funding, and ensure initiatives are planned and positioned for successful execution. Build strong relationships with senior executives and business leaders and serve as a trusted advisor regarding infrastructure capabilities, risks, investments, and emerging technology opportunities. Cloud & Platform Engineering: Lead Cloud and Platform Engineering across Azure, Google Cloud, Nutanix, operating systems, storage, backup integration, identity integration, infrastructure as code, platform governance, and cloud cost management. Establish platform engineering standards that improve scalability, reliability, security, automation, and consistency across cloud and on-premises environments. Drive modernization of infrastructure platforms while reducing technical debt and improving lifecycle management, standardization, and operational efficiency. Establish governance for cloud consumption, capacity, performance, and cost optimization while ensuring infrastructure investments align with business requirements. Network & Communications: Direct Network and Communications services across corporate offices, distribution centers, cloud environments, and remote operations. Provide executive oversight for enterprise and distribution center networks, WAN, cloud connectivity, wireless infrastructure, internet redundancy, DNS and DHCP, VPN, and voice and collaboration communication technologies. Establish network architecture, availability, capacity, performance, and lifecycle standards to support business continuity, operational growth, and high-availability requirements. Ensure clear ownership, escalation, and engineering accountability for network reliability and business-critical connectivity. Digital Workplace & End User Services: Lead Digital Workplace and End User Services for remote, hybrid, office, and distribution center employees, including Windows and Mac engineering, endpoint and mobile management, Microsoft 365 and collaboration services, device lifecycle, patching, self-service, and employee productivity. Establish enterprise standards and governance for end-user technology platforms, administrative services, endpoint engineering, and technology asset lifecycle management. Provide executive oversight of Service Desk and technology service management capabilities, including tiered support, executive support, request fulfillment, asset and knowledge management, service catalog capabilities, and continuous improvement of the employee technology experience. Establish strategy and governance for endpoint lifecycle and technology asset management, including device standards, provisioning, refresh planning, mobile devices, asset controls, licensing, vendor and leasing strategy, and secure disposition. Establish clear service ownership, service levels, operating standards, and accountability to provide consistent technology experiences across all supported business environments. Site Reliability Engineering, Service Management & Resilience: Establish Site Reliability Engineering and operations practices for end-to-end business services, including monitoring and observability, incident and problem management, capacity management, service levels, operational readiness, backup validation, disaster recovery, and business continuity exercises. Establish the Infrastructure Services IT service management operating model and governance across incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset, and service management. Define clear service ownership, escalation pathways, SLAs/OLAs, operating standards, and continuous improvement expectations across Infrastructure Services. Establish the enterprise infrastructure resilience strategy, including availability standards, recovery objectives, capacity and redundancy requirements, disaster recovery governance, and operational readiness for business-critical services. Ensure integrated service delivery and accountability across infrastructure engineering, Service Desk and End User Services, SRE, warehouse technology, Applications, Cybersecurity, and Operations. Provide executive leadership during major technology incidents and ensure effective escalation, communication, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and organizational learning. Warehouse Technology Enablement: Oversee Warehouse Technology Enablement across distribution center environments, including warehouse Wi-Fi, RF handhelds, scanners, printers, shipping workstations, local infrastructure, and site technology support. Coordinate with Operations, application teams, technology leaders, and external vendors on conveyor and warehouse control system interfaces, PLC connectivity, facility upgrades, infrastructure dependencies, and peak-season readiness. Establish appropriate ownership and escalation models between frontline support, infrastructure engineering, operational technology resources, and business operations. Ensure distribution center technology is designed and supported to meet business-critical availability, resilience, performance, and recovery requirements. Infrastructure Architecture, Automation & AI: Set infrastructure architecture, engineering standards, reference designs, lifecycle plans, and target-state direction across Infrastructure Services. Establish architecture governance that promotes standardization, interoperability, scalability, security, resiliency, and effective lifecycle management. Reduce technical debt and expand reusable platforms, infrastructure as code, automation, orchestration, and self-service capabilities. Introduce practical AI-assisted support and infrastructure operations in partnership with the AI Center of Excellence and Cybersecurity, with appropriate governance, data protection, security, and human oversight. Evaluate emerging technologies and determine where adoption can materially improve infrastructure performance, service reliability, employee experience, scalability, or cost effectiveness. Cybersecurity, Risk & Governance: Partner with the CISO organization to incorporate security requirements into infrastructure strategy, architecture, engineering, and operations. Ensure alignment with enterprise requirements for identity and access controls, network segmentation, vulnerability remediation, endpoint and administrative controls, technology asset governance, monitoring, change controls, and audit and regulatory requirements. Partner with Enterprise Architecture, PMO, Procurement, application leaders, Operations, and other technology functions on shared standards, priorities, dependencies, and enterprise initiatives. Ensure infrastructure risks, control gaps, lifecycle exposures, and service vulnerabilities are identified, prioritized, communicated, and appropriately mitigated. Financial, Vendor & Performance Management: Own Infrastructure Services budgets, financial planning, vendor performance, contracts, resource planning, and delivery commitments. Establish meaningful KPIs, informed by the Gartner model, for availability, incident response, recovery, provisioning, device health, customer satisfaction, automation, capacity, service quality, and cost. Use service, operational, financial, and performance data to identify trends, evaluate organizational effectiveness, improve service outcomes, and inform investment decisions. Report material risks, performance trends, financial results, major initiatives, and roadmap progress to executive leadership. Establish effective vendor governance and ensure external technology partners meet contractual, service, financial, security, and performance expectations. Organization, Workforce & Talent Leadership: Recruit, develop, and grow the Infrastructure Services organization, building strong leadership and engineering capability across the function. Own multi-year workforce and capability planning, including organizational design, critical capability gaps, succession planning, insource/outsource decisions, vendor augmentation, and sequencing of leadership and engineering investments. Develop leaders and technical talent through clear accountability, coaching, performance management, succession planning, cross-training, career development, and knowledge transfer. Create a culture of engineering excellence, operational ownership, continuous improvement, proactive communication, collaboration, and customer service. Ensure organizational capacity, leadership capability, and technical expertise remain aligned with the company’s evolving infrastructure needs and strategic priorities. Education, Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Required Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Preferred Education: None. Required Knowledge: Enterprise infrastructure architecture and operations across public cloud, private cloud, networking, endpoints, collaboration services, and IT service management. High-availability design, observability, incident and problem management, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity. Infrastructure security principles, identity and access management, endpoint protection, change control, and vendor governance. Budgeting, cloud financial management, service metrics, and technology lifecycle planning. Preferred Knowledge: Azure, Google Cloud, Nutanix, Microsoft 365, Intune, Jamf, RingCentral, Terraform, and related automation tooling. Distribution center wireless and operational technology environments, including RF devices, warehouse control systems, conveyor interfaces, and site resilience. AI-assisted operations and support, including event correlation, knowledge retrieval, predictive monitoring, and responsible Copilot enablement. Pharmaceutical distribution, specialty pharmacy, and related security or regulatory expectations. Required Experience: Minimum of fifteen (15) years of experience in IT, with at least seven (7) years in a senior leadership role. Progressive leadership experience directing enterprise infrastructure and operations organizations, including senior leaders, managers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams. Demonstrated ownership of cloud and network platforms, end-user services, service reliability, major incidents, disaster recovery, and infrastructure resilience in a distributed, multi-site organization. Experience building and executing multi-year roadmaps, prioritizing technology investments, managing budgets and vendors, and communicating technology risks, business cases, and investment priorities to senior executives. Record of improving measurable service outcomes and leading organizational, operating model, or capability transformation across complex technology environments. Preferred Experience: Leadership of technology services for multiple distribution centers or other high-availability, transaction-intensive facilities. Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments, infrastructure as code, SRE practices, and cloud cost optimization. Experience supporting a large remote workforce and modernizing service desk and self-service capabilities. Experience partnering with Cybersecurity, Operations, and application teams on warehouse automation, regulated processes, or peak-season readiness. Required Skills: Strategic planning and practical execution; ability to translate business priorities, risk, and growth requirements into funded roadmaps, investment decisions, and reliable services. Visible leadership, sound judgment during incidents, clear escalation, and concise executive communication. Ability to design and build effective organizations, establish clear accountability and decision rights, coach leaders, and work across organizational boundaries. Analytical management using KPIs, root cause analysis, service reviews, operational risk, and financial data to drive decisions and continuous improvement. Strong stakeholder, vendor, contract, and change management skills. Preferred Skills: Applying AI responsibly to incident analysis, support knowledge, and workflow improvement. Leading site technology readiness and coordinating technical response with warehouse operations. Required Professional Certification: None required. Preferred Professional Certification: Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, ITIL 4, cloud architecture, networking, cybersecurity, project management, or business continuity and disaster recovery credentials, including CISSP, CISM, TOGAF, PMP, or Lean Six Sigma. title: MarTech & Analytics Specialist (Tracking & Customer Data)
description:
MarTech & Analytics Specialist (Tracking & Customer Data)

Reports to: Head of Performance Type: Full-time, permanent

About the role

We run a high-traffic travel business, and the marketing that powers it only works if the data underneath it is trustworthy. Every popup, form, campaign, ad, and checkout depends on tags firing correctly, events landing in the right place, and customer data flowing cleanly from the website into the tools that action it — and on someone turning all of that into insight the business can act on.

This role owns that layer. You are the person who makes sure we can measure what happens across our website and marketing, act on it, and trust the numbers. You implement and maintain our tag management, web and product analytics, ad-platform tracking, and customer-data pipelines and you turn the data they produce into clear reporting and recommendations.

You sit between marketing and the tech team. You are not a developer, but you speak their language: you scope what needs to be built, write clear requirements for the data layer and events, test rigorously, and validate that what ships actually works. You're the single point of truth for "is our tracking correct, and what is it telling us?"

What you’ll own

  • Tag management (GTM). Own our Google Tag Manager containers end to end — tags, triggers, variables, the data layer — across dev and production. Keep them clean, documented, and version-controlled.
  • Web & product analytics. Own event tracking and configuration in GA4 and Amplitude — event design, naming conventions, funnels, attribution, cross-domain tracking, and self-referral/UTM handling — so the business has one reliable read on behaviour.
  • Ad-platform & conversion tracking. Own conversion tracking across our paid channels — Meta (Conversions API / pixel), Google Ads, and offline/server-side conversion imports — so marketing spend is measured accurately and attribution holds up.
  • Customer data & Braze. Own the flow of customer and behavioural data into Braze (and our wider customer-data stack) — SDK/tag implementation, custom events and attributes, external-ID/identity handling, audience segmentation inputs, and syncs from source systems.
  • Reporting & insight. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that the marketing and performance teams can rely on and self-serve from — and turn the data into clear recommendations, not just charts. This is an analyst role as much as an implementation one.
  • Measurement framework & governance. Own the tracking plan — a documented event taxonomy, naming conventions, and data dictionary that the whole team works off — so measurement stays consistent as the business grows.
  • Consent, privacy & compliance. Own cookie consent and consent-mode configuration (e.g. CookieYes, Consent Mode v2) and keep tracking compliant with POPIA / GDPR analytics, marketing, and personalisation tags gated correctly, with sensible data-retention practice.
  • First-party data & the cookieless shift. Help move us toward durable, privacy-first measurement - server-side tagging and first-party data.
  • Data integration & validation. Bring tracking data together for analysis (e.g. in BigQuery), connect sources, and validate what we report against source systems so the numbers reconcile.
  • Experimentation enablement. Provide clean, trustworthy measurement for A/B tests and conversion work so experiment results can be believed and acted on.
  • MarTech stack ownership. Evaluate, recommend, and integrate marketing-technology tools; keep the stack coherent and the vendor relationships (e.g. Braze) productive.
  • Re-platforming migration. Lead the re-implementation and QA of the entire tracking and data layer on the new website (Nuxt), so measurement and customer-data flows are intact and verified at launch.
  • Data integrity & troubleshooting. Be the first responder when numbers look wrong — diagnose double-firing, missing events, broken attribution, identity mismatches — and drive the fix through the tech team.

How the role works with the team

You are the bridge between marketing and tech. You translate marketing and performance needs into precise, buildable requirements for developers, then test and sign off on what they deliver. You work closely with the front-end/dev team on anything that needs to happen in code (data layer, SDKs, site-side events), with marketing, paid media, and campaign colleagues on what needs to be measured and actioned, and with platform vendors (e.g. Braze) on audits and best practice.

Others build in the codebase; you specify, configure in the platforms you own, validate, report, and hold the standard. When tracking is right, nobody notices, that’s the job.

What you’ll bring

  • Hands‑on expertise with Google Tag Manager — comfortable building and debugging tags, triggers, and a clean data layer without needing a developer for the GTM side.
  • Strong working knowledge of GA4 (event-based model, configuration, funnels, attribution) and ideally Amplitude or a comparable product‑analytics tool.
  • Experience with ad‑platform conversion tracking — Meta CAPI/pixel, Google Ads conversions, and server‑side/offline conversion imports.
  • Experience implementing and maintaining a customer engagement / CDP platform — Braze ideally, or similar (Iterable, Klaviyo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, etc.) — including custom events/attributes and identity handling.
  • Ability to build reporting and turn data into insight — dashboards plus a clear point of view on what the numbers mean and what to do next.
  • Understanding of consent management, privacy, and compliance (Consent Mode, cookie tools, POPIA/GDPR, gating tags correctly).
  • The ability to write clear technical requirements and work productively with developers — you don't code the site, but you know exactly what to ask for and how to test it.

Ways of working

  • Rigorous and detail‑obsessed about data accuracy — you assume nothing works until you've verified it end to end.
  • Strong analytical problem‑solving — you can trace a wrong number back to its cause.
  • Comfortable prioritising competing requests and working with autonomy and ownership.
  • A clear communicator with non‑technical stakeholders — you explain why a number is what it is, in plain language.
  • Curious and current — you keep pace with a fast‑moving analytics and privacy landscape (GA4 changes, iOS/privacy shifts, platform updates).

Nice to have

  • Exposure to headless / modern JS front‑ends (Nuxt, Vue, or similar) and how tracking behaves on them.
  • Working knowledge of dataLayer patterns and server‑side tagging (e.g. server‑side GTM).
  • Comfort with SQL / BigQuery for validating and modelling data against source.
  • A grounding in SEO and content infrastructure

title: Specialist Engineer - E3D
description:
The E3D Specialist will be responsible for providing specialist support in AVEVA E3D Design activities for a major ADNOC Offshore PMC assignment. The role will support the PMC engineering and project teams in ensuring that 3D model development, review, coordination, and deliverables are executed in accordance with project specifications, ADNOC standards, approved procedures, and applicable international codes and standards.

The position will work closely with the PMC Engineering, Project, Construction, and Contractor teams to ensure effective development and management of the E3D model throughout the project lifecycle.

Wood is a global leader in consulting, engineering and operations for the energy and materials sectors. With 33,000 people in around 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower carbon future. Wood forms the Energy & Materials pillar of Sidara - a global partnership uniting leading multidisciplinary engineering, design, and project management companies. www.woodgroup.com

Diversity Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer that recognises the value of a diverse workforce. All suitably qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment on the basis of objective criteria and without regard to the following (which is a non-exhaustive list): race, colour, age, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or other characteristics in accordance with the relevant governing laws.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide specialist technical support for AVEVA E3D modelling and design activities across the project.
  • Review and monitor contractor/EPC E3D models to ensure compliance with approved engineering deliverables, project specifications and ADNOC requirements.
  • Perform detailed 3D model reviews, including equipment, piping, structural, electrical, instrumentation and other disciplines as applicable.
  • Identify model clashes, design inconsistencies, constructability issues and interface problems and ensure timely resolution.
  • Coordinate with engineering disciplines to ensure accurate integration of the 3D model.
  • Review model development against approved P&IDs, plot plans, equipment layouts, piping specifications, datasheets and other engineering documents.
  • Support model review meetings / 30%, 60%, 90% and final model reviews as required by the project.
  • Ensure appropriate modelling practices, naming conventions, tagging, attributes and project databases are maintained.
  • Monitor model quality and completeness and provide technical comments to EPC/contractor teams.
  • Review piping routing, equipment arrangement, structural interfaces, access/maintenance requirements and offshore constructability.
  • Ensure adequate consideration of operability, maintainability, safety, construction and commissioning requirements within the 3D model.
  • Support the resolution of technical queries and design changes affecting the E3D model.
  • Coordinate with the document control and engineering teams to ensure model updates are aligned with approved engineering documents.
  • Monitor contractor compliance with project BIM/3D modelling procedures and E3D requirements.
  • Participate in interdisciplinary design reviews and provide specialist E3D input.
  • Support development and review of model deliverables required for fabrication, construction and offshore installation.
  • Ensure model integrity is maintained throughout the project and that changes are properly incorporated and traceable.
  • Provide guidance to engineering disciplines and contractor modelling teams on E3D best practices.
  • Support project reporting on model progress, quality, clashes, interfaces and outstanding actions.
  • Review and verify final as-built / as-installed 3D model information where applicable.

PMC Responsibilities

  • Monitor EPC/contractor performance against contractual E3D and 3D modelling requirements.
  • Review and approve/comment on contractor technical submissions within the delegated authority of the PMC.
  • Ensure compliance with ADNOC standards, project specifications and approved design procedures.
  • Identify potential design and construction issues early and elevate significant risks to the PMC Engineering Manager/Project Manager.
  • Maintain effective communication with ADNOC, EPC contractors and other project stakeholders.
  • Support technical assurance and ensure that project deliverables meet the required quality standards.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Engineering Design, CAD/Design Technology or a related discipline.
  • Specialist training/certification in AVEVA E3D / PDMS is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of 3D plant design and modelling principles.

Experience

  • Typically 15+ years of relevant experience in oil & gas engineering/design, with significant experience in AVEVA E3D/PDMS.
  • Previous experience working on offshore oil & gas projects is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with major EPC/EPCM/PMC projects and large multidisciplinary 3D models.
  • Previous experience supporting ADNOC or other UAE/GCC oil & gas projects is highly desirable.
  • Strong experience in model reviews, clash detection, interdisciplinary coordination and constructability reviews.
  • Experience reviewing contractor/EPC 3D models in a PMC environment is preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in AVEVA E3D / PDMS.
  • Strong understanding of plant 3D modelling and engineering design workflows.
  • Good knowledge of piping, equipment, structural and multidisciplinary interfaces.
  • Understanding of P&IDs, equipment layouts, piping specifications and engineering drawings.
  • Knowledge of offshore facilities, topsides, modules, platforms and associated facilities.
  • Familiarity with model review and clash detection processes.
  • Good understanding of engineering change management and model revision control.
  • Knowledge of relevant international codes and standards and ADNOC project requirements.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong technical and analytical skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to identify design and constructability issues proactively.
  • Strong coordination and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary PMC team.
  • Ability to challenge contractor submissions professionally and provide technically sound recommendations.
  • Strong organizational and reporting skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet project deadlines.

title: Senior Reservoir Engineer - Simulation Specialist (Remote)
description:
Our client is seeking an exceptional Senior Reservoir Engineer specializing in simulation to join their fully remote global team. This position is critical for developing and refining advanced reservoir models to optimize hydrocarbon recovery and maximize asset value. You will work with complex geological data, employ sophisticated simulation techniques, and provide expert insights to support strategic field development. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced engineer to leverage their simulation expertise in a flexible, remote work environment, contributing to significant projects within the Oil & Gas industry, potentially supporting operations near Nelspruit.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, calibrate, and run complex 3D dynamic reservoir simulation models for various field development scenarios.
  • Perform sensitivity analyses and uncertainty assessments to optimize production strategies and economic outcomes.
  • Utilize advanced simulation techniques, including compositional modeling and enhanced oil recovery (EOR) simulations.
  • Analyze simulation results and provide clear, actionable recommendations to management and operational teams.
  • Collaborate effectively with geologists, geophysicists, and production engineers to ensure integrated reservoir management.
  • Stay current with the latest advancements in reservoir simulation technology and methodologies.

Requirements

  • Master's or Ph.D. degree in Petroleum Engineering or a closely related quantitative field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience in reservoir engineering, with a significant focus on simulation studies.
  • Expert proficiency in industry-standard reservoir simulation software (e.g., Eclipse, CMG Suite, Petrel RE).
  • Strong understanding of reservoir characterization, fluid properties, and numerical modeling techniques.
  • Proven ability to interpret simulation results and communicate complex technical information effectively.
  • Self-motivated with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a fully remote work setting.

Benefits

  • Highly competitive salary and attractive bonus structure.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Generous paid time off and a supportive remote work culture.
  • Access to advanced simulation software and computing resources.
  • Significant opportunities for professional growth and impact within the Oil & Gas sector, working remotely from any location.

title: Full-stack Engineer (Python, TDD)
description:
Remote, South Africa | Posted on 06/03/2026

Full Stack Engineer Python / FastAPI Next.js TDD Remote friendly

About Us

We automate end to end candidate compliance for education recruitment agencies using deterministic, AI powered workflows. We collect and validate documents, execute compliance rules, and produce a fully auditable clearance outcome for every candidate. We are early, moving fast, and building something technically interesting. Agentic compliance pipelines, rules engines, and document processing AI on top of a clean FastAPI and Next.js stack.

The Role

You will own both sides of the stack. Backend heavy in practice, focused on compliance logic, agentic workflows, and third party integrations, but you will also ship the React and Next.js surfaces that compliance teams and candidates use every day. This is not a lite frontend, serious backend split. We care deeply about both. The admin dashboard and candidate portal need to be fast, clear, and polished.

What You Will Do

  • Build and maintain FastAPI services that power compliance checks, document validation, and third party integrations
  • Design and implement durable, auditable workflow logic with a strong focus on traceability
  • Integrate external APIs including DBS providers, professional registers, and identity verification services
  • Write high coverage tests first. TDD is not optional here, it is how we work
  • Own database schema design and query performance on Postgres
  • Build the candidate portal and admin dashboard in Next.js with a component first approach
  • Implement clean, accessible user interfaces using shadcn ui and Tailwind, with opinionated defaults rather than custom CSS
  • Keep frontend data fetching patterns tight using React Query, typed API contracts, and clear state management
  • Ship features end to end. You spec, build, test, and deploy
  • Build compliance agents that validate candidate data, cross reference records, and review documentation against regulatory requirements
  • Instrument LLM workflows with observability tooling including traces, evaluations, prompt regression tests, and scoring pipelines
  • Maintain prompt quality through structured evaluation workflows.
  • Broken prompts should fail CI

How We Work

Tests are written before or alongside implementation

Backend stack includes FastAPI, Postgres using Neon, and Temporal Cloud for durable workflows

Frontend stack includes Next.js, shadcn ui, and Tailwind

Pull requests are small, reviewed quickly, and merged to main frequently

We are not looking for someone who ticks every box. If you are strong on backend, care about code quality, and can build a solid frontend, we would like to talk.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Must have

  • Strong Python and FastAPI experience with a solid understanding of async and clean service design
  • Solid React and Next.js skills. You can build a good looking, functional UI without hand holding
  • Practises TDD. Red, green, refactor is your default loop
  • Comfortable with relational databases including schema design, migrations, and query optimisation
  • Experience with REST APIs and third party integrations
  • Strong Git hygiene including meaningful commits, small pull requests, and constructive code reviews

Nice to have

  • Experience with workflow orchestration such as Temporal
  • Familiarity with regulated environments or compliance adjacent products
  • Experience with shadcn ui, Radix, or similar headless component libraries
  • Exposure to LLM powered document processing or agentic systems and frameworks such as LangChain or Mastra
  • Experience with LLM evaluation workflows including prompt regression testing, scoring pipelines, and observability tools such as Langfuse, Braintrust, or LangSmith
  • Agentic engineering experience including declarative specs, skills, subagents, AGENTS.md, and ADRs
  • Experience building B2B SaaS products including multi tenancy, tenant isolation, external APIs, webhooks, and data feeds

title: Technical Specialist
description:
Location: South Yarra, onsite
Part-time: 4 set days per week
Reporting to: Experience Team Lead


We’re looking for a Technology Specialist to take ownership of the technology, systems and technical problem-solving that keeps ANGRYchair running.

This is not a traditional IT support role.

We’re looking for someone who is naturally good with technology, loves solving problems, can work things out quickly, and is comfortable taking responsibility for things they may not have seen before.

You do not need to know everything already.

You do need to be the kind of person who can look at a problem, investigate it, use ChatGPT or Claude, Google it, read documentation, test a few things, call one of our external specialists if needed, and keep going until the problem is resolved.

One day you might be troubleshooting why an editor’s Mac is running slowly.

The next you might be researching replacement computers, improving the way our website gets updated, reviewing how we use AI safely, working through a HubSpot problem, checking our password and access setup, improving our LTO archive process, or coordinating with our external IT provider.

The big goal is simple: make sure our team can work effectively and technical problems don’t need to become the Founder's problems.

You’ll sit within our Experience Team, reporting to our Experience Team Lead, and work closely with our Data & Automation Engineer, who focuses more deeply on coding, integrations and automation.

What you’ll own

Technology and problem-solving

You’ll become the first person the team turns to when something technological isn’t working properly.

That might include:

  • Troubleshooting Macs, monitors, printers, peripherals and everyday software issues

  • Investigating hardware or performance problems affecting our editors and creative team

  • Researching new computers, equipment and software

  • Helping determine when technology should be repaired, upgraded, replaced or retired

  • Coordinating with external IT providers such as CompNow and other technical specialists

  • Identifying recurring problems and finding ways to stop them happening again

You won’t need to personally solve every technical issue. You will need to own the outcome, rather than simply passing problems on.

Business systems

You’ll help take ownership of the platforms and systems we use to run the business.

This will include developing a strong understanding of systems such as:

  • HubSpot

  • Google Workspace

  • Airtable

  • Notion

  • WordPress

  • Frame.io

  • Vimeo

  • Our internal forms, tools and SaaS platforms

You’ll help keep these systems organised, usable and working together properly.

You’ll also look for bottlenecks and opportunities to improve how we use them.

For example, if publishing a blog is taking too long, your job isn’t simply to upload the blog.

Your job is to understand why it is taking too long and improve the process.

Systems improvement and automation

You’ll work closely with our Data & Automation Engineer to improve the way ANGRYchair operates.

You don’t need to be a coder.

You do need to be able to understand a workflow, identify where things are going wrong or wasting time, and work out what a better process could look like.

Where deeper coding, APIs or automation are required, you'll build the solution together using tools such as n8n, Zapier, Snowflake and BigQuery.

You’ll often be responsible for defining the problem, understanding the business need and making sure the final solution actually works for the team.

Cybersecurity and access

You’ll help ensure ANGRYchair uses technology safely and sensibly.

This may include:

  • Password management

  • Passkeys and multi-factor authentication

  • Account permissions and access

  • User onboarding and offboarding

  • Device security

  • SaaS access

  • AI security and data handling

  • Backup procedures

  • Vendor access

  • General cybersecurity hygiene

You are not expected to be a cybersecurity expert.

You are expected to recognise when something needs deeper expertise, research the issue and engage the right external specialist where required.

AI and emerging technology

AI is becoming an increasingly important part of how we work.

You’ll help ANGRYchair understand how to use AI tools effectively and safely.

This could include:

  • Evaluating new AI tools

  • Helping establish safe and practical AI policies

  • Understanding privacy, security and data risks

  • Helping team members use AI more effectively

  • Identifying repetitive work that technology could improve

  • Working with our Data & Automation Engineer on AI-enabled workflows

  • Keeping across relevant technology changes without chasing every shiny new thing

We’re particularly interested in someone who already uses tools such as ChatGPT or Claude as part of the way they research, learn and solve problems.

Media technology, storage and archive

Video Production comes with some specialised technology requirements.

Over time, you’ll develop a strong understanding of how our media and storage environment works, including:

  • Media ingest

  • File storage

  • Backups

  • LTO tape archive

  • Archive retrieval and recovery

  • Shared storage

  • Drive and network performance

  • Media workflows

  • Equipment lifecycle

You don’t need to arrive knowing all of this.

You need to be technically curious enough to learn it and eventually take ownership of it.

Documentation and business continuity

A major part of this role is making yourself replaceable.

We do not want important knowledge living inside one person’s head.

You’ll be responsible for building and maintaining a useful internal knowledge base covering things such as:

  • Systems maps

  • Workflow diagrams

  • Technical procedures

  • Troubleshooting guides

  • Vendor contacts

  • Escalation pathways

  • Hardware and software registers

  • Access and permission structures

  • Backup and recovery procedures

  • Archive processes

  • Important technical decisions and why they were made

  • Onboarding and offboarding procedures

  • “What do I do if this breaks?” guides

Solve it once. Document it. Make the next time easier. Automate it where worthwhile.

What success looks like

You are succeeding in this role when:

  • The team knows who to go to when they have a technology problem.

  • Technical issues are resolved quickly and reliably, and repetitive problems gradually disappear

  • Changes, outages and new tools are communicated clearly and early across the team, avoiding disruption to projects and deadlines

  • HubSpot and our other business systems are properly understood and supported, and become easier to understand and use over time

  • Technology decisions are researched properly before money is spent, and external providers are managed effectively

  • Our cybersecurity and access practices are sensible and well maintained

  • Systems and workflows become better documented, so key knowledge does not depend on one person

  • Our use of AI and emerging technology becomes safer and more useful

  • You regularly identify improvements we hadn’t thought to ask for

You’ll probably be great at this if you…

  • Are naturally curious about technology and how things work

  • Love solving problems

  • Are comfortable saying “I don’t know yet, but I’ll work it out”

  • Can independently research and investigate unfamiliar problems

  • Use AI tools intelligently as part of your problem-solving process

  • Have broad technical knowledge rather than only one narrow specialisation

  • Are confident working in a Mac environment

  • Understand basic IT concepts without needing to be a hardcore IT engineer

  • Can explain technical things in plain English

  • Are comfortable dealing with suppliers and external specialists

  • Can make recommendations rather than simply presenting information

  • Are organised and follow problems through until they are actually resolved

  • Notice inefficient processes and instinctively want to improve them

  • Document things properly instead of keeping knowledge in your head

  • Enjoy helping people and making their work easier

  • Are comfortable balancing lots of different small and large problems

  • Know when to keep investigating and when to bring in an expert

Experience that would be useful

You don’t need experience in every one of these areas, but some exposure to the following would be valuable:

  • Mac hardware and macOS

  • Business IT support

  • SaaS platforms

  • Google Workspace

  • CRM systems such as HubSpot

  • WordPress or website administration

  • Cybersecurity fundamentals

  • Password managers and identity management

  • Device management

  • Networking fundamentals

  • Backup systems

  • Storage and file management

  • AI tools

  • Process mapping

  • Documentation and knowledge bases

  • Hardware procurement

  • Working with external IT providers

HubSpot and Project Management experience would be a huge plus, however not essential.

Experience in a creative, media or video production environment would be useful, but it is not essential.

What this role is not

This is not a helpdesk role where you wait for tickets.

It is not a hardcore engineering or coding role.

It is not a video production technical role focused on cameras, lighting or production equipment.

It is not a senior executive technology role.

It is a hands-on role for someone who can understand technology, take ownership, solve problems and continuously improve how a small business works.

ANGRYchair’s Core Values

  • Smart, not Hard

  • Razzle Dazzle

  • We’re Not Saving Lives Here

  • Bloody Excellent

  • Improve Continuously

  • Focus on People

If you’re the kind of person who likes being handed a messy problem, working out what’s actually going on, fixing it properly and then making sure everyone knows how it works next time, we’ll probably get along very well.

description:
At North Richmond Community Health (NRCH) we are proud to deliver courageous health and community services that collaboratively address health inequity. Join our dedicated Medically Supervised Injecting Room (MSIR) Harm Reduction team, where you'll play a pivotal role in providing life-saving support to those in our community. This position is focused on ensuring the safety, dignity, and health of clients accessing the MSIR. You will work closely with our team to deliver harm reduction interventions, health education, and client engagement in a supportive and non-judgmental environment.

You are passionate about social justice and committed to making a difference in the lives of vulnerable populations. Your communication skills, empathy, and ability to handle complex situations make you an invaluable member of our team.

  • Tertiary qualifications in Welfare, Social Sciences, Psychology, or Public Health.

  • Experience engaging with clients who may present with challenging behaviours.

  • Strong understanding of harm reduction principles and social justice values.

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic, team-oriented environment.

title: VIDEO SURVEILLANCE TECHNICIAN (2389)
description:
Job Summary

Under general supervision, assists in developing and implementing a districtwide security program, including surveillance, and emergency radio systems. Position is responsible for installation, maintenance and repair of hardware essential to the support of these programs and projects.

Job Description / Essential Elements

VIDEO SURVEILLANCE TECHNICIAN

DEFINITION

Under general supervision, assists in developing and implementing a districtwide security program, including surveillance, and emergency radio systems. Position is responsible for installation, maintenance and repair of hardware essential to the support of these programs and projects.

DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS

A Video Surveillance Technician is responsible for developing and implementing a districtwide security program, including surveillance, and emergency radio systems. Position is responsible for installation, maintenance and repair of hardware essential to the support of these programs and projects.

A Network Technician and Security Specialist participates in the planning and installation and ongoing maintenance of the district’s wide area network and local area networks. This includes providing technical support for software and hardware associated with the networks, ensuring the reliable interface among the district’s local area networks, access to mainframe systems and the worldwide web/Internet; and participating in the planning, implementation and maintenance of network security and cybersecurity.

An Information Technology Support Technician is responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of computer hardware, software and for both Intel-based and Macintosh-based installed technology.This includes knowledge of operating tools and advanced electronic hardware and software analysis equipment for diagnosing, repairing and resolving hardware and software problems on individual workstations and peripheral equipment.

SUPERVISION RECEIVED AND EXERCISED

Direct supervision is provided by the Assistant Director, Educational Technology and Information Services, or Director, Educational Technology and Information Services. General supervision may be provided by other assigned administrators.

No supervision is exercised over district personnel.

EXAMPLES OF DUTIES

Assures the reliable and efficient operation of the district’s security surveillance and emergency radio system; assists in the planning, organizing, controlling, directing, monitoring, and maintenance of the district’s technical-based security surveillance programs and emergency radio system; assists in the development and implementation of a districtwide security surveillance policy and emergency radio policy.

Uses safety equipment, supplies, and procedures to perform job duties as required.

Provides reports on activities as requested by an appropriate administrator.

Stores and shelves equipment and other supplies in conformance with various local, state, federal, and district rules and regulations.

Maintains equipment in a safe operating condition; maintains preventive maintenance procedures, records, and reports.

Assists visitors and safeguards district property; adheres to all state and federal laws and regulations regarding safety and health.

Attends and participates in district and/or assigned training or information sessions; incorporates new information or technology into existing job duties. Shall carry a communication device, if assigned one, and be available for general duties.

Uses a computer for entry and retrieval of information for work assignments.

Communicates effectively orally, in writing, and electronically.

Operates equipment such as district vehicles, electric carts, etc.

As needed, climbs an appropriate ladder to install, inspect, repair and troubleshoot equipment (e.g., IP cameras, wireless access points, servers, etc.).

Estimates cost of jobs; specifies, orders, and procures supplies, materials, tools, and equipment for the purpose of maintaining availability of required items and completing jobs efficiently; maintains inventory of supplies, parts and equipment; confers with appropriate administrator regarding cost effective use of materials and supplies.

Transports various items (e.g. tools, equipment and supplies) for the purpose of ensuring the availability of materials required at the job site.

Plans and coordinates emergency radio and security surveillance system installation with Facilities Planning and Maintenance Department, Educational Technology and Information Services Department, and outside vendors and contractors; serves as liaison for security system vendors and service contractors.

Assists in the design configuration, installation, maintenance, security, and management of all networked and telecommunication devices related to district security; diagnoses and resolves surveillance and emergency radio problems related to networking and telecommunications; troubleshoots connections and/or networks; isolates software problems from hardware problems; repair equipment or arrange for repair; drives to various sites to conduct work.

Guides end users on the proper use of the security camera client software and emergency radios.

Assists in the planning, installation, maintenance and troubleshooting of the Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) units that support the backup power to the security surveillance servers and related network switches.

Maps out the security system for the district and provides recommendations and specifications for purchase.

Researches, evaluates, and recommends new security and emergency radio technology; recommends and implements software and hardware upgrades for all security and emergency radio systems; manages equipment.

Maintains system documentation for all surveillance and emergency radio systems.

Monitors and maintains video and intrusion alarm systems; responds appropriately to breaches in security.

Assists in security implementation in new and remodeled buildings; recommends surveillance system management options.

Performs other related duties as assigned.

CLASS QUALIFICATIONS

Knowledge of:

Security surveillance systems which can include Video Management Systems (VMS), Network Video Recorder (NVR) server hardware, video streaming protocols, and IP camera technology.

Maintains work order system for hardware and security requests.

Operates various equipment and hand tools related to assigned activities.

Attends a variety of meetings as assigned.

Participates in training and certification activities as needed.

Prepares and maintains a variety of records and reports related to assigned activities; prepares status reports or documents detailing equipment usage.

Applicable sections of the State Penal Code, State Education Code, Health and Safety Code and GLENDALE UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT

others as assigned.

Federal, State and local laws, rules and regulations related to assigned activities.

Network principles, protocols, standards and various operating systems.

Internet software and protocols, IP’s and related information.

Technical aspects of the field of specialty.

Demonstrate understanding of, sensitivity to, and respect for the diverse academic, socio-economic, ethnic, religious, and cultural backgrounds, disability, and sexual orientation of students, faculty and staff.

Collaborates with contractors, management, and staff in coordinating and overseeing projects.

title: SOE Engineer
description:
Salary: Competitive salary package

The Role

Reporting to the IT Manager, you will be one half of a tight two-person IT team. You'll be the person our staff turn to when something breaks, and the one driving the projects that stop it breaking again. You'll be our go-to person for Microsoft 365, Apple and mobile device management, and you'll own our desktop fleet and its security controls end to end. And because we're an ISP, you'll work alongside our network engineers, developers, sales and support teams. Few IT roles offer this much variety, and you'll love it. Every day brings something new, and your career will benefit from the breadth and depth on offer.

We'd love to meet someone who treats their home lab as a hobby, not a chore. You already run Proxmox or ESXi in the garage, have an opinion on Intune vs. JumpCloud and read changelogs for fun. You'll be free to design and build the solutions you think are right, not just the ones on a ticket.

We trust you to make good calls when no one's watching, flag problems before they become incidents, and keep learning because you're curious. You won't be going it alone, though. It's a friendly team, and we will back you as you settle in. If that sounds like the job you've been waiting for, read on!

What you'll be doing
  • Running helpdesk support that fixes root causes instead of just closing tickets.
  • Owning security alerts from triage through to resolution.
  • Managing identity platforms including Entra ID, Okta, AD and our in-house developed platforms.
  • Managing a fleet that's mostly Windows, Apple and iOS, keeping it secure, current and well documented.
  • Patching servers, endpoints and appliances.
  • Owning backups end to end, running, restoring and regularly testing them.
  • Administering Intune/365, JumpCloud and Apple device management as well as our other cloud platforms.
  • Keeping the IT asset register and documentation accurate and useful.
  • Running on-boarding, off-boarding, access control, change management and reporting.
  • Using the latest AI tooling to automate and improve our systems and monitoring, so routine jobs run on their own and faults are caught before users notice them.
  • Planning and delivering IT projects, including ideas of your own like automation that removes repetitive work, security uplift, a simpler network, or anything that makes life easier for you and your users.
What we're looking for
  • Demonstrated expertise troubleshooting Windows 11, macOS, iOS, Windows Server, firewalls and VPN appliances, the kind that comes from curiosity as much as job experience.
  • Strong M365 and AD/Entra administration, including PowerShell scripting and application packaging/deployment.
  • Solid problem-solving, communication and prioritisation skills, and the judgement to know when to escalate and when to just handle it.
  • A track record of self-directed learning: certifications, a home lab, side projects, contributions to open source, or whatever else shows you keep learning.
Desirable
  • Experience implementing ACSC Essential Eight controls.
  • Microsoft and Apple certifications.
  • 3-5 years in a similar role.
Benefits for you!

At Pentanet, our people are our greatest asset! As one half of a two-person team, you'll have genuine ownership. You will have the autonomy to drive your own projects, backed by a team that has your back (and that you'll back in return). The way work happens here is a big part of the benefit. On top of that, we provide a range of employee benefits to support and empower our team, including:

  • Great work/life balance, flexible work environment.
  • Free breakfast cereal, an excellent coffee machine and wellbeing initiatives for staff.
  • Free or discounted internet service for your home, handy for that home lab.
  • Free GeForce NOW cloud gaming subscription.
  • Employee recognition program.
  • + much more!

Join the team and grow with us!

How to Apply

If this sounds like you, we want to hear from you. To apply, please send two things:

An up-to-date CV.

A personalised cover letter (no more than two pages) that addresses the following. Home lab examples are welcome, except where a question asks for production experience:

  • The hardest fault you have diagnosed, at work or in a home lab: what you tried, what you ruled out and how you found the cause. If it was a production environment, tell us its size and your role.
  • One task you automated with PowerShell or Intune, the problem it solved and how you knew it worked.
  • Your production experience administering M365 and Entra ID/AD: the size of the tenant or domain, what you managed day to day (for example licensing, conditional access, hybrid sync or Group Policy), and one thing you fixed or hardened.
  • A security or reliability problem you found or handled (in a tool such as Threatlocker or Huntress, or on your own systems): how you triaged it, when you would escalate, and what you changed to stop it recurring.
  • An example of an IT project or improvement you identified and delivered largely on your own initiative, and what it achieved for the organisation. Tell us what you would do differently now.
  • How you keep your skills current, whether through a home lab, certifications, side projects, open-source contributions or something else. Tell us what you want to learn next.

Pentanet supports diversity, inclusion and equal opportunity. We encourage people of all cultures, backgrounds, genders, ages, sexual orientations and abilities to apply.

To learn more about Pentanet and what we do, please visit https://pentanet.com.au/

APPLY NOW!

title: Manufacturing Technical Lead (MTL)
description:
Req ID: 138819
Remote Position: No
Region: Asia
Country: Thailand
State/Province: Chonburi

**Summary**
The Manufacturing Technical Lead (MTL) is responsible for driving operational execution and technical readiness for next-generation hardware programs from initial concept through mass-production handoff. Serving as the primary technical interface on the program team, the MTL bridges hardware design technical leads, software/firmware engineers, factory NPI managers, and global operations teams. This role owns the mitigation of manufacturing risks, the timely completion of hardware prototyping phases, and the enforceability of documentation and change controls across the product development lifecycle.
**Detailed Description**
**1. Cross-Functional Technical Bridging**
+  **Operational Gatekeeper:**  Translate highly complex engineering product intents and schematic parameters into practical, execution-ready directives for Factory NPI Managers and manufacturing sites.
+  **Operations Synthesis:**  Partner closely with internal Front-End, Back-End, and Test Engineering Senior Managers to ensure manufacturing infrastructure, SMT lines, box build automation, and test fixtures scale alongside prototyping phases.
+  **Design & Software Interface:**  Partner directly with hardware Design Technical Leads and Software Engineering Program Managers to align code, firmware, diagnostics, and silicon readiness with test schedules.
**2. Build Prototyping & Plan Execution**
+  **Execution Accountability:**  Own the execution matrix for all early-stage engineering and validation builds (Proto, EVT, DVT, PVT), ensuring builds complete on time and hit rigorous internal quality targets.
+  **Build-Specific SOW Authoring:**  Author and enforce precise build-specific Scopes of Work (SOW) defining clear hardware configuration baselines, build quantities, material allocations, and specific engineering test goals.
+  **Anomaly & Deviation Controls:**  Manage the live tracking, logging, and technical resolution of manufacturing anomalies, ensuring that engineering deviations are strictly controlled, documented, and closed.
**3. Risk Mitigation & Governance**
+  **Risk Framework Execution:**  Deploy NUDD (New, Unique, Different, Difficult) reviews, golden pFMEAs, and Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) parameter monitoring to prevent downstream yield and manufacturing shortfalls.
+  **Change Control Governance:**  Enforce rigorous change management protocols, representing operations at Change Control Boards (CCB) to ensure mid-cycle design tweaks or component substitutions are properly risk-assessed.
+  **Issue Tracking & Escalation:**  Utilize automated tracking frameworks (e.g., Jira) to monitor build blockers, spearheading immediate technical workarounds or executing crisp, timely escalations to management before critical paths are impacted.
**Knowledge/Skills/Competencies**
+  **Process Depth:**  Strong knowledge of electronic manufacturing operations (SMT, box build, system assembly, and test methodologies) paired with experience handling complex BOM structures and configuration lifecycles.
+  **Governance Tools:**  Proficiency with change control systems (PLM/CCB), bug/issue-tracking systems (Jira), and authoring detailed technical documentation such as Scopes of Work (SOWs).
**Physical Demands**
+ Duties of the position are performed in a manufacturing environment with frequent exposure to noise, dust, chemicals, operating machinery, temperature extremes, hazardous substances, etc.
+ Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data.
+ Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.
**Typical Experience**
+ 5+ years of experience in hardware NPI engineering, manufacturing technical leadership, or systems program management.
**Typical Education**
+ Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer, or Industrial Engineering.
+ Educational requirements may vary by geography.
**Notes**
This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

title: Principal Data Privacy Specialist, Fulfillment
description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. The Principal Data Privacy Specialist, Fulfilment, is a senior operational role within ZoomInfo’s Office of the Data Protection Officer. Reporting to the Senior Team Lead, Data Privacy Fulfilment, the role supports the effective day-to-day delivery of the Fulfilment team’s work, with primary responsibility for complex data subject rights requests, privacy-related queries, and related operational processes across applicable US, European, and other privacy regimes.

As a senior member of the team, the Principal Data Privacy Specialist provides subject‑matter expertise, quality oversight, and practical support to colleagues. The role acts as a delegated point of leadership when the Senior Team Lead is unavailable, helping maintain continuity in prioritisation, escalation handling, workload coordination, and service delivery.

This is a privacy fulfilment and operations role. It supports execution of established privacy processes and does not own the wider privacy compliance programme or broader privacy strategy.

What You'll Do:

Privacy Operations & Program Support

  • Manage and oversee the end-to-end handling of data subject rights requests, including access, deletion, correction, restriction, objection, opt‑out, and related complaints, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant responses.
  • Apply working knowledge of applicable privacy requirements, including the GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, other relevant US state privacy laws, data broker laws, and other applicable data protection requirements.
  • Oversee the operational management of the data privacy mailbox, including triage and prioritisation of queries, coordination of responses, and maintenance of clear records.
  • Demonstrated project‑management experience delivering privacy fulfilment initiatives from scoping through implementation, including workflow automation, process improvement, operational policy or procedure rollout, and cross‑functional change management.

Team Mentorship & Coaching

  • Support the Senior Team Lead in the day‑to‑day coordination of the fulfilment team, including workload prioritisation, escalation management, quality assurance, and process consistency.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and practical support to other members of the fulfilment team, helping promote consistent, high‑quality handling of requests.

Incident Response & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support the handling of data incident notifications received through privacy fulfilment channels, including initial triage, coordination with relevant teams, and support for root‑cause analysis and remediation activities.
  • Analyse privacy‑related fulfilment queries, assess relevant facts and risk, prepare recommended responses, and escalute complex, sensitive, or higher‑risk matters to the Manager, Privacy Fulfilment or other appropriate stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate request records, operational metrics, and supporting documentation to support reporting, audit readiness, and continuous improvement.

Cross Functional Partnerships

  • Identify recurring issues, process gaps, and trends in fulfilment activity, including emerging requirements under US privacy and data broker laws, and recommend practical operational improvements.
  • Work closely with Legal, Security, Product, Customer Support, and Operations teams to obtain information and coordinate fulfilment activities.

What You Bring:

  • 3-5+ years’ experience in data privacy compliance, data protection, regulatory fulfilment, risk, or a related operational environment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing consumer or data subject rights requests under US privacy laws, including the CCPA/CPRA and other applicable state privacy and data broker requirements.
  • Strong working knowledge of European data protection law and practice, including the GDPR and associated guidance, as well as familiarity with other relevant global privacy requirements.
  • Relevant third‑level qualification and a recognised data protection or privacy certification, or progress toward one.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Professional privacy certification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, AIGP, or equivalent is advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess and resolve privacy‑requests in a pragmatic, business‑focused way, escalating appropriately where legal, regulatory, or reputational risk is elevated.
  • Experience providing senior‑level support, informal leadership, coaching, or quality oversight within an operational team.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with a structured and detail‑oriented approach.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across the business.
  • Ability to work independently, make sound operational judgments, and contribute positively within a collaborative team environment.
  • High levels of professionalism, discretion, and integrity when handling sensitive information.

Missão do Cargo

O(a) Especialista de Business Insights & Commercial Excellence será responsável por gerar insights de negócios por meio da análise de desempenho de produtos, concorrência, eficácia da força de vendas e pesquisas de mercado para embasar a tomada de decisões.   • Desenvolver dashboards e relatórios analíticos para apoiar a tomada de decisões em diversas áreas do negócio;
