title: Senior Data Protection Specialist - Governance
description:
Senior Data Protection Specialist - Governance Job Snapshot

Role: Senior Data Protection Specialist - Governance

Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

Industry: Oil and Energy

Function: Information Technology

Experience: Extensive data governance and protection experience required

Job Type: Full-time

Senior Data Protection Specialist - Governance in Dubai, United Arab Emirates is a specialist Oil and Energy opportunity with ADNOC Group responsible for enterprise data governance, data protection, information asset management, digital risk, data quality, privacy, and regulatory compliance. The role develops and maintains corporate governance frameworks covering data and technology policies, standards, ownership, stewardship, security, and protection while ensuring consistent adoption across ADNOC and its Group Companies.

Country: United Arab Emirates

City: Dubai

Industry: Oil and Energy

Function: Information Technology

Salary: 28000-42000 Estimated salary range based on similar jobs in the job city; please confirm the final offer with the employer.

Gender: Any

Candidate Nationality: Any

Job Type: Full-time

Role Context

The Senior Data Protection Specialist establishes the governance structures required to manage enterprise information as a controlled, trusted, secure, and valuable corporate asset. Working across business, operational, digital, architecture, risk, and technology teams, the position translates data protection and governance requirements into practical policies, standards, controls, accountability models, and assurance activities. The role has enterprise-wide impact by improving data quality, strengthening privacy and security controls, clarifying information ownership, maintaining visibility of authoritative data assets, and ensuring digital risks are systematically identified and managed. It also supports ADNOC 's response to evolving regulatory requirements and emerging data protection technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement an enterprise-wide data governance framework covering data quality, security, privacy, ownership, stewardship, and protection.
  • Develop the corporate data governance program and coordinate its adoption across ADNOC Group.
  • Establish policies, procedures, standards, and controls for enterprise data governance and information management.
  • Ensure data governance requirements are consistently applied across business, operational, and technology environments.
  • Work with business and operational teams to define requirements for protecting sensitive and critical information.
  • Translate business data protection requirements into clear technology, governance, and operational controls.
  • Ensure data protection requirements are incorporated into operational planning and prioritization.
  • Coordinate resources across business and operational areas to support data governance objectives.
  • Resolve governance, data quality, stewardship, and protection issues escalated by data governance representatives.
  • Develop and maintain an enterprise inventory of information assets.
  • Identify authoritative systems, information owners, custodians, and responsible stakeholders for critical data assets.
  • Support implementation and continuous improvement of enterprise data quality standards.
  • Facilitate adoption of data protection standards and associated compliance requirements throughout the organization.
  • Define data governance roles, responsibilities, ownership structures, and accountability requirements.
  • Establish clear stewardship responsibilities for ADNOC Group information assets.
  • Define Enterprise Architecture Information Principles and establish standards supporting their implementation.
  • Incorporate information governance principles and controls into annual assurance programs.
  • Monitor compliance with approved data governance policies, standards, and information management requirements.
  • Establish an enterprise digital Risk Management Framework, supporting methodologies, controls, and assessment practices.
  • Support risk champions and practice owners in identifying, evaluating, documenting, and reporting digital risks.
  • Maintain digital risk registers and ensure risk information remains current and actionable.
  • Conduct periodic risk reviews in accordance with Enterprise Risk Management framework requirements.
  • Escalate material data governance, data protection, privacy, and digital risk issues to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Build effective working relationships across internal functions, departments, Group Companies, government authorities, shareholders, vendors, and service providers.
  • Provide specialist guidance on emerging data protection technologies and their potential application within ADNOC.
  • Conduct market assessments covering technology developments relevant to enterprise data protection.
  • Identify and evaluate vendors capable of delivering appropriate data governance and protection technologies or services.
  • Provide technical expertise for RFPs and RFQs covering data protection solutions and services.
  • Review tendering and contractual documentation to support cost-effective procurement and appropriate protection requirements.
  • Participate in negotiations covering contractual provisions and Service Level Agreements.
  • Ensure vendor agreements adequately protect ADNOC 's data, technology, commercial, and service interests.
  • Monitor relevant service expectations and support effective vendor governance.
  • Plan, supervise, and coordinate assigned data governance and protection activities.
  • Coach and develop assigned personnel in data governance, digital risk, information management, and protection practices.
  • Provide input for functional and departmental budget preparation.
  • Support execution of approved budgets and work plans and investigate significant variances.
  • Implement approved policies, systems, processes, standards, and procedures in accordance with company and international requirements.
  • Contribute to approved performance objectives within the company performance framework.
  • Develop tools and techniques that improve data governance quality, assurance, and operational efficiency.
  • Benchmark internal practices against recognized industry approaches and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Comply with applicable HSE policies, legislation, sustainability guidelines, and ADNOC Codes of Practice.
  • Provide data governance, protection, and risk inputs for MIS and management progress reports.

Ideal Profile

The successful candidate should have substantial professional experience in enterprise data governance, data protection, information governance, digital risk management, data quality, or related information technology disciplines. Strong knowledge of data governance frameworks, privacy and protection controls, data ownership, stewardship, information asset inventories, authoritative data sources, and enterprise data quality practices is important. Candidates should understand how governance requirements interact with Enterprise Architecture, information security, operational technology environments, business processes, regulatory obligations, and Enterprise Risk Management. The position requires the ability to translate complex governance and protection requirements into practical policies, standards, controls, roles, and accountability structures that can be implemented across a large organization. Experience with vendor evaluation, technology market analysis, RFP and RFQ development, contractual requirements, SLA negotiations, assurance programs, and senior stakeholder engagement will be valuable.

Skills Set

  • Data protection
  • Information governance
  • Data privacy
  • Data quality management
  • Data security

  • Data governance policies
  • Data management standards

  • Vendor management

Why Join Us

This position provides the opportunity to shape enterprise data governance and protection across a large Oil and Energy organization where information quality, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance are increasingly important to digital operations and strategic decision-making. The role combines governance leadership with digital risk, enterprise architecture, data quality, technology assessment, vendor management, and information protection. It offers experienced specialists the scope to establish standards and accountability structures that influence how critical data assets are governed and protected across ADNOC Group.

About the Company

ADNOC Group is an integrated energy organization with operations spanning exploration, production, drilling, processing, logistics, refining, petrochemicals, and related energy activities. Its continuing digital transformation depends on secure, reliable, high-quality information assets supported by effective enterprise data governance, information protection, risk management, and technology standards.

  • Please be aware that this position is considered “Essential Personnel.” This means that in the case of inclement weather (e.g. snow storm) the employee who occupies this position may be expected to report to work for their normal shift if management deems necessary.

More about us:

At Takeda, we are transforming patient care through the development of novel specialty pharmaceuticals and best in class patient support programs. Takeda is a patient-focused company that will inspire and empower you to grow through life-changing work.

Certified as a Global Top Employer, Takeda offers stimulating careers, encourages innovation, and strives for excellence in everything we do. title: BCBA Clinical Director
description:
General Summary: The BCBA Clinical Director provides clinical leadership, oversight, and supervision across center-based and community based Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) services. This role is responsible for ensuring the delivery of high-quality, evidence-based, culturally responsive, and individualized care while promoting clinical excellence, staff development, and positive client outcomes. The BCBA Clinical Director provides direct supervision and support to Behavior Analyst Trainees (BATs) and other clinical staff, guiding clinical decision-making, treatment implementation, documentation, professional development, and performance.
Working in partnership with operational and organizational leadership, the BCBA Clinical Director helps implement clinical strategies, strengthen clinical workflows, support integrated care coordination, and maintain compliance with organizational policies and applicable AHCCCS, BACB, Arizona Board of Psychologist Examiners, health plan, and regulatory requirements.
This position also supports the ongoing development of the ABA program by promoting consistent clinical standards, effective supervision practices, and a positive, mission-aligned culture across clinic and in-home services.

JOB RESPONSIBLITIES:
1. Clinical Leadership & Program Oversight · Provide clinical supervision to unlicensed clinical staff in accordance with organizational, state, and regulatory standards. · Ensure clinical services are delivered in alignment with evidence-based practices, medical necessity criteria, and organizational policies. · Review and approve clinical documentation, treatment plans, and assessments to ensure quality and compliance. · Provide case consultation and guidance on complex clinical situations, crisis interventions, and risk management. · Ensure appropriate level of care determinations and service delivery.
2. Staff Supervision & Workforce Development · Provide clinical supervision to licensed and/or unlicensed clinical staff in accordance with state licensure & AHCCCS rules. · Participate in performance evaluations, chart reviews, corrective guidance, and ongoing feedback. · Support staff professional development, training, CEU planning, internship/residency coordination, and skill-building initiatives. · Support onboarding, orientation, and training of new clinical staff.
3. Clinical Documentation & Quality Assurance · Work with QM and Clinic Staff ensuring documentation meets state, federal, payer, and organizational standards (timeliness, content, medical necessity). · Assist in monitoring compliance with treatment planning, CFT/CM/MH reviews, progress notes, service authorizations, and discharge planning. · Conduct regular chart audits and quality reviews; collaborate with the operations oversight for any recommended corrective action plans as needed. · Support integration with utilization management, prior authorization, and care coordination teams.
4. Regulatory, Licensing & Payer Compliance · Ensure clinical services meet regulatory requirements including HIPAA, OSHA, state licensure. · Maintain adherence to payer requirements, clinical protocols, credentialing standards, and service definitions. · Participate in internal/external audits, investigations, incident reviews, and corrective action plans.
5. Member Care Coordination & Safety · Support complex case management, crisis intervention protocols, and escalation pathways. · Ensure continuity of care across service levels (outpatient, medical, inpatient, community). · Oversee risk management related to clinical services, including safety planning and mandated reporting.
6. Clinical Collaboration and Communication · Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including medical providers, care coordinators, and operational leadership. · Support integrated care efforts between behavioral health and physical health providers. · Communicate effectively with the Executive Director regarding clinical trends, risks, and staff performance. · Participate in team meetings within program and across the organization.
Qualifications and Experience:

Minimum Education Required: Master’s degree in Applied Behavior Analysis, Education, Psychology, or related field.
Minimum Experience Required: Four years of related experience in the field of Applied Behavior Analysis and two years of supervisory experience.
License Requirement: Must be a Board Certified Behavior Analyst recognized by the Behavior Analyst Certification Board and must be licensed behavior analyst recognized by the Arizona Board of Psychologist Examiners.

Regulatory Requirements:

Minimum 18 years of age.
Valid AZ DPS Level I fingerprint clearance card (must maintain valid card throughout employment)
CPR, First Aid, AED certification, if required (must maintain throughout employment).
Current, valid Driver’s License and 39-month Motor Vehicle Report and proof of vehicle registration liability insurance to meet insurance requirements
Initial current negative TB test result, if required (Employer provides).
Must pass a pre-employment drug screen and may be subject to random, post-injury, reasonable suspicion and/or annual drug screens as requested by leadership or required by program regulations.

title: Director, Virtual Workspace Engineering (Toronto, ON, CA, M1L4S2)
description:
Requisition ID: 257990

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Leads and oversees Virtual Workspace Engineering as an end-to-end product and engineering function, accountable for the strategy, architecture, engineering, operational stability, and continuous evolution of the Bank’s virtual workspace platforms. The role owns both the current service landscape and the future transformation roadmap, ensuring reliable, secure, scalable, and user-centric delivery across enterprise virtual workspace services.

This leader is accountable for the present and future of the virtual workspace domain, including Citrix, virtual desktop and application delivery, Omnissa Horizon, and the strategic evolution toward Windows 365 Cloud PC. The role combines director-level leadership, product ownership, and senior principal engineering depth to simplify the environment, modernize the platform, improve service resilience, and translate technology investments into business outcomes.

Ensures all activities are conducted in compliance with governing regulations, internal policies, standards, and procedures.

Acts as the senior leader for a complex enterprise virtual workspace product domain that must simultaneously run, improve, and transform. The role defines the product vision, engineering direction, and service operating model for virtual workspace technologies across the Bank, balancing user experience, resilience, simplification, security, operational control, and cost discipline.

The incumbent serves as the senior technical authority and business-facing product leader for the domain, shaping priorities, investment choices, architecture patterns, engineering standards, operational processes, and modernization roadmaps.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:
• Leads and oversees the Virtual Workspace Engineering function, ensuring strategic alignment, strong service ownership, and execution against business and technology priorities.
• Owns the product strategy and engineering roadmap for the virtual workspace domain across current and future platforms, including Citrix, Omnissa Horizon, virtual desktop and application delivery, and Windows 365 Cloud PC. Ensures the roadmap balances business demand, engineering feasibility, risk, operational readiness, supportability, and long-term simplification.
• Acts as the most senior technical leader in the domain, providing deep expertise across architecture, systems design, engineering, automation, service operations, and platform optimization. Leads complex design decisions across networking, latency, geographic distribution, resiliency, capacity, security, compliance, identity, and endpoint integration.
• Owns operational stability and service excellence for the live environment, including availability, performance, supportability, incident response, root-cause analysis, problem management, lifecycle management, and permanent corrective actions.
• Defines and drives simplification of the virtual workspace ecosystem by rationalizing complexity, improving operational efficiency, reducing platform sprawl where appropriate, and standardizing engineering and service patterns.
• Champions modernization and innovation through product thinking, proofs of concept, proofs of value, and disciplined execution. Leads the transition toward modern cloud-based virtual workspace capabilities, including Windows 365 Cloud PC, while ensuring coexistence and sound operational governance across legacy and strategic platforms.
• Translates business priorities into a clear product backlog and engineering execution plan, partnering with stakeholders across infrastructure, security, architecture, operations, support, and lines of business. Ensures technology direction is tied to measurable business outcomes, service quality, risk reduction, and user experience improvements.
• Defines target architecture, reference patterns, engineering standards, automation, and operational controls for the domain. Ensures solutions are scalable, secure, supportable, and documented, and that knowledge is embedded into the organization rather than concentrated in individuals.
• Builds and leads a high-performing, inclusive, and globally distributed team through strong leadership, talent development, coaching, succession planning, and clarity of accountability.
• Drives strong governance, risk management, and control discipline across the domain, embedding security, resilience, compliance, and operational risk awareness into daily decision-making.
• Serves as a senior escalation point and trusted advisor for complex platform, architecture, operational, and transformation issues. Engages effectively with executive stakeholders, engineering leaders, vendors, and cross-functional partners to influence outcomes, align decisions, and drive delivery

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Extensive progressive experience in enterprise infrastructure, Enterprise Platforms, end user compute, virtual workspace engineering, or adjacent platform engineering environments, including significant experience leading complex engineering and operational functions in large-scale enterprises.
• Strong people leadership experience, including leading managers and globally distributed teams, building high-performing organizations, and driving accountability across engineering and operations.
• Deep expertise in virtual workspace and end user computing technologies, including strong experience with Citrix, virtual desktops and application delivery, Omnissa Horizon, Windows 365 Cloud PC, Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, identity and access patterns, and operational tooling relevant to platform performance and observability.
• Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, systems design, resiliency, security, network dependencies, capacity considerations, automation, and service operations.
• Hands-on technical credibility with automation, scripting, and engineering problem solving; ability to engage deeply in design and troubleshooting while operating effectively at leadership level.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate highly complex concepts into clear direction for executives, peers, customers, and technical teams.
• High proficiency in English is required. Spanish is considered an asset for global collaboration.
• Relevant certifications are an asset, particularly in Citrix, Horizon, Microsoft 365, Endpoint Management Intune, Security, Entra ID, and Azure.

What's in it for you?
• Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.

Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

title: Staff Software Engineer - Frontend
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Software Engineer - Frontend based in India.

This staff-level engineering role focuses on shaping a high-impact platform that enables highly customized user experiences at global scale.
You’ll help architect robust systems, build scalable interfaces, and improve the underlying runtime and templating capabilities that power complex frontend experiences.
The role combines frontend and full-stack engineering with platform architecture, operational excellence, and technical leadership.
You’ll work primarily with React, Node.js, TypeScript, and Ruby while applying modern approaches such as microfrontend architecture.
A major part of the position involves influencing technical direction, improving engineering standards, and collaborating across teams on large-scale initiatives.
You’ll also contribute to production reliability, continuous delivery, operational support strategies, and the development of other engineers.
This opportunity is ideal for a highly experienced engineer who can tackle complex technical challenges while communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Accountabilities:

  • Platform architecture: Architect, develop, and maintain the runtime platform that powers customized frontend experiences, ensuring solutions are robust, scalable, maintainable, and performant.
  • Scalable frontend development: Design and implement sophisticated user interfaces using microfrontend concepts to deliver flexible, high-quality, and intuitive experiences.
  • Templating systems: Improve and evolve templating capabilities that enable engineering teams to build and customize platform experiences more efficiently and consistently.
  • Full-stack engineering: Work across React, Node.js, TypeScript, and Ruby to develop platform capabilities and supporting services.
  • Software quality: Produce clean, efficient, well-tested, and well-documented code while following established engineering standards and best practices.
  • Technical communication: Explain complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through discussions, presentations, and design documentation.
  • Cross-team initiatives: Collaborate with engineering teams on large-scale technical initiatives and contribute to the development of a unified, scalable global platform.
  • Technical standards: Establish and evolve team-level technical standards, engineering practices, and operational processes that improve development effectiveness and system quality.
  • Production reliability: Provide ongoing support for production UIs and services, including 24/7 operational coverage, with a focus on achieving 99.99% uptime.
  • Performance and scalability: Identify and recommend technical investments that improve the stability, performance, scalability, and long-term maintainability of production services.
  • CI/CD: Build and improve modern Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery systems that enable reliable and deterministic software releases.
  • Operational strategy: Develop intuitive and scalable operational support strategies that enable new and junior developers to effectively contribute to production support.
  • Technical leadership: Support engineering leadership in assessing short- and long-term technical priorities, balancing immediate business needs with sustainable platform investments.
  • Mentorship: Mentor junior developers and help them strengthen both their technical capabilities and professional skills.

    • Requirements

    • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
    • Professional experience: 8+ years of software engineering experience, including test-driven development and UI/API design.
    • Technology expertise: Strong experience with modern engineering technologies, with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Ruby on Rails preferred.
    • Frontend architecture: Strong understanding of scalable frontend architecture and experience with microfrontend concepts or comparable approaches.
    • Production operations: 5+ years of experience monitoring production systems, tuning alerts, responding to production incidents, and improving service reliability.
    • Scalability and performance: Demonstrated ability to identify technical investments and architectural improvements that strengthen stability, performance, and scalability.
    • CI/CD expertise: Experience building or contributing to modern Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery systems that support deterministic and dependable releases.
    • Technical leadership: Ability to influence architecture, establish technical standards, guide engineering practices, and contribute to complex, organization-wide initiatives.
    • Problem solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complex technical challenges and make sound engineering decisions.
    • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
    • Strategic thinking: Ability to balance short-term priorities with longer-term technical goals and make recommendations that support sustainable engineering outcomes.
    • Operational mindset: Ability to create practical, scalable operational support strategies for engineering teams.
    • Distributed collaboration: Experience working remotely and effectively collaborating with distributed teams.
    • Mentorship: Strong interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to support the growth and development of less-experienced engineers.
    • English proficiency: Fluent spoken and written English.

      • Benefits

      • Full-time employment: Full-time staff-level engineering position.
      • Bangalore-based role: Position located in Bangalore, India.
      • High-impact scope: Opportunity to work on a highly visible platform serving users at significant global scale.
      • Technical ownership: Strong opportunity to influence frontend architecture, platform strategy, engineering standards, scalability, and reliability.
      • Modern technology stack: Hands-on work with React, Node.js, TypeScript, Ruby, microfrontend concepts, templating systems, and modern CI/CD practices.
      • Cross-functional environment: Collaboration across engineering and other technical teams on large-scale platform initiatives.
      • Leadership and mentorship: Opportunity to influence engineering practices and mentor junior developers while continuing to grow as a technical leader.
      • Operational excellence: Exposure to high-availability production systems and engineering practices focused on achieving 99.99% uptime.
      • Immediate opportunity: The position is intended for a candidate who can join immediately.

At Steampunk, our goal is to build and execute a data strategy for our clients to coordinate data collection and generation, to align the organization and its data assets in support of the mission, and ultimately to realize mission goals with the strongest effectiveness possible.

For our clients, data is a strategic asset. They are looking to become a facts-based, data-driven, customer-focused organization. To help realize this goal, they are leveraging visual analytics platforms to analyze, visualize, and share information. At Steampunk you will design and develop solutions to high-impact, complex data problems, working with the best and data practitioners around. Our data exploitation approach is tightly integrated with Human-Centered Design and DevSecOps.

Contributions

  • Lead and architect migrations of data using Databricks with focus on performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Assess and understand ETL jobs, workflows, data marts, BI tools, and reports
  • Address technical inquiries concerning customization, integration, enterprise architecture and general feature/functionality of data products
  • Experience working with database/data warehouse/data mart solutions in cloud (Preferably AWS. Alternatively Azure, GCP).
  • Key must have skill sets – Databricks, SQL, PySpark/Python, AWS
  • Support an Agile software development lifecycle
  • You will contribute to the growth of our AI & Data Exploitation Practice!

Qualifications

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance.
  • Bachelor's Degree and 8+ years of experience.
  • 5-7 years industry experience coding commercial software and a passion for solving complex problems.
  • 5-7 years direct experience in Data Engineering with experience in tools such as:
    • Big data tools: Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, etc.
    • Relational SQL (Preferably T-SQL. Alternatively pgSQL, MySQL).
    • Data pipeline and workflow management tools: Databricks Workflows, Airflow, Step Functions, etc.
    • AWS cloud services: Databricks on AWS, S3, EC2, RDS (or Azure equivalents).
    • Object-oriented/object function scripting languages: PySpark/Python, Java, C++, Scala, etc.

  • Advanced working SQL knowledge and experience working with relational databases, query authoring and optimization (SQL) as well as working familiarity with a variety of databases.
  • Experience manipulating, processing, and extracting value from large, disconnected datasets.
  • Ability to inspect existing data pipelines, discern their purpose and functionality, and re-implement them efficiently in Databricks.

title: Data Protection Specialist
description:
Our client is a fast-growing health insurance business in Ireland, built to challenge the status quo with faster access to care, genuine value and customer service that puts people first. Backed by an established international insurance group, the business pairs the stability of a major insurer with the pace and ambition of a challenger brand. With the business scaling quickly, this is an excellent time to join a lean, high-impact team.

The business is a regulated health insurance intermediary, authorised and supervised by the Central Bank of Ireland. Reporting to the Chief Risk and Compliance Officer (CRCO), the Senior Compliance Officer will play a central role in operating and embedding an effective second-line compliance framework, with support across enterprise risk management and data protection. This is a hands-on role for an experienced compliance professional who wants real ownership and visibility in a growing organisation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the day-to-day delivery of the annual Compliance Plan and Compliance Monitoring Programme (CMP), including testing, reporting and tracking remediation to closure.
  • Maintain the compliance universe of applicable legal and regulatory obligations, monitoring upcoming regulatory developments and ensuring new requirements are assessed, communicated and implemented.
  • Draft, review and maintain compliance policies, procedures and standards, and deliver training and awareness on regulatory, risk and data protection topics.
  • Investigate and log conduct risk issues, errors, breaches and incidents, escalating appropriately and supporting root cause analysis and remediation.
  • Prepare Central Bank of Ireland returns, regulatory correspondence and responses to ad hoc information requests.
  • Prepare compliance reporting for the Risk and Compliance Committee, Audit Committee and the Board.
  • Support the Risk Management Framework, including maintaining the risk register, risk appetite metrics and key risk indicators, and facilitating risk workshops with business owners.
  • Act as a key point of contact on data protection matters, supporting the DPO/CRCO with DPIAs, records of processing activities, breach management and subject access requests under GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.
  • Partner with stakeholders across the business to gather key risk and compliance data and metrics.
  • Support outsourcing oversight, third-party due diligence and operational resilience activities, and act as a point of contact for the outsourced Internal Audit function.
  • Promote a strong compliance and risk culture, advising first-line teams on how to apply regulatory requirements in practice.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience:

  • 4–5+ years’ experience in compliance (ideally with exposure to risk and data protection) within financial services, preferably insurance, insurance intermediation or another regulated sector.
  • Strong working knowledge of Central Bank of Ireland requirements, including the Consumer Protection Code, Insurance Distribution Regulations and the Fitness and Probity regime.
  • Practical knowledge of GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018, including DPIAs, breach management and records of processing.
  • A relevant qualification in compliance, law, finance or business is desirable (e.g. LCI’s Professional Diploma in Compliance).
  • Excellent analytical, report-writing and communication skills, with the confidence to engage senior stakeholders and regulators.
  • A self-starter who thrives in a small second-line function and can manage multiple regulatory deadlines.

title: Senior Manager, HPS Front-End Manufacturing Engineering
description:
Req ID: 138820
Remote Position: No
Region: Asia
Country: Thailand
State/Province: Chonburi
City:  Laem Chabang
**Summary**
As the Senior Manager of Front-End Manufacturing Engineering, you will lead the strategic alignment between early-stage product design and mass-production manufacturability for next-generation
products and technologies. This role bridges the gap between top-tier chip design partners, internal Hardware engineering teams, and Manufacturing sites. You will be responsible for leading and scaling a team of high-performing engineers, driving SMT and Assembly Process Development to meet technology development roadmaps, mitigating technical risks via the NUDD framework, and ensuring seamless execution from concept to product qualification.
**Detailed Description**
1. People Management Team Leadership
+ Talent Development & Mentorship: Directly manage, coach, and mentor a team of Front-End Manufacturing Engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous professional growth.
+ Performance Management: Establish clear individual and team KPIs, conduct regular performance evaluations, and build tailored career development paths.
+ Resource Planning & Allocation: Oversee team workload, headcount planning, and resource distribution to effectively support multiple parallel hardware development projects and operational timelines.
+ Technical Oversight: Act as an escalation point to provide technical guidance, helping team members resolve complex engineering and manufacturing bottlenecks.
2. Early Engagement & DFx Strategy
+ Design for Excellence: Lead and participate in comprehensive DFM/DFx reviews, providing technical solutions and mitigations to resolve manufacturing risks before design freeze.
+ Co-Design Partner: Engage with design teams and architects in the early design phases to align component specifications with cutting-edge manufacturing capabilities.
+ Ecosystem Partnership: Drive early-stage technology co-development and Level 2 qualification efforts with critical third-party partners and manufacturing sites.
3. Risk Mitigation & Technical Analysis (NUDD)
+ NUDD Framework Execution: Evaluate New, Unique, Different, and Difficult (NUDD) processes against strict product technology requirements to identify potential yield and reliability detractors.
+ Quality & Controls: Drive golden pFMEAs and define Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) parameters across new product lines.
+ Failure Analysis: Interpret complex hardware product features and Failure Analysis (FA) results to generate comprehensive engineering and root-cause reports.
4. Advanced SMT Process Characterization
+ Warpage & Thermal Management: Partner with operations to characterize complex PCB and large-form-factor BGA warpage behaviors.
+ Process Optimization: Characterize and optimize reflow profiles and advanced stencil designs to support development phases and continuous operational improvements.
+ NPI Prototyping Support: Provide hands-on engineering leadership during physical process builds,managing special build requirements and supervising deviation controls.
5. Technical Project Management & SME Leadership
+ Cross-Functional Governance: Facilitate internal alignment meetings, manage action items, and maintain accountability across engineering disciplines.
+ Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for external customers, suppliers, and HPS teams, leading weekly synchronization on all related Front End Engineering activities.
**Knowledge/Skills/Competencies**
+ People Management Experience: 5+ years of direct experience managing, building, and leading engineering teams within a highly technical hardware development or manufacturing environment.
+ Industry Context: Direct experience collaborating with hyperscalers or tier-1 silicon providers (e.g., Nvidia, Broadcom, Marvell) is highly preferred.
+ Technical Expertise: Deep understanding of DFx principles, pFMEA methodologies, reflow profiling, stencil design optimization, and BGA/PCB warpage characterization.
+ Leadership & Soft Skills: Strong emotional intelligence with a proven track record of mentoring technical staff; exceptional project management skills with the ability to lead cross-functional matrixed teams and present technical milestones to executive stakeholders.
**Physical Demands**
+ Incumbent will perform the duties of this position in a normal office environment.
+ Duties may require periodic sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data.
+ May require occasional travel.
**Typical Experience**
+ 8+ years of experience in Electronic Manufacturing, SMT Process Engineering, or NPI Leadership, with a proven track record handling large BGAs and high-density interconnect boards.
**Typical Education**
+ Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical field.
+ Educational requirements may vary by geography.
**Notes**
This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

title: Sr. Media Planner
description:
The Opportunity

Ready to build the media planning playbook for one of the world's most recognized brands? Adobe is establishing a new in-house media planning function to take direct ownership of end-to-end media buying and develop an AI-driven engine for global advertising execution. As Senior Media Planner, this role will translate regional media strategy into tactical media plans for one or more paid channels — starting with Meta, TikTok, and Snap — converting strategy into plans the buy desk can implement directly. It's an early opportunity to help shape how Adobe plans and buys media for years to come!

What the Role Does

This role sits between the media strategy teams and the buy desk, making sure every plan is platform-native and ready to execute! The Senior Media Planner builds tactical plans for assigned channels — audience targeting, budget splits, flighting, and placement — based on regional media strategy, and stays in daily contact with the local strategy team to maintain alignment. Keeping pace with platforms that change their ad products and targeting tools every quarter takes staying current and applying that knowledge consistently across every plan.

Finished plans get handed to Adobe's India-based media-buying team for execution. This role flags blockers and resolves them against the team's established process. Where it fits, Adobe's own marketing technology — GenPem, AEP, RTCDP — gets built into the plan, putting Adobe's platforms to work on its own advertising. Before anything moves to the buy desk, campaigns are tagged, organized, and quality-checked against Ops standards, with local nuance (language, regulatory, pricing) layered on top of consistent global planning practices.

This role will also partner with regional strategists and analysts to review campaign reporting and translate results into optimizations: budget shifts, targeting changes, and creative refreshes for their channel(s). Performance trends, platform changes, and new targeting or data-sharing opportunities get surfaced back to the Director of Media Planning and the broader team. The role also helps shape a consistent quarterly planning process and works directly with platform partners to identify testing and beta opportunities each cycle.

Scope & Reporting

This is an individual contributor role, one of a global team of seven Media Planners reporting to the US-based Director of Media Planning. The role works closely with, but does not manage, the India-based buy desk, analytics, media strategy, and engineering partners. Initial focus is paid social (Meta, TikTok, Snap), with scope expected to grow over time.

First 90 Days

During the first quarter, the goal is to ramp fast and build trust. Become proficient in Adobe's audience segments, brand guidelines, and channel mix, and work on building relationships with regional strategists regarding media objectives and planning cadence. Complete the buy desk handoff process for at least one full plan submission. You will audit current tagging, naming, and QC practices against new Ops standards. You will establish a regular cadence with regional strategy counterparts and the India-based buying team.

What's Needed to Succeed

  • 5+ years in digital advertising or media planning/buying, with hands-on experience in at least one of Meta, TikTok, or Snap
  • Strong working knowledge of platform ad managers, audience targeting tools, and campaign measurement
  • Experience managing multi-market activations, including platform setup across a wide range of markets and languages
  • A track record of delivering performance-focused paid social campaigns
  • Comfort reading campaign dashboards and working with analysts to shape concrete optimization recommendations
  • Ability to translate strategic briefs into detailed, executable media plans
  • Clear communication across regional and offshore teams, holding to global standards while adapting to local needs
  • Strong attention to detail — comfortable owning QA, QC, and documentation for assigned plans

Nice-to-Haves

  • Familiarity with AI-driven media buying, including executing buys through LLM-based tools like Meta's MCP
  • Experience with Adobe's marketing and advertising tools (GenPem, AEP, RTCDP)
  • Experience working with an offshore or outsourced buying/execution team
  • Background spanning both B2B and consumer advertising
  • Agency experience, or exposure to a newly formed team — ideally at a company insourcing media execution

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.


Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.


Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

title: Machine Learning Engineer | ML Engineer
description:
Salary: $200,000 – $300,000 per year

PLEASE NOTE: This role is based in Austin, Texas (NOT SYDNEY) - on-site, relocation & VISA costs all taken care of.

We are looking for some of Australia's best machine learning engineers ready to make the life-changing decision to relocate to Austin, Texas, where you will join one of the most progressive tech companies in the world. After experiencing rapid growth & funding, this business has working products in a number of US states and will soon be looking at international expansion. Due to this success, they are looking at hiring multiple ML Engineers for their expanding team.

If successful, you will build the neural networks that let self-driving cars and delivery robots see and decide in real traffic.

This transformative opportunity will not only shape your career but also your life experience, as you will get to live and work in one of the most vibrant cities in the world. The business is an autonomous vehicle company that builds two main products:

  • Autonomus cars

  • Autonomous delivery robots

They are both driverless and can run in real traffic - both vehicle & pedestrian.

They want engineers from Australia, and they are hiring multiple machine learning engineers into their teams covering perception, behaviour prediction, and motion planning. Where you land is settled after the interview process, by what you are strongest at.

To be straight about what this is not: it is not a pipelines and MLOps role. It is neural network work, deployed on real hardware. If your experience is simulation only, or research that never shipped, this one is not the fit.

What you will do

Day-to-day, you work in Python with PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX. Inference runs in C++ on the vehicle, so you will work inside that code too.

  • Perception. Train the models that see, and decide which data they need from a fleet that records far more than any person could review.

  • Prediction and planning. Model how pedestrians, cyclists and other drivers are about to move, and turn that into how the car should act.

  • Evaluation. Build metrics that track real on-road behaviour, because a model that scores better offline can still drive worse.

  • Failure analysis. Dig into rare scenes from real driving logs and feed what you find back into the data and the model.

  • Fixed compute. Make hard calls between accuracy, latency and memory on embedded hardware, and defend them.

What you will bring

  • At least three years taking neural networks from data through training into production or onto real hardware, and keeping them working once there.

  • Real depth in one area: computer vision, or behaviour prediction and motion planning, ideally on vehicles, robots, drones or similar physical systems.

  • Python and a modern deep learning framework as your everyday tools.

  • Enough C++ (or Rust) to read and work in the code your model runs inside.

  • Ownership from prototype to deployment, including fixing it after it shipped, and getting your own data at scale with SQL rather than waiting on someone else.

Nice to have

Making a model meaningfully faster on target hardware and knowing what you gave up for it. Machine learning for autonomous vehicles or robotics. Published work or open source code they can read. Good judgment on which new architectures, transformers and multimodal models included actually apply to the problem.

What is on offer

  • Salary in US dollars. Mid-level USD 150,000 to 180,000 base with a 20% target bonus. Senior up to around USD 220,000 base with about 22% bonus, plus equity. Around AUD 220,000 to 320,000 base across the range.

  • Relocation covered. Relocation and US immigration costs, corporate housing on arrival, flights for your family and help with a car.

  • Leave and benefits. 21 days leave, 10 sick days and 8 public holidays, health premiums paid, a 401(k) with a 4% match, and 20 weeks primary parental leave after a year.

  • Work that is judged on what you built. No advanced degree needed and no prior autonomous vehicle experience needed. Shipped systems count far more than credentials.

  • A team that ships together. Onsite in Austin, working directly with the planning, infrastructure and vehicle software engineers who take your model's output.

Who can apply

PLEASE NOTE: This role is based in Austin, Texas - on site, relocation & VISA costs all taken care of. Only apply if you are an Australian Citizen and happy to relocate. This is NOT a remote working role. Relocation and US immigration costs are covered.

Apply

ScaleUp Recruitment welcomes applicants from every background however, due to the restrictions around the e3 Visa, you will need to be an Australian Citizen to be eligible for this role.

Apply now, or email sam@scaleuprecruitment.com.au for a confidential chat.

title: Data-Quality Specialist
description:
We're seeking someone to keep the service's data trustworthy. To steward the data, find and fix quality problems, and reconcile between the contingent workforce platform and the HR and finance systems, so that reports and controls rest on accurate records.

The role suits a data analyst or steward who enjoys tracing a break back to its source.

About the Service

A leading South African financial institution is mobilising a managed service to run its contingent workforce process end to end. The service covers the full contractor lifecycle: requisitions, supplier routing, onboarding, contractor care, renewals, timesheets and deliverables, billing control and exits. It operates for a large population of contractors and consultants placed by a panel of more than 200 recruitment suppliers.

The service is delivered by a neutral managed service provider, on the client's systems and under the client's policies. The client keeps every decision that matters: policy, budget, rates, selection, payment and settlement. The provider administers, controls, reports and improves, and treats every supplier equally.

Key Responsibilities

Data Stewardship

  • Monitor completeness, accuracy and consistency of the workforce, supplier and financial data.
  • Maintain data definitions and quality rules.

Reconciliation

  • Reconcile between the vendor management platform and HR and finance systems, and resolve breaks.
  • Track data exceptions to closure with the owner of the source.

Reporting

  • Report data quality metrics and root causes, and recommend fixes to the reporting lead.

What success looks like

  • Data quality measured and improving against defined rules.
  • Reconciliation breaks between systems resolved with source owners.
  • Root causes of recurring data errors identified and fixed.

Boundaries of the role

Independence is central to this service. This role does not:

  • change source records without the owner's approval, or use data access to influence supplier or candidate outcomes.
  • override, or act in place of, a client decision on policy, budget, rates, selection, payment, settlement or risk acceptance.
  • favour or disadvantage any supplier or candidate.
  • influence supplier allocation, candidate screening or progression, rate outcomes, commercial disputes or supplier standing. This role sits in a ring-fenced specialist team.

You must declare any current or recent relationship with the client institution or with any supplier on its panel.

Qualifications

  • Degree or diploma in information systems, statistics, business or a related field.

Experience

  • At least 7 years in data quality, data stewardship or data analyst roles.
  • Experience with SQL and data reconciliation across systems.

Skills and knowledge

  • Data quality management.
  • SQL and reconciliation.
  • Root-cause analysis.
  • Attention to detail and communication.

Systems and tools

  • SQL, Excel, business intelligence tools, and familiarity with HR and finance systems.

Advantageous

  • Experience with HR or workforce data.

Personal attributes

  • Persistent in tracing breaks to source.
  • Diplomatic when a source owner must change a record.
  • Documents rules and findings.

Working relationships

  • The MI/BI and Service Performance Lead.
  • Reporting and Analytics Analysts.
  • Owners of HR, finance and platform data at the client.

Please Note: As all iqbusiness roles require honesty in the handling of or access to cash, finances, financial systems, or confidential information; our recruitment process requires that the following background checks be completed: credit, criminal, ID, and qualification verification.

In this role you will manage the collection of sustainability data that enables Bord Bia to develop and support claims and proof points around the sustainability of Irish food and drink, and demonstrate to the industry that the sustainability of Irish dairy and beef is continuously improving.

What you’ll do

1. Coordinate the collection, integration, validation and quality of sustainability data across the Bord Bia Assurance Schemes and Origin Green Programme.

2 Develop reports, dashboards and analytical insights that transform complex sustainability data into meaningful information for stakeholders and support evidence-based decision making.

3 Contribute to the development and enhancement of sustainable reporting methodologies and sustainability data solutions that support the Bord Bia Assurance Schemes and Origin Green Programme.

4. Analyse business processes, data flows and reporting requirements across the Bord Bia Assurance Schemes and Origin Green Programme, identifying opportunities to improve data quality, reporting capabilities and system effectiveness.

5. Work with technical teams and service providers to support the implementation of reporting, data and system enhancements that enhance the Bord Bia Assurance Schemes and Origin Green Programme outcomes.

6. Coordinate workstreams within AgNav and other sustainability initiatives that support the Bord Bia Quality Assurance Schemes and Origin Green Programme.

7. Present sustainability data, analytical insights and reporting outputs to internal and external stakeholders and provide subject matter expertise on sustainability data and reporting.

8. Manage assigned budgets and support compliance with GDPR, data governance and Bord Bia control procedures.

9. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and the implementation of Bord Bia standards, policies and governance frameworks across sustainability data and reporting activities.

About You

Essential Knowledge, Skills & Capabilities

Knowledge:

  • The ideal candidate will have 3-4 years' experience in a similar role.
  • Experience analysing and interpreting complex datasets to generate insights, identify trends and support decision making.
  • Experience gathering, analysing and documenting business requirements to deliver reporting, analytical and data solutions.
  • Experience developing reports, dashboards, data visualisations and benchmarking outputs for a range of stakeholders.

  • A quality-driven, detail orientated completer who consistently follows through on commitments.

title: Pipeline Engineer - Oil and Gas Projects
description:
Pipeline Engineer - Oil and Gas Projects

Job Snapshot

Role: Pipeline Engineer

Location: Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

Industry: Oil and Energy

Function: Mechanical Engineering

Experience: Minimum 6 years in Pipelines Engineering

Job Type: Full Time

ADNOC Group is seeking an experienced Pipeline Engineer in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates to develop cost-effective, value-added engineering solutions across pipeline projects and plant change initiatives. The role covers pipeline design review, engineering coordination, project technical support, pigging operations, corrosion-related activities and engineering document control. Candidates should bring at least six years of pipeline engineering experience together with strong knowledge of HSE, international pipeline standards, corrosion, cathodic protection, metallurgy, welding and inspection practices.

Job Details

Country: United Arab Emirates

City: Abu Dhabi

Industry: Oil and Energy

Function: Mechanical Engineering

Salary: Not disclosed

Gender: No Preference

Candidate Nationality: Not specified

Job Type: Full Time

Work Arrangement: On-site

Job Purpose

The Pipeline Engineer will develop practical and cost-effective engineering solutions throughout the project lifecycle while supporting plant change management in response to operational and market requirements. The position provides pipeline engineering expertise across engineering, procurement, construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning and handover. It also supports accurate implementation of pipeline document management and control systems.

Key Accountabilities

Pipeline Engineering and Design

  • Ensure consultant and engineering contractor designs are submitted in accordance with the approved scope of work.
  • Help ensure facilities delivered to end users are safe, reliable, operable and maintainable.
  • Review and approve pipeline engineering drawings, specifications and other technical design documents in line with project plans and objectives.
  • Develop cost-effective and value-added engineering solutions to improve project outputs.
  • Carry out designs for in-house engineered works, including drawings, specifications, data sheets and bills of quantities.
  • Provide engineering input required to support and implement plant change management.
  • Apply relevant engineering codes, standards and inspection requirements to pipeline activities.

Project Engineering Support

  • Provide technical expertise to project management activities throughout engineering, procurement, construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning and handover.
  • Coordinate interdisciplinary engineering activities associated with pipeline project scopes.
  • Ensure relevant company requirements are addressed across engineering interfaces.
  • Participate in pipeline engineering projects, including review of tender packages.
  • Witness commissioning activities where required.
  • Follow up on the timely receipt of commissioning documentation, spares and manufacturers ' maintenance manuals.

Pipeline Operations

  • Plan and direct pigging operations according to network availability.
  • Prepare monthly pigging schedules.
  • Liaise with Corrosion Section personnel regarding routine chemical injection and batch treatment programmes.
  • Ensure corrosion-related activities follow applicable Corrosion and Inspection guidelines and operating procedures.
  • Audit and review operating procedures and operating philosophies to assess the network 's capability to transport required throughput from fields to the terminal.

Engineering Documentation

  • Establish preliminary pipeline route alignments and coordinate requirements with relevant pipeline departments.
  • Manage engineering documentation associated with pipeline activities.
  • Evaluate asset documentation to support implementation of the pipeline document management and control system.
  • Maintain accurate engineering information required to support project and operational activities.

Supervision

  • Plan, supervise and coordinate activities within the assigned area to achieve functional objectives.
  • Provide appropriate guidance to assigned personnel.
  • Train and develop staff in relevant technical skills to improve job proficiency and support functional requirements.

Minimum Qualification

  • Bachelor 's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering or a relevant professional qualification.

Minimum Experience, Knowledge and Skills

  • Minimum 6 years of experience in Pipelines Engineering.
  • Knowledge of HSE requirements within plant and pipeline environments in a large industrial organization, preferably within the Oil and Gas industry.
  • Sound knowledge of international pipeline, corrosion and cathodic protection engineering standards and codes.
  • Comprehensive understanding of pipeline industry practices and relevant technology trends within Oil and Gas.
  • Good understanding of engineering disciplines, risk management and loss prevention techniques.
  • Working knowledge of design, manufacturing, metallurgy and welding.
  • Knowledge of standards and legislation associated with plant and equipment inspection.
  • Familiarity with QA/QC systems and procedures.
  • Technical ability to interpret engineering codes, standards and inspection methods.
  • Knowledge of HSE procedures and practices.
  • Ability to plan, organize, schedule, coordinate, check, examine and record engineering activities.

title: Hydrotechnical & Dam Breach Engineer | Specialist / Lead Level | UK
description:
Globe 24-7, in partnership with a leading international engineering consultancy, is seeking experienced and qualified professionals to join the team in the United Kingdom.

The Role

The incumbent will be responsible for leading and delivering dam breach assessments for tailings storage facilities (TSFs) and water-retaining structures. Focus on hydraulic modelling, consequence classification, inundation mapping, and integration of breach results into risk assessments, design decisions, and emergency preparedness planning.

The Responsibilities

  • Lead or support dam breach analyses for tailings and water dams, including breach mechanism definition, breach parameter selection, and scenario development.
  • Develop and run hydraulic and inundation models (e.g., HEC RAS, FLO 2D, RAMMS, or equivalent).
  • Produce inundation maps, consequence assessments, and support classification of facilities in line with international guidelines (GISTM, ICOLD, CDA, ANCOLD).
  • Interpret breach results to support risk assessments, design alternatives, and mitigation strategies.
  • Prepare technical reports, presentations, and documentation for internal review, clients, and regulators.
  • Collaborate with geotechnical, hydrotechnical, and water resources teams to support integrated project delivery.
  • Support emergency response planning and development of Emergency Preparedness and Response Plans (EPRPs) where required.
  • Contribute to site investigations, data review, and validation of input parameters.

The Requirements

  • Minimum 6 years’ experience in dam breach modelling, hydraulic modelling, or tailings/water dam safety engineering.
  • Strong capability with hydraulic modelling software (e.g., HEC RAS 1D/2D, FLO 2D, MIKE, or similar).
  • Understanding of tailings storage facilities, dam failure modes, breach mechanisms, and consequence classifications.
  • Experience preparing inundation maps, hazard assessments, and technical reports.
  • Familiarity with GISTM, ICOLD, CDA, ANCOLD, or equivalent guidelines.

The Rewards

The position offers a competitive remuneration package.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:

  • Demonstrated experience developing ETL/ELT processes for complex and/or large data movement, transformation and/or visualisations, particularly in a cloud environment.Weighting:50%

You will also collaborate with other engineers and geoscientists to evaluate new drilling locations and assess the potential productivity of existing wells.

To excel in this role, you should have a strong background in reservoir engineering, with experience in reservoir simulation software such as Eclipse or CMG. You should also have a thorough understanding of petroleum geology, fluid flow behavior, and production forecasting methods.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze data from well tests, production logs, and other sources to determine the characteristics of oil and gas reservoirs
  • Develop numerical models to simulate fluid flow within reservoirs and predict future production behavior
  • Perform sensitivity analyses on various parameters to optimize field development plans
  • Collaborate with geoscientists to integrate geological data into simulation models
  • Monitor production performance of existing wells and recommend actions to improve productivity
  • Evaluate new drilling locations using geological data and previous well results
  • Communicate results and recommendations to management, technical teams, and stakeholders
  • Stay updated on industry developments, new technologies, and best practices in reservoir engineering

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Petroleum Engineering or related field
  • Minimum of 5 years experience in reservoir engineering with a focus on simulation modeling
  • Experience working with reservoir simulation software (Eclipse or CMG)
  • Strong knowledge of petroleum geology principles
  • Familiarity with fluid flow behavior in porous media
  • Proven ability to analyze complex data sets and make accurate predictions based on various parameters
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-engineering stakeholders

Location

This position is based in Lusail, Qatar. Candidates from India or other English-speaking countries are preferred.

Salary

We offer a competitive salary of 1500$ per month, with potential for growth and advancement within the company.

If you are a driven and experienced Petroleum Engineer with a strong background in reservoir simulation, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Join our dynamic team and contribute to the success of our company.

title: (1730) Reference and Master Data Specialist - BSTD
description:
Job Description

The main purpose of this position is to define, maintain, manage and provide assurance of reference and master data within the South African Reserve Bank (SARB) Group (the SARB and its subsidiaries) to support reliable and effective decision‑making.

Detailed description

  • Define and document reference and master data requirements, business rules, measurements and metrics for data domains to create an authoritative source of truth for critical business information to enable effective decision‑making and operational effectiveness.
  • Define and manage master data relationships, hierarchies and structures to enable integrated entity views and support advanced analytics.
  • Implement standards, guidelines, processes and procedures for reference and master data within the SARB Group.
  • Define and implement business rules for data matching and merging to create a single version of the truth.
  • Create, maintain, manage and integrate a reference and master data environment that supports the standardisation of business information.
  • Monitor, measure, remediate and report on reference and master data quality metrics to ensure sustained data quality and identify areas of non‑conformance.
  • Develop, manage and maintain reference data and master data repositories for data domains across the SARB Group.
  • Contribute to the development of reference and master data standards, frameworks and standard operating procedures.
  • Implement appropriate governance controls to maintain and manage reference and master data effectively.
  • Develop and manage stakeholder relationships to promote reference and master data management across the SARB Group.

Qualifications

Job requirements

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or Management Information Systems, or an equivalent qualification in a related field.
  • At least five to seven years of experience in the field of reference and master data management.
  • A relevant reference and master data certification (e.g. CDMP Practitioner) would be an added advantage.

Additional requirements

  • Knowledge and skill in industry, organisational and business awareness.
  • Continued learning and/or professional development.
  • Quality assurance.
  • Information management.
  • Enterprise information management (EIM) strategy.
  • Data quality management.
  • Metadata management.
  • Data modelling and development.
  • Information governance.
  • EIM legislation and governance, risk and compliance.
  • Extensive knowledge in master record relationships, hierarchies and match and merge.
  • Continuous improvement.

In line with the SARB's commitment to diversifying its workforce, preference will be given to suitable candidates from designated groups. People with disabilities are welcome to apply.

The SARB offers remuneration and benefits commensurate with the level of the position and in line with the market. The level at which the successful applicant will be appointed will depend on his/her competence and experience.

The role will ensure data is accurate, complete, consistent, timely, and fit for purpose across banking, regulatory reporting, risk, finance, analytics, and AI initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and implement Data Quality Framework, standards, policies, controls, KPIs/KRIs and scorecards. Define and monitor Data Quality Rules for Critical Data Elements (CDEs). Lead Data Quality Issue Management, including root-cause analysis, remediation, escalation, and closure. Monitor data quality through dashboards, scorecards and management reporting. Support regulatory reporting, risk, finance, compliance and audit requirements. Ensure data quality for AI, analytics and ML initiatives. Work closely with Data Owners, Data Stewards, IT, Risk, Finance, Compliance and Business teams. Drive enterprise-wide Data Governance and Data Quality maturity.

Required Experience:

8–12 years in Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Management, Risk Data or Regulatory Data. Banking/Financial Services or another highly regulated industry is required. Strong knowledge of Data Quality, Data Governance, Data Lineage, Metadata, MDM and Reference Data. Experience with Informatica, Collibra, Microsoft Purview, ABACUS or similar platforms. Strong stakeholder management and governance experience.

title: Broker
description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

The Sales Broker is responsible for managing and growing a book of business while building and maintaining strong relationships with agents, brokers, and carriers. This role involves reviewing and analyzing risks, cultivating new market opportunities, and delivering excellent customer service to ensure client satisfaction and retention. Our focus is on bringing the power of collective size and specialty to the wholesale brokerage marketplace. Bridge Specialty Group – aligning risk with greater reach.

title: Animal Care Attendant
company: British Columbia Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals
description:
POSITION: Animal Care Attendant
STATUS: Permanent; Part-Time with benefits
SHIFT: 28 hours per week – Sunday to Wednesday
LOCATION: Vancouver, BC
CLASSIFICATION: CUPE 1622
WAGE: Hourly
CLOSING DATE: Open until Filled

About the Position:
The main responsibility of the Animal Care Attendant position is to care for the health and welfare of the animals in the Shelter. A subsidiary responsibility is to give support to the front office staff in an effective and courteous manner.

Some specific duties:

To work collaboratively with others to maintain the entire physical plant in a clean, sanitary and efficient manner on an ongoing basis
To maintain the kennels, runs and cat cages in a clean, sanitary and efficient manner on an ongoing basis
To treat the animals humanely, with compassion and concern, and transmit these values to others both on and off the job
To provide the animals with proper diet and to ensure that they feed and water properly
To ensure the animal’s health and well-being in accordance with the society’s animal health policy, including the administration of such medications as specified by the animal health technologist or other authorized shelter staff
To maintain a high level of standards in order to portray to the public the image of the SPCA as a compassionate and caring organization
To willingly help co-ordinate the supporting work of volunteers, in the spirit that we all work together for the benefit of all animals
To perform other duties, as required, which are necessary to ensure the smooth operation of the shelter
To collaborate with other shelter personnel thereby creating a positive and harmonious atmosphere among staff and volunteers, enhancing team performance

Secondary Key Responsibilities:
To assist the front office staff as may be required in:

Telephone reception and other communications
Answering counter inquiries
Receiving animals for surrender
All adoption procedures
License and merchandise sales
Performance of general office routines and record keeping
Other related duties
To perform all of the above in a courteous, friendly way to clients, volunteers and other staff, to ensure the highest possible reputation for the shelter and the maintenance of the goodwill of its community

Qualifications you need to have:

High School diploma or equivalent
Valid Class N or 5 BC Drivers’ License and driver’s abstract
Demonstrable interest in all aspects of animal welfare
A sound knowledge of animals, their breeds, characteristics and more common diseases
Ability to work as a team player and demonstrable well-developed interpersonal skills
Basic computer skills sufficient to deal effectively with the necessary front office routines
Excellent customer service
Ability to prioritize demands on time

Philosophical harmony with the vision, mission, and strategic directions of the BC SPCA.
